tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bka' 'grel sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed kyi
༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bka' 'grel sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed kyi

tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄༅// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bka' 'grel sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed kyi dgongs 'grel kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs don rab gsal zhes bya ba'i dbu phyogs bzhugs pa legs so// (2) shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bka' 'grel sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed dgongs 'grel kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs don rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rmad byung thugs bskyed rgya chen tshogs gnyis bsags// rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags pa brnyes// mdzad phrin gser gyi rtsibs ldan nyi ma'i gnyen// ston mchog thub dbang zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// rnam grol sku gsum brnyes kyang thub pa'i bstan// mthon por 'degs pa'i rin chen khrir 'khod nas// theg chen chos kyi nyi 'od sa gsum (3) khyab// rgyal tshab mi pham mgon la gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal yum brgyud 'dzin rgya bod mkhas kun dang*// khyad par mdo sngags chos tshul kun mkhyen pa'i// chos kyi spyan ldan kun mkhyen yab sras nas// yongs 'dzin mchog gi bar du byon rnams rgyal// rgyal yum dgongs 'grel rgyan gyi tshig don rnams// ha cang rgyas min mdor bsdus pa'ang min par// tshig 'jam go bde'i ngag gis 'dir bshad bya// dpyod ldan gzur gnas rna ba blags te nyon// 'dir gangs khrod bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam mgon dam pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba go bo rab 'byams bsod nams seṅge (4) zhes nyi 'og gi rgyal khams kun tu yongs su grags pa des mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed kyi dgongs 'grel las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du rig pa rnam grangs dang brda 'chad gtso bor gyur pa'i spyi'i ngag gis 'chad pa don gsum ste/

brjod bya sher phyin la 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ rjod byed bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'grel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'phags pas ji ltar phye ba'i tshul/ slob dpon gyis ji ltar bkral ba'i tshul/ gnad kyi don ngos gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyan gyi mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang dang pos rten gyi gang zag nyan rang 'phags pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gzhi shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshig rkang gnyis pas rten gyi gang zag byang sems 'phags pa'i dbang du mdzad nas lam shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshig rkang gsum pas rten gyi gang zag sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dbang du mdzad nas rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ tshig rkang bzhi pas sangs rgyas kyi yum bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen slob mi slob kyi mkhyen pa mtha' dag la dngos btags ma phye ba'i sher phyin du byas nas de la 'dir phyag 'tshal ba bstan pa yin no// zhes 'chad (5) pa la nyir snang du/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar 'god pa sngon du 'gro bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di byung*/ de ltar mkhyen gsum spyi'i yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bye brag sangs rgyas kyi yum la phyag mdzad nas shugs la mkhyen gsum de'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi man ngag gi bstan bcos rtsom par dam bca' ba bstan pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la zhes brjod pa 'di ni de'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi man ngag bshad sbyar du bya'o snyam pas rnam par 'grol bar bya'o zhes mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad pa 'di sbyar ba dam bcas pa yin no// zhes pa 'di byung*/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyis bkral tshul ni/

'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang zhes sogs kyis mchod brjod kyi mtshams sbyar bstan/ de bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni zhes sogs dgos don bstan/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis don brgyad bsdus la/ zhes pas bsdus don bstan/ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes sogs kyis tshig don bstan/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs kyis brgal lan bstan pa bzhed do /gsum gyis brgyad bsdus tshul ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su shugs (6) la mkhyen gsum gyi rgyan rtsom par dam bcas pa dang*/ lus kyi skabs su mngon rtogs brgyad brjod byar byas pa ni 'gal ba med cing gnad gcig pa yin te/ mchod brjod kyi skabs mkhyen gsum des lus kyi skabs kyi mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus pa'i phyir te/ mchod brjod kyi mkhyen gsum des lus kyi mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid kyis sgo nas bsdus/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sbyor ba'i sgo nas bsdus/ rtse sbyor rab kyi sgo nas bsdus/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba go rim gyi sgo nas bsdus/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mthar thug gi sgo nas bsdus/ 'bras bu chos sku rnam smin gyi sgo nas bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'o na sdu byed mkhyen pa dang bsdu bya'i mngon rtogs don gcig gam zhe na/ de gnyis 'gal ba ma yin pa ni gzhir bzhag la/ don gcig tu nam yang khas mi len te/ 'dir bstan sdu byed kyi mkhyen pa yin na/ bsdu bya'i mngon rtogs yin pas ma khyab/ bsdu bya'i mngon rtogs yin na yang bsdu byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa rnams mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pas sdu byed kyi mkhyen pa yin kyang*/ bstan bcos lus kyi dngos bstan gyi bsdu bya'i mngon rtogs ma yin pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku la sogs pa'i sku gsum po rnams bsdu bya'i mngon rtogs yin kyang*/

sdu byed kyi mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dir lam shes kyi thad du 'grel pa don gsal du mdo drangs pa (7) las/ lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing*/ lam thams cad shes par bya'o// de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing*/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang*/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs gsum po gang rung du gyur pa'i byang sems kyi lam thams cad byang sems rang rgyud la bskyed par bya zhing*/ rang rgyud kyi lam des rang rgyud la yod pa dang*/ byang sems 'og ma dang nyan rang sogs gzhan rgyud la yod pa'i rtogs rigs gsum po gang rung du gyur pa'i lam thams cad shes par bya dgos la/ der ma zad nyan rang gi spangs rtogs de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya dgos te/ de yang sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod thob pa'i dus su sngar theg dman gyi 'phags lam mngon du ma song na/ nyan rang gi spangs bya'i rigs mtha' dag slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas nas spong zhing nyan rang gi rtogs pa'i rigs mtha' dag ni dman lam sngon du ma song ba la yang 'dir nges par rdzogs te/ nyan rang gi ji tsam rtogs pa thams cad 'dir nges par rtogs pa'i (8) phyir ro// dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa mngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi dus su nyan rang gi spangs pa'i rigs mtha' dag rdzogs te/ nyan rang gi ji tsam spangs pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig byang sems dang po pa yin na/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs pas khyab/ zhes pa dang*/ yang kha cig byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod pa yin na/

nyan rang gi spangs pa'i rigs ma rdzogs pas khyab/ dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa mngon song gi byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod pa yin na/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs pas khyab zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ byang sems mthong lam pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ nyan rang gi spangs pa'i rigs rdzogs par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyon sgrib spangs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de ma spangs par thal/ de spong bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i gnyen po bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi byang (9) sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ nyan rang gi spangs pa'i rigs ma rdzogs par thal/ rtags de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rdzogs par thal/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i phyir/ de'i rtogs pa sngon song yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa mngon song gi byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod na de chos can/ rang rgyal gyi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma rdzogs par thal/ nyan thos kyi spangs pa'i rigs rdzogs la/ rang rgyal kyi spangs pa'i rigs ma rdzogs pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song la/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa la lam thams cad shes pa dang nyan rang gi spangs rtogs rdzogs pas mi chog ste/

sangs rgyas thob pa la smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang zhes pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rigs kun yongs su rdzogs dgos shing*/ sems can mtha' yas pa spang bya mthong spangs dngos su (10) spong rung dang*/ gnyen po mthong lam dngos su skye rung sogs kyi smin grol la 'god dgos pa dang*/ snod bcud kyi zhing dngos su sbyong ba'i zhing dag sbyor ba'i nyams len rnams mthar phyin par bya dgos la/ de lta bu rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin nas/ chos kyi sku brnyes pa'i dbang gis thugs dus rtag tu mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba ni/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas nas yang dag mtha' mngon du byas par 'gro bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i khyad chos so// de gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa ni mi srid kyang*/ rtag pa mtha' bzung gi tshul du de'i tshad 'jog na/ dag sar sgrib pa spong ba sogs kyi dgos pa med bzhin du ring du mnyam par bzhag pa na/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du byas par 'gro bas/ de ltar mi bya'o zhes 'doms la/ mdor/ de dag gis ni yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin no// gal te rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i dag sa'i byang sems yod na/ de chos can/ khyod de dag gis ni zhes sogs kyi gdams pa 'di dag dang 'gal bar thal/ rtsod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ (11) 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal ba'i dag sa'i byang sems yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ des na 'di dag sar 'byung nye ba'i dogs pa tsam yod pas/ de dag gis ni zhes sogs kyi gdams pa 'di dag sa'i byang sems la brjod pa yin te/ ma dag sa bdun du chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa na/

'bad rtsol dang bcas te 'jog dgos pas/ dgos pa med bzhin du mnyam bzhag la 'byams kyis dogs pa med la/ dag pa sa gsum du 'bad rtsol med par mnyam bzhag la gnas pas dgos pa can gyi mnyam bzhag gi tshad de rdzogs 'gro khar sangs rgyas rnams kyi mnyam bzhag de las nges par slong bar mdzad pas/ dgos med du mnyam bzhag la 'byams par 'gyur ba'i skabs mi srid cing slong ba po nyung na dgos med du 'byams par 'gyur bar srid pa ni rtag pa mtha' bzung ngo*// de skad du/ 'jug par/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'gog las slong bar mdzad// zhes gsungs so// 'di dang*/ ring du song ba 'di ni skad cig dang*/ zhes sogs 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i dogs pa spyod dgos yod kyang*/ 'dir skabs ma yin pas ma spros so// gsum pa gnad gyi don ngos bzung ba la gnyis te/ don dngos dang mtha' spyad pa'o// dang por la gsum ste/ brjod bya'i gtso bo byang sems kyi mngon rtogs su bstan pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba dang*/ de'i (12) 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i mngon rtogs su bstan pa'i sgo nas mdo'i dgos pa la sbyar ba dang*/ de'i 'bras bu 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs su bstan pa'i sgo nas mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa la tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes su byas nas rtogs rigs de gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can la bstan pas/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol ba rnams 'bras bu nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par mdzad pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs byung*/ de bzhin du byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa la tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes su byas nas rtogs rigs de byang sems kyi rigs can la bstan pas/

'gro ba la phan par byed pa'i byang sems rnams rtogs rigs de la brten nas 'bras bu 'jig rten gyi don mngon mtho dang nges legs sgrub par mdzad pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ 'gro la phan par byed rnams zhes sogs byung*/ yang de bzhin du byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa la tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen du byas nas rtogs rigs de byang sems rang gis nyams su blangs pas/ rtogs pa mthar thug brnyes pa'i thub par gyur pa ni ji ltar ji snyed kyi rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sna (13) tshogs pa gsungs pa 'di 'byung ba yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ gang dang yang dag ldan pas zhes sogs byung*/ de ltar na byang sems kyi rgyud kyi skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i skyed byed kyi yum yin pas/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i skye byed kyi yum de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'chad pa la/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i zhes sogs byung*/ mdor na sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe tshig rkang dang po gsum gyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ de'i tshe bzhi pa'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas kyi yum gnyis don gcig la/ sbyar tshul gnyis pa'i tshe yang de bzhin du rigs 'gre'o// sbyar tshul 'di'i shes byed ni/ bka' 'grel las/ bstan bcos rtsa bar skabs dang po gsum gyi mkhyen gsum dang mchod brjod kyi skabs kyi mkhyen gsum gnad gcig par bzhed nas lus kyi skabs su yang thub pa'i zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi zhes dang*/ nyan thos la sogs zhes mchod brjod kyi skabs kyi rten gyi gang zag dang sbyar ba mdzad cing*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa de'i don ni/
thub rnams zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi thub pa dang*/ thub pa'i zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi thub pa gnyis/ gnad gcig tu sbyor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gang dang yang

(14) dag ldan pas zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa de yang*/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen dang gnad gcig tu sbyor dgos la/ de ltar na bstan bcos lus kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen de byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas/ de'i tshe na mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gsum pa'i skabs su byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dngos su bstan pa grub cing*/ de bzhin du mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi rten gyi gang zag dang*/ bstan bcos lus kyi dngos bstan gyi lam shes kyi rten gyi gang zag gnyis kyang gzhung nyid du dngos su sbyar bas mkhyen pa gnyis kyang sbyar dgos la/ de'i tshe na tshig rkang gnyis pa'i skabs su byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa bstan pa grub/ yang tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi rten gyi gang zag dang*/ bstan bcos lus kyi dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes kyi rten gyi gang zag gnyis gzhung nyid du dngos su sbyar bas mkhyen pa gnyis kyang gnad gcig tu sbyar dgos la/ de'i tshe na tshig rkang dang po'i skabs su byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa bstan pa grub ste/ bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen gsum ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mngon rtogs 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir ro// des na brjod bya'i gtso bo byang sems kyi mngon rtogs (15) su bstan pa'i sgo nas zhes pa'i don yang bstan bcos lus kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen gsum byang sems kyi mngon rtogs su bstan pa'i sgo nas/ mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gsum char yang byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa ston byed du sbyar nas 'chad pa'i 'chad tshul gcig nges par thob ces pa'i don yin te/

'di nyid las/ de ltar na mchod brjod kyi mkhyen pa gsum po byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs la sbyar zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi yum du 'jog pa'i tshe skye byed kyi yum du 'jog pa 'di ni bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bor snang zhing*/ zhes dang*/ phyag gi yul ni sangs rgyas kyi yum kho na ste/ 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams snga phyi go bsgrigs nas 'chad rigs pas so// gnad 'di ni rje bla ma buddha'i mtshan can gyis gsungs so// sbyar tshul 'di ni 'grel pa don gsal las/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshad mas gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med pa yongs su shes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyi mtshan nyid kyi yum la gnod pa ma mthong nas zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par 'byor te/ gcig tu bral gyi rtags las byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po de rim bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gnyis (16) pa dang gsum pa'i bstan don du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa'am/ yum yin par 'grel pa des legs par bstan 'dug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mdo'i dgongs pa la sbyar ba ni/ rgyan gyi mchod brjod 'di mthar thug gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i mkhyen gsum ston byed du sbyar nas 'chad pa'i tshul yang yod de/ thob bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug mchod brjod kyi yul du byas nas de thob par byed pa'i thabs su mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bshad pa gzhung 'di'i skabs don yin pas/ de ltar gyi tshe na/ sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de'i lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ de'i rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa rnams sbyar tshul gnyis pa'i tshe rim bzhin du tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes dang*/

gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes dang*/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen yin cing*/ de lta bu'i mkhyen pa gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'chad pa la/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa nas/ yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i bar 'di byung*/ gsum pa mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba ni/ mdor dge slong lnga stong tsam dang thabs cig ste/ 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung dang zhes sogs 'khor rnam bzhi ston pa'i mdo rnams kyi rten gyi gang zag bstan/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa (17) zad pa zhes sogs kyi 'bras bu nyer zhi gnyis bstan pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na rten gyi gang zag de rnams kyis 'bras bu de rnams thabs gang la brten nas thob pa yin zhe na/ thabs nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi kun shes nyid la brten nas thob pa yin no zhes 'chad pa la/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes tshig rkang dang po byung*/ byang sems chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang yang thabs cig ste// 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang zhes sogs kyi rten gyi gang zag bstan/ thams cad kyang gzungs thob pa/ ma nyams pa'i mngon shes thob pa/ zhes sogs kyi 'bras bu 'jig rten gyi don sgrub pa bstan pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na rten gyi gang zag des 'bras bu de thabs gang la brten nas thob pa yin zhe na/ thabs byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lam shes la brten nas thob pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la 'gro la phan par byed rnams zhes sogs tshigs rkang gnyis pa byung*/ yang mdor/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi bla gos bzhi bltabs su byas te gdan seṅge'i khri bshams par mdzad do// ces dang*/ zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste stong gsum khyab par mdzad nas de las 'od zer 'byung ba'i rtse mo las padma'i sdong po re re/ de'i lte ba la sprul sku shākya thub pa/

'dab ma la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams la phar phyin drug las brtsams pa'i chos 'chad pa'i (18) snang bas phyogs bcur khyab pa'o// zhes sku'i snang ba byung ba'i mdo rnams kyi rten gyi gang zag bstan/ chos 'chad pa'i snang ba byung ba'i mdo rnams kyi 'bras bu chos 'khor bskor ba bstan pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na rten gyi gang zag de rnams kyi 'bras bu de rnams thabs gang la brten nas thob pa yin zhe na/ thabs sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen la brten nas thob pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ gang dang yang dag ldan pas zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum pa byung*/ 'o na de lta bu'i 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs rnams 'dir phyag 'tshal ba'i yum yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ mchod brjod mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba'i skabs 'dir ni 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs kyi nang nas sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mngon rtogs kho na sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pas/ de la phyag 'tshal ba yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhi pa byung*/ rje btsun mus rab 'byams pas mi pham dgongs rgyan las/ spyir mkhyen gsum la bstod pa dang*// bye brag sangs rgyas kyi yum la phyag 'tshal ba zhes gsungs pa yang sbyar tshul 'di'i skabs su dgongs pa yin no// des na mchod brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i tshe/ yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yum yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi skye byed kyi yum yin pas khyab/ (19) mtshan gzhi ni bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi slob lam mtha' dag go /mchod brjod mdo'i dgos pa la sbyar ba dang*/ mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba'i tshe yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yum yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pas khyab/ mtshan gzhi ni theg chen gyi mi slob lam mtha' dag go

/de skad du 'di nyid las/ bshad tshul dang po la sangs rgyas kyi skye byed kyi yum dang*/ phyi ma gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum la phyag 'tshal zhes par 'gyur bas/ phyag gi yul ni sangs rgyas kyi yum kho ni te/ 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu la phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes na 'dir phyag 'tshal ba'i yum ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa yin no// 'o na mchod yum gzhi shes sogs kyi tha snyad mi 'thad par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de ni rong ṭig gi dgongs don yum don rab gsal dang yan lag rgyas bshad rnams la grags tshod che yang*/ 'dir de dag gi tha snyad dngos su mi snang bas khas ma blangs kyang chog la/ ci ste khas len na gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa rnams mchod yum gzhi shes dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa rnams mchod yum lam shes dang*/ (20) rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa rnams mchod yum rnam mkhyen yin no// de ltar byas na mchod yum gzhi shes yin na/ gzhi shes yin pas ma khyab/ de lam shes yin na/ lam shes yin pas ma khyab/ de rnam mkhyen yin na yang rnam mkhyen yin pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi rnam pa skyed med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa rnams kyi rim bzhin ma nges pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang gzhi shes dang*/ 'phags lam don gcig mtshan gzhi ni 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag yin la/ lam shes dang*/ theg chen 'phags lam don gcig

mtshan gzhi ni byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa mtha' dag yin zhing*/ rnam mkhyen dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa don gcig go /mdor na/ rnam mkhyen yin na/ lam shes yin pas khyab/ lam shes yin na gzhi shes yin pas khyab/ gzhi shas yin na lam shes yin pas ma khyab/ lam shes yin na rnam mkhyen yin pas ma khyab pa shes par bya'o// blo gros gsar bu la mkho ba'i brda 'chad 'di ltar shes dgos so// (21) gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa ni/ kha cig na re/ mchod brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi rten gyi gang zag yin na byang sems yin pas khyab/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rten gyi gang zag yin na yang*/ byang sems yin pas khyab/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin dgos pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs nyams su len pa po'i nyan thos bsgom lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi rtogs rigs kyi rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi rtogs rigs nyams su len pa po'i rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su nyams su len pa po'i nyan thos slob pa yin pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs grub cing khyab pa yod de/ 'di nyid las/ tshig rkang dang pos byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa bstan te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs de bstan pas/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol ba rnams rtogs rigs dang nyams su blangs pas zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/

(22) gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems ma yin par thal/ theg dman gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs kyi rgyun phyi mar gyur pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug gi bdag rkyen byas te gdul bya la chos 'khor bskor ba po'i mchog gi sprul sku chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir// ma grub na der thal/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyis chos 'khor bskor pa po'i rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de de yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ de skad du 'di nyid las/ rtogs rigs de nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa mthar thug pa gang dang yang dag ldan pas ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa gsungs pa 'di 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ des na mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i nyan thos de nyan thos slob pa dang*/ de'i tshe tshig rkang gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i thub pa de mchog gi sprul sku yin cing*/ 'on kyang de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin pa dang*/ tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa'i bstan gyi gang zag sngar bshad pa de ltar yin pa la 'gal ba'i skyon med de/ sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos (23) bstan gyi nyan thos dang*/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi thub pa rnams rim bzhin byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ de de'i rgyud kyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa rgyud ldan min yang de dang de'i rtogs rigs kyi rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/

de skad du 'di nyid las/ bshad tshul 'di la rnam mkhyen dang gzhi shes kyi bstan gyi gang zag ni rtogs rigs kyi dbang du byas par 'chad dgos so zhes gsungs so// de las gzhan du smra ba rnams kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe rnam mkhyen dang gzhi shes kyi rten gyi gang zag rtogs rigs kyi dbang du byas nas 'chad dgos la/ lam shes kyi rten gyi gang zag rtogs rigs kyi dbang du byas nas 'chad mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bskal pa'i bar du btsal kyang mi rnyed do// de bzhin du mchod brjod mdo'i dgos pa la sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gang zag dang*/ de'i tshe tshig rkang gnyis pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin na yang*/ sangs rgyas yin pas ma khyab ste/ rim bzhin sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs nyams su len pa po'i nyan thos sgom lam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs nyams su len pa po'i byang sems bsgom lam pas ma nges so// des na sbyar tshul gnyis pa lta bu la bshad tshul 'di la lam shes dang*/ gzhi shes kyi rten gyi gang zag ni rtogs rigs kyi dbang du byas nas 'chad dgos (24) so// zhes pa gcig don gyi thob bo// gnad gyi don ni nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyan thos dang*/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyan thos don gcig de la dbye na don la sangs rgyas yin la nyan thos kyi tshul gzung ba/ don la byang sems yin la nyan thos kyi tshul gzung ba/ nyan thos rang rgyud pa dang gsum yod de/ dang po ni/ dge slong shā ri bu la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i nyan thos mtha' dag go /gnyis pa ni/ don la byang sems 'phags pa yin la rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi tshul bzung ba la sogs pa mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun rnams so// gsum pa ni/

mchog gi sprul sku'i dngos kyi 'khor du gyur pa'i nyan thos kyi rigs can slob pa dang*/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa dang*/ nyan thos mi slob pa mtha' dag go /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes la yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gsum yod do// de bzhin du tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems dang*/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems don gcig de la dbye na/ don la sangs rgyas yin la byang sems kyi tshul bzung ba dang*/ byang sems rang rgyud pa gnyis yod do//

(25) dang po ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i byang sems rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs sbyor mthong bsgom la gnas pa'i byang sems mchog gi sprul sku'i dngos kyi 'khor du gyur pa rnams so// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes la yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gnyis yod do// yang de bzhin du/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi thub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas don gcig de la dbye na/ don la byang sems yin yang*/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rang nyid kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ sa bcu pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// sems can yang dag sgrol ba la// 'jig rten na ni mnyam par nyid// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ston pa shākya thub pa lta bu'o// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen la yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gnyis yod do// kha cig skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin na/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin pas (26) khyab/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin na/ tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes yin pas khyab/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin na/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ ma dag sa la gnas pa'i byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi 'di ni nyan thos lam gyi dmigs pa'o// 'di ni nyan thos lam gyi rnam pa'o snyam pa'i mngon zhes can gyi blo chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshan 'dzin du gyur pa'i nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsod gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i mtshan 'dzin yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mtshan 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ma dag sa la gnas pa'i byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi 'di ni byang sems lam gyi dmigs pa'o snyam pa'i mngon zhen can gyi blo chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir byang sems kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gong ltar 'gre'o// 'dod na yang sngar bzhin no// gsum ba la/ sngar smos pa de'i rgyud kyi (27) 'di ni theg chen lam gyi dmigs pa'o// 'di ni rnam pa skye ba med pa'o snyam pa'i mngon zhen can gyi blo chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub pa dang*/ 'dod na/ 'gre/ des na tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig spyir tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig tshigs rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig pa yin zhing*/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*// theg dman gyi rtogs rigs don gcig de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang*// rang rgyal kyi rtogs rigs gnyis/

dang po dang gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs don gcig gnyis pa dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs don gcig yang lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen slob pa dang mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs mtha' dag la 'jog de bzhin du rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ (28) sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs yang don gcig pa yin te/ mdor/ thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad pa'i rtogs rigs rnams ni rtogs pa so so'i ldog cha la 'jog pa yin pas/ ldog cha 'gal ba'i gnad kyis rtogs rigs phan tshun so so yang sems can dang sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs gang du yang 'gal bar khas len la/ rtogs pa rnams ni 'gal bar khas mi len te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin na/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa gsum ka yin dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ dang po nyid nas rang rgyal lam du zhugs pa'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs pa gnyis ka yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gang zag gi bdag (29) med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs gnyis phan tshun gnyis 'gal ba yin no// 'dir kha cig mchod brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i tshe/

mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na/ byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs yin pas khyab zhes dang*/ kha cig byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin na/ mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pas khyab/ mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ sbyar tshul gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa gang rung yin na/ sbyar tshul gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa ma yin pas khyab pa zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la gcig du bral gyi rtags las gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de ltar sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gang zhig gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ 'grel bar/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas tshad mas gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med par yongs su shes pa zhes gsungs pa'i bstan don grub pa'i (30) phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin par thal/ sems so skye'i rgyud kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byang sems so skye'i gnas skabs su gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa sogs gsum po de phan tshun 'gal ba'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs ma yin par thal/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bdag med ma rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ theg chen slob lam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor mthong bsgom bzhi po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i skye byed kyi yum yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi slob lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ bdag med ma rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi slob lam yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir// mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mchod (31) brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i tshe tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin par thal/ mchod brjod mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba'i tshe mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i tshe tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ der gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong bsgom gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen gyis kyang ma nges te/ sgrub tshul rigs 'gre/ des na rang gi lugs ni/ mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtags rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig

mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gnyis pa dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig (32) des mtshon nas/ mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa don gcig gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa la'ang rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul gnyis pa'i tshe/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa don gcig gzhan gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre/ mchod brjod mdo'i gleng gzhi la sbyar ba'i tshe/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs don gcig de yin na/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pas khyab/ de'i tshe tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa don gcig de'i tshe tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa don gcig ste/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid tshul gsum pa can sangs rgyas la sogs pa bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za ba srid pa nyid do// zhes dang*/ 'di nyid las/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs gsum po des thog mar sangs rgyas bskyed nas sangs (33) rgyas kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs gsum po des bdag rkyen byas te chos 'khor bskor bas slar yang 'phags pa gzhan rnams bskyed pa gleng gzhi'i tshul du 'byung ba'i phyir/

zhes dgongs so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na mchod brjod kyi bshad tshul dang po 'di ni rdzing du chu sog pa dang*/ de yur ba nas 'dren pa sogs so nam las ka byed pa'i dpe dang mtshungs pa skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i mkhyen pas bsdus pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs kyi nyams len mtha' dag ston par byed pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ mchod brjod kyi tshig gi mkhyen gsum rdzing bcas nas/ dgongs 'grel ngag gi yur ba nas drangs te/ mngon rtogs brgyad kyi zhing la bcus pa yis/ zhes pa 'di byung*/ bshad tshul gnyis pa 'di ni so nam las ka byas pa las 'bras bu ston thog 'byung ba'i dper mtshungs par byang sems kyi nyams len de las byung ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen gsum ston par byed pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ rang don mkhyen gsum lo tog rab rgyas nas/ zhes pa 'di byung*/ bshad tshul gsum pa 'di ni/ lo tog de la sems can rang rang gi 'dod pa dang mthun par zas la longs spyod tshul tha dad pa'i dpe dang mtshungs par sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs des bdag rkyen byas te gdul bya nyan rang gi rigs can la chos 'khor (34) bskor bas rang gi bzhed don gyi zas theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs bskyed de/ 'bras bu nyon mongs nye bar zhi ba lhag bcas myang 'das dang*/ sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba lhag med myang 'das gnyis su 'gro bar byed/ sangs rgyas sa'i lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs des bdag rkyen byas te byang sems kyi rigs can la chos 'khor bskor bas rang gi bzhed don gyi zas/ byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs bskyed de sems can gyi don sgrub par byed de/ sangs rgyas sa'i rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs kyi bdag rkyen byas te gdul bya rigs can bzhir phye ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs can la chos 'khor bskor bas rang gi bzhed don gyi zas sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs bskyed de/

'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad pas/ mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par ston par byed pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa la/ gzhan don gleng gzhi'i tshul gyi rigs can gsum/ rang rang bzhed don zas la spyod pa yis// so nam tshul 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// mdzad pa'i 'khor lo yin par kho bos rtogs// zhes pa 'di byung*/ 'dir yang sngon gyi bgres po kha cig rgyan gyi mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na/ rdzing nang gi chus dpes mtshon pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas khyab/ rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel gyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na/ yur nang gi chus dper mtshon (35) pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas khyab/ bstan bcos lugs kyi dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na/ zhing nang gi chus dpes mtshon pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas khyab/ zhes gsungs pa rnams mi 'thad de/ gsum ka la rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na der thal/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ma grub na/ der thal/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mngon rtogs brgyad kyi dang por rnam mkhyen bstan pa 'di gdul bya 'bras bu la spro ba skye ba'i ched du bstan par gsungs pa de 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gsum ka la chos can/ rim bzhin de dang de ma yin par thal/ rang don mkhyen gsum lo tog rab rgyas nas zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lo tog gi dpes mtshon pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/
des na rgyan gyi mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad ni rdzing dang chos mtshungs/ tshigs bcad de bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i

(36) skabs kyi mkhyen pa rnams ni rdzing nang gi chu dang chos mtshungs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid zhes sogs dgongs 'grel gyi tshigs bcad gnyis pa ni yur ba dang chos mtshungs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lam zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi lam zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa de yur nang gi chu dang chos mtshungs/ rgyan gyi skabs brgyad lus dang bcas pa ni zhing dang chos mtshungs/ bstan bcos lus kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po ni/ zhing nang gi chu dang chos mtshungs pas/ de gsum ka sbyar tshul dang po'i gnas skabs 'ba' zhig yin no// de nas sbyar tshul gnyis pas bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i mkhyen gsum ni lo tog dang chos mtshungs/ sbyar tshul gsum pas bsdus pa'i 'phags bzhi so so'i mngon rtogs ni zas la longs spyod pa dang chos mtshungs pa yin/ zhes yongs 'dzin dam pa dbang phyug dpal bzang gsung ngo*// 'di las gzhan du smra ba rnams kyis kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa bskal par 'bad kyang ga la longs/ sngon bsags kyi rnam dpyod gcig dgos pa yin no// yang 'dir kha cig rgyan gyi mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum la rang sras nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i yum dang bzhi yod de/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de zhes gsungs pa'i tshig gi nus pas nyan thos (37) dang byang sems gnyis ka la'ang yum sbyar nas de gnyis dang tshig zin la bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yum dang gsum ka la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'dir nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas zhes pa 'og gi yum dang bsgrel rgyu ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi ni zhes pa'i yum de sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos su sbyor ba yin te/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba de zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

des na 'dir yum la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ yum sras kyi don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang sras 'phags pa'i skye byed dang de'i bzhed don sgrub byed gang rung du gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa de yum gyi mtshan nyid/ yang de gang rung du gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa de mchod yum gyi mtshan nyid yin no// mchod yum dang rgyan gyi mchod brjod kyi yul du gyur pa'i yum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yum rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi lam mtha' dag go /gnyis pa la/ skyed byed kyi yum dang bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sras 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i slob pa'i mkhyen pa'o// de la dbye na/ rang sras theg (38) dman 'phags pa/ byang sems 'phags pa/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa skyed byed kye yum dang gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin dang po la gzhi gang zag gi dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag gi skye med gang rung du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sras theg dman 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i slob pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de bzhin du gnyis pa lam la 'dzin pa chos kyi sogs dang*/ gsum pa rnam pa 'dzin pa chos kyi zhes sogs sngar ltar la/ theg dman gyi tshab tu byang sems sogs so sor sbyar ro// rigs gnas smos pas ni rang gi rgyun 'gag kha ma'i bdag med rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi tshogs sbyor mthong bsgom bzhi dang rang gi rgyun 'gag kha ma'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam rnams skyed byed kyi yum du sdud pa'i ched yin no// dbye ba de re re la yang de dang de'i rtogs bya bskyed med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis dang po ni/

theg pa che chung gi tshogs sbyor gyi lam la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ theg pa che chung gi mthong bsgom gyi lam la 'jog mi slob lam ni bzhed don sgrub byed tsam yin no// 'dir nyang stong bka' chen pas/ gzhi bzung ba chos kyi bdag gi skye med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas zhes sogs rang sras rang rgyal 'phags pa'i skyed byed kyi (39) yum gyi mtshan nyid du bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ gcig char ba'i rgyun zhugs kyi rtogs pa sngon song gi rang rgyal kyi rigs can sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal// mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ rang sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i skyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi rang rgyal gyi rigs can sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ skye byed kyi yum yin na/ slob lam yin pas khyab pa ni rje btsun mus rab 'byams pa bzhed do// bka' 'grel gyi dgongs 'grel nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ rnam mkhyen skad cig ma dang po ni skyed byed kyi yum ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la nyams len med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pas so// gnyis pa bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi 'phags pa'i bzhed don gyi gtso bo sgrub pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa'o// de la dbye na rang sras theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum sogs gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi gang zag gi dang bzung ba chos kyi bdag gi skye med gang rung du mngon (40) sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang sras theg dman 'phags pa 'bras bu nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa'o// mtshan gzhi ni theg dman gyi mthong bsgom mi slob lam gsum mo// 'di la kha cig

nyer zhi gnyis po thob zin pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ rang rgyud ldan gyi theg dman 'phags pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par byed pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyud ldan gyi theg dman 'phags pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid zin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyud ldan gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid zin pa'i phyir zhe na/ rigs gnas smos pas skyon med de/ de rang rgyud ldan gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par byed pa'i rigs gnas tsam las 'khrid par byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir mtshan nyid kyi zur du rigs gnas sbyar ba rnams ni yongs gcod kyi dgos pa can yin no// gong gi gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid ni lam 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag gi skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i 'jig rten gyi don sgrub par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ mtshan gzhi ni theg chen gyi mthong bsgom gnyis so// mchod yul gzhi shes sogs kyi rnam bzhag byed na/ 'di dang sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis la byed rigs kyis/ (41) theg dman gyi yum la de gsum gyi rnam bzhag mi thob ste/ mchod yum yin na/ theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ theg dman gyi mkhyen pa la rje btsun byams pa mgon pos bstod phyag ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i sgo nas rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa'o// mtshan gzhi ni sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa mtha' dag go /des na theg pa che chung gi mthong bsgom gyi lam rnams rang sras 'phags pa'i skyed byed kyi yum dang rang rgyud ldan gyi 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis ka yin pas/

spyir skyed byed dang bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis ka yin la/ rang sras 'phags pa'i skyed byed de'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis ni 'gal te/ de'i skyed byed kyi yum yin na/ de'i snga logs su byung bas khyab/ de'i bzhed don sgrub byed kye yum yin na/ de dang dus mnyam yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dir dogs pa 'di lta bu zhig 'byung ste/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de rang sras shākya thub pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ shākya thub pa gnyis la sras yum (42) gyi rnam bzhag yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de med par thal/ shākya thub pa de shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'i sras ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de de'i rjes su skyes pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de de dang dus mnyam yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ de dang de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gnyis la phan tshun yum sras kyi rnam bzhag med kyang*/ so sor yum sras su 'jog dgos te/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa ni yum dang*/ shākya thub pa sras yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ de yang shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yum yin te/ de shākya thub pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ shākya thub pa sras yin te/ de'i yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa'i sras yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa yin na/ yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa'i sras yin dgos pa'i phyir/ des na rang sras zhes pa skyed byed kyi yum gyi skabs su rang rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sras yin pas/ mkhyen pa de dang de'i sras mtshan nyid pa yin la/ bzhed don sgrub byed kyi skabs su mkhyen pa yum de dang rang sras 'phags pa dus mnyam pas/ de bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum de'i sras ma yin zhing*/

spyir rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i yum gyi sras yin pas/ rang sras shes pa zhag gam snyam du kho bo cag sems so// gzhan du na rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum mi (43) 'thad par 'gyur bas ha cang thal lo// 'dir tshig la khris na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sogs de dang de rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin la/ spyir byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum ma yin par khas len no/ des mtshon nas nyan rang dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum la yang shes par bya ste/ dper na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin zhes rang ldog la khris nas smra bar bya'o// gal te shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa lta bu sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin zer na/ de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang dus mnyam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi snga rol du sangs rgyas 'phags pa ma byung bar thal/ khyod sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang dus nyam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'i snga rol tu sangs rgyas 'phags pa 'byung bar thal/ de'i snga rol tu sangs rgyas 'phags pa byung ba'i phyir te/ de'i snga rol tu tshogs sog yul gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pa byung ba'i phyir te/ des 'tshang rgya ba'i snga rol tu sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong (44) sogs la tshogs bsags pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gyi saṃ mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas rgyun mtha' bar du yod la/ rang sras nyan thos 'phags pa dang*/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum ni/

nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi mthong lam nas mi slob pa'i gnas skabs theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i bar du yod par yum don rab gsal du bshad do// 'o na theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la theg dman gyi lam dang*/ theg chen gyi lam gnyis cig car du yod par 'gyur te/ de'i rgyud la theg dman gyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yod pas/ theg dman gyi lam yod pa ni gzhir bzhag de theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma yin pas/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems tsam dang ldan pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ dman lam sngon du ma song bar theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i dus su smon sems dang nges par ldan dgos kyang*/ theg dman gyi bslab pa la gnas pa'i gang zag theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i dus su smon sems dang mi ldan pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la smon sems nam skyes pa na sngar gyi bslab pa gnas gyur pa theg chen lam du zhugs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper brjod na/ nyan thos dge slong gi rgyud la smon sems nam skyes pa na/ dman sems dor nas (45) sngar gyi spong sems de nyid theg chen gyi bslab par gnas gyur pa yin no// 'di ni yum don rab gsal du legs par bshad do// yang rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i skyed byed kyi yum gyi sa mtshams ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas/ rgyun mtha'i snga rol du yod/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes ni de'i skyed byed kyi yum ma yin te/ des rang gi skad cig phyi logs de ma thag tu rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa bskyed par byed cing*/ byang sems 'phags pa bskyed par mi byed pa'i phyir/ yang theg dman du ltung nges kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ rang sras 'phags pa skyed byed kyi yum yin par thal/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa skyed par mi byed pa'i phyir/ de mi bskyed par nges pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman du ltung nges kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi chos yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir ma nges te/ de lta bu'i byang sems tshogs lam de re zhig theg dman du ltung nges yin kyang*/ mthar thug 'tshang rgya nges yin pas de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa des kyang mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i sa bon dang bag chags su 'thad pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyud kyi (46) mkhyen pa de theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yum sras kyi don ni/ yum mtshan nyid pa bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin zhing*/ yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa ni 'phags pa bzhi char la yod de/ 'phags pa yin na/ rang rgyud bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab las byung bas khyab pa'i phyir/ yab kyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' yin na/ rang rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed skyes pas khyab pa'i phyir/ des na yum ni rgyu'i ngos nas bzhag sras ni 'bras bu'i ngos nas bzhag cing*/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag gis sras dang yab kyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa'i sras gnyis ka yin pas khyab/ yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa'i sras dang*/ 'phags pa don gcig go /de la kha cig byang sems sbyor lam pa chos can/ 'phags pa yin par thal/ yum gyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa'i sras yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyu bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab las byung ba'i sras yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyu tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab las byung ba'i sras yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyu de'i gnas skabs kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sngon song gi sras yin pa'i phyir te/
'dir ma nges/ ma grub na/ der thal/

(47) rang rgyu de'i gnas skabs kyi nyams len mtha' dag sngon song gi sras yin pa'i phyir te/ sras gang zhig rang rgyu de'i gnas skabs kyi nyams len mtha' dag sngon song yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyu tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs mtha' dag rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems sbyor lam pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ chos de sngon song gi 'bras bu yin na/ chos de las byung ba'i ma khyab cing*/ chos de'i snga rol du byung ba yin na yang*/ chos de'i rgyu yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ dper na shākya thub pa'i snga rol du byung ba'i rang rgyal dang nyan thos rnams shākya thub pa'i rgyu ma yin pa sogs mtha' yas so// des na byang sems sbyor lam pa de rang gi snga rol du byung ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sngon song yin kyang*/ des bskyed pa dang de las 'khrungs par mi 'jog ste/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bskyed pa'i sras ni nges par 'phags pa la 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnad 'di ni rong ston smra ba'i seṅge'i bzhed pa yin cing 'jug pa bka' 'grel du yang gsal lo// de rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sngon song ni ma yin te/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir/ 'o na de rang rgyu tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sngon song yang ma yin par thal/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i tshogs (48) lam gyi gnas skabs kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir zhe na/ bar tshangs kyi rnam dbye dgos pas 'dir ma nges te/ dper na byangaṃ 'phags pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i sgrib pa med kyang*/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa yod pa dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' med kyang*/

don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa yod pa dang*/ rang gi gdul bya la chos dngos su ston pa'i rnam mkhyen med kyang*/ rang gi gdul bya la chos dngos su ston pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam mkhyen yod pa sogs bar tshangs kyi rigs mtha' yas so// mchod brjod bshad zin to// ༈ /gnyis pa dgongs 'grel ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum la phyag btsal nas shugs la mkhyen gsum gyi rgyan rtsom par dam bcas pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na rgyan de'i brjod bya gang zhe na/ rnam mkhyen thob byed kyi lam byang sems kyi rgyud kyi skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gang zag gi cha rkyen gyi sgo nas mngon rtogs brgyad du 'gyur ba de nyid rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo yin no zhes pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes pas bstan/ lam de yang ston pas sher phyin gyi mdo las bshad pa gang (49) yin pa de 'dir bshad par bya ba yin zhing*/ der theg pa gsum ka'i lam bshad kyi 'dir theg pa gzhan gyi myong ba ma yin pa theg chen gyi lam rim kho na 'chad do// ces pa ni/ ston pas 'di las zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ cha rkyen gyi mngon rtogs brgyad ni byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gcig nyid kyang gang zag gi cha rkyen gyi mngon rtogs brgyad char yin te/ de rang gi rten gyi gang zag byang sems sbyor lam pa 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen gsum yang yin/ de'i cha rkyen du gyur pa'i sbyor gzhi yang yin/ de'i cha rkyen du gyur pa'i 'bras bu chos sku yang yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir te/ de mkhyen gsum gyi gnas skabs su thos bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa yang yin/ sbyor gzhi'i gnas skabs su nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa yang yin/

chos sku'i skabs su 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa yang yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir te/ de chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ mdo don zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod bcu po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ de skad du/ 'di nyid las/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi skye med gsum rtogs pa'i rtogs pa gang zag gi cha rkyen gyi sgo nas mngon par rtogs pa brgyad du 'gyur pa de nyid ces dang*/ ci'i phyir sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i mdo don bsdus pa yin zhe na/ mkhyen gsum gyi skabs (50) su yang phar phyin bcu po 'di nyid thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i ldog pa nas bstan/ sbyor gzhi'i skabs su yang bcu po de nyid nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan/ chos sku'i skabs su yang bcu po de nyid 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa yin no// lugs 'di la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi lam zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ gang zag gi cha rkyen gyi mngon rtogs brgyad kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen nas de'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu chos sku'i bar dang*/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod rnams don gcig yin zhing*/ byang sems kyi gnas skabs kyi phar phyin bcu'i nyams len la 'dir bstan chos spyod bcur bzhed pa yin no// de ltar na mkhyen gsum gyi skabs su thos bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin na thos bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas ma khyab/ sbyor bzhi'i gnas skabs su nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas ma khyab/ chos sku'i skabs su 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas ma khyab ste/

gal te khyab na/ dang po la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi sbyin sogs kyi nyams len khyad par can chos can/ der (51) thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod bcu po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ mkhyen gsum gyi skabs su yang zhes sogs sngar drangs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir te/ yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi skyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ thos bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sbyor mthong bsgom gsum gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bdag med pa'i don la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems kyi tshogs lam phal pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir// ma grub na/ der thal/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod bcu po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ sbyor bzhi'i skabs su yang bcu po de nyid zhes sogs sngar drangs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ sngar ltar rigs 'gre/ rtsa ba 'dod na/ de chos can/ nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ thog bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan (52) pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de de yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ bdag med pa'i don thos bsam gtso bor byed pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa yod pa'i phyir te/ len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/

theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir ma grub na/ der thal/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ chos sku'i skabs su bcu po de nyid zhes sogs sngar drangs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ bsgom pa nyams len gyi bsdus pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can dang*/ de'i sbyor lam dang*/ de'i mthong lam dang*/ de'i bsgom lam dang bzhi po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du mkhyen gsum gyi skabs su spyi'i sgrub pa yin na spyi'i sgrub pa yin pas ma khyab/ sbyor bzhi'i skabs su bye brag gi sgrub pa yin na/ bye brag gi sgrub pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ dang po la bshad ma thag pa'i skyon dang po de dang*/ gnyis pa la/ skyon gnyis pa de 'phen par bya zhing*/ sgrub tshul sngar ltar rigs 'gre'o// de skad du 'di nyid las/ de ltar (53) byas nas phar phyin phyi ma bzhi shes rab kyi phar phyin du 'dus pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i phar phyin drug po de la sgrub pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas/ de nyid mkhyen gsum gyi skabs su bstan pa la spyi'i sgrub pa dang*/ sbyor bzhi'i skabs su bstan pa la bye brag gi sgrub pa zhes pa'i gzhung dang yang sbyor ba yin no zhes gsungs so// des na spyi'i sgrub pa dang thos bsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ bdag med pa'i don la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems tshogs lam lta bu/ bye brag gi sgrub pa dang nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can nas/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar ro// mdor na/

sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum brjod bya dngos brgyad don bdun cu rnams mngon rtogs rgyan gyi brjod bya yin zhing*/ de'i bshad bya de'i brjod bya de'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du de'i ched du bya ba de'i dgos pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgyan la brten nas so so'i skye bos mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa de yin te/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang rgyan la brten nas/ mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa de tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs su nyams su blangs pas/ (54) sa dang po thob pa'i yon tan khyad par can te rgyan gyi nying dgos kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni rgyan la brten nas chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pas don mngon sum du mthong ba'i mkhyen pa de yin te/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di la yang*/ gnas skabs kyi nying dgos dang*/ mthar thug gi nying dgos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyan la brten nas thob pa'i byang 'phags kyi yon tan mtha' dag go /gnyis pa ni/ rgyan la brten nas thob pa'i 'bras bu chos sku rnams so// de bzhin du rgyan gyi brjod bya dgos pa nyid dgos gsum/ thabs thabs byung gi tshul gyi 'brel ba de/ rgyan gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'brel pa yin zhing*/ 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyi shugs la ston/ gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ rgyas pa la dad pa brgyad du phye ba/ bar pa la dad pa drug tu bstan pa/ bsdus pa la dad pa gsum du bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po bsdus don lus rnam bzhag dang*/ tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa la 'phros nas/

sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum 'bras bu sher phyin thob byed kyi lam mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad/ sangs rgyas kyi (55) skyed byed yum slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i sher phyin gang zag gi cha rkyen mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad ces pa ni// shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// zhes pas bstan/ gzhung sher phyin brjod bya mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad ces pa'ang tshig rkang gnyis po de'i shugs la bstan to// de ltar sher phyin la gsum las/ 'bras bu sher phyin dang*/ sher phyin mtshan nyid pa dang*/ 'bras yum dang*/ rnam mkhyen rnams don gcig lam sher phyin dang*/ slobaṃ lamaṃ gyisaṃ baṃsdus pa'i sher phyin dang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam sher phyin dang*/ mchod brjod kyi bshad tshul dang po'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa rnams don gcig ste/ 'di nyid las/ bshad tshul dang pos bsdus pa'i lam sher phyin ni/ gang zag gi cha rkyen mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad/ ces gsungs pas so// 'on kyang shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i lam sher phyin ni/ theg chen gyi mthong sgom gang rung dang don gcig ste/ slob dpon gyi 'grel chen las/ mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lam la yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni btags pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phal cher 'di tsam gyi 'khrul gzhi byas nas lam (56) sher phyin yin na/ byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs yin pas khyab gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i rtogs pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ lam sher phyin dang 'bras bu sher phyin gang rung gang zhig 'bras bu sher phyin ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sher phyin ma yin pa'i phyir te/

yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i thad kyi nyir snang du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sher phyin yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ nyir snang du mchod brjod kyi skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ni/ lus kyi skabs su dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad par gsungs shing*/ zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na der thal// yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yum dang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sher phyin don gcig pa ni/ bstan bcos rtsa 'grel thams cad kyi dgongs par gnas so// gzhung sher phyin ni yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lta bu brjod byed tshig gi sher phyin rnams te/ sher phyin dang sher phyin thob pa'i thabs brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pas/ sher phyin gyi ming gi btags pa tsam mo// snying po don gyi (57) sher phyin ni/ sher phyin gyi don dang ldan pa'i gnas lugs don dam bden pa rnams so// dngos po brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin ni// rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid// ces sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ de yang thob bya'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen/ de thob byed kyi rgyu lam shes/ de'i blang dor bya ba'i yan lag tu gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye shes pa'i gzhi shes rnams ni yum mkhyen pa gsum ste/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas/ rnam pa kun mkhyen 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir// lam gsum shes pa'i tshul la legs sbyangs te// gzhi kun shes pa nyid du rab phye nas// lam dang lam min sgro 'dogs chod par shog ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i don rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum du bsdus nas bsgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang*/

bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa rtse mor sbyor ba dang*/ go rims su bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cig char du bsgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi ni nyams len gyi sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ rtogs pa rab kyi mthar phyin thob nas kyang*// slar yang de dag go rim ji bzhin du/ cig 'char bsgom pa'i nyams len mthar phyin shog ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar sbyor bzhis nyams su

(58) blangs pa las/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs sku dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs sna tshogs sems can gyi don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku dang*/ phrin las nyer bdun gyis bsdus pa'i gzhan don mdzad pa phrin las dang bzhi ni 'bras bu chos sku yin te/ zag med yon tan kun ldan rang bzhin sku// yid 'ong mtshan dpe rab mdzes longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs gdul bya'i re skong sprul pa'i sku// mngon du gyur nas phrin las dbang gyur shog /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ brgyad po de dag cung zad phye ste bshad na/ don bdun cur gyur te/ de yang rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu ni/ theg chen sems bskyed dang*/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag dang*/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rigs dang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba dang*/ go sgrub dang*/ 'jug sgrub dang*// tshogs sgrub dang*/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin no zhes pa ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od 'dom gang bas lha rnams kyi rnam smin gyi 'od mog mog por byed pa la sogs (59) pa'i yan lag dang*/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang*/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang*/ 'di phyi'i phan yon dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dang*/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ mos pa sgom lam dang*/ mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon bstod bskur bsngags gsum dang*/ bsngo ba bsgom lam dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba bsgom lam dang*/ sgrub pa bsgom lam dang*/ rnam dag bsgom lam rnams yin no zhes pa ni/

mog mog por byed la sogs dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis bstan/ gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu ni/ srid mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes dang*/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang*/ gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po gzhi shes dang*/ rgyu sbyor ba dang*/ rgyu sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid dang*/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam rnams yin no// zhes pa ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan// rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig ni/ theg chen gyi bsgom bya rnam pa dang*/ rnam pa bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan dang*/ theg chen sbyor ba la bar du gcod byed kyi skyon dang*/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed sgrub dang las sgrub gang rung gis (60) bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun khyad par can dang*/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dang*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba rnams yin no zhes pa ni/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad ni/ rtags kyi rtse sbyor dang*/ rnam 'phel gyi rtse sbyor dang*/ brten pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ mthong lam rtse sbyor dang*/ bsgom lam rtse sbyor dang*/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ gsal bya log sgrub rnams yin no// zhes pa ni/ de'i rtags dang rnam 'phel dang zhes pa nas rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba tshul khrims kyi=

bzod pa'i= brtson 'grus kyi= bsam gtan gyi= shes rab kyi= sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i= chos rjes su= dge 'dun rjes su= tshul khrims rjes su= gtong ba rjes su= lha rjes su= dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba rnams yin no// zhes pa ni/ mthar gyis pa rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes pas bstan/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi (61) chos bzhi ni/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i= mtshan nyid med pa'i= gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams yin no zhes pa ni/ skad cig ma zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi ni/ ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku dang*/ mdzad pa phrin las rnams yin no// zhes pa ni/ ngo bo nyid longs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ mtshon tshul ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po des rnam mkhyen yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i tshul dang*// rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i tshul gyis mtshon zhing*/ mtshon byed kyi chos gzhan rnams kyis ni lam shes pa la sogs pa phal cher rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon zhing*/ rgyu 'bras bu mtshon pa'i tshul sogs kyang cung zad yod do// dngos po brgyad kyi dang por rnam mkhyen ston pa ni 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du yin zhing*/ don bdun cu'i dang por theg chen sems bskyed ston pa ni/ sems bskyed theg chen gyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin par shes pa'i ched du yin no// kha cig rnam kun mkhyen nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen yin na// rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab/ lam shes nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes yin na/ lam shes yin pas khyab/ de nas thams cad shes (62) pa nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin na/ gzhi shes yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/

dang po la rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir te/ mchod brjod bstan bcos lus kyi nyams len la sbyar ba'i tshe/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ skabs dang po gsum gyi mkhyen gsum dang*/ mchod brjod kyi skabs kyi mkhyen gsum gnad gcig par bzhed nas/ zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ der gyur pa'i byang sems kyi tshogs sbyor gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyis// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// ces pa'i dngos (63) bstan gyi lam shes yin pa'i phyir te/ mchod brjod kyi sbyar tshul dang po'i tshe tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab sgrub dang*/ rtags sgrub gong gi rigs 'gre/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ der thal/

de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub tshul gong gi rigs 'gre/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyi/ des na skabs dang po'i dngos bstan tsam gyi rnam mkhyen dang*/ skabs brgyad pa'i go rim la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam mkhyen dang*/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i rnam mkhyen rnams don gcig skabs dang po'i dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen dang*/ thos bsam gyi yul du gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen dang*/ rnam pa skye med rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa rnams don gcig ste/ 'di nyid las/ des na skabs dang por (64) bstan pa'i rnam mkhyen ni skabs brgyad kyi go rim la 'jug pa'i tshe chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i rnam mkhyen la 'jug ste/ zhes dang*/ thos bsam gyi gtan la dbab pa'i yul du bzhag pa'i tshe na/ chos bcu po skye med du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa la 'jug go /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes la yang sngar bshad pa ltar byang sems kyi so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gnyis yod cing*/ de re re la yang nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa dang*/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa dang*/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa gsum ka yod do// 'on kyang skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i lam shes yin na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab ste/ skabs gnyis pa'i skabs don ni/
