bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes pa'i bar gyi bstan don la 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du skabs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes la yang byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gnyis ka yod cing*/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems so skye'i mkhyen pa la/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs kyis khyab/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang (65) 'phags kyi mkhyen pa la/ theg pa gsum ka'i rtogs rigs yod do// 'on kyang gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes/ zhes gsungs pa 'di la 'chad tshul gcig yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i nang tshan gyi gzhung tshig de dang de'i bstan bya'i gtso bo yin na/ skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo yin pas khyab bo// gzhung lugs kun la skabs don gyi rnam dbye gces so// gzhan du na/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ theg dman gyi mkhyen pa'i gzhi mthun yang yod par 'gyur te/ rnam dag gi skabs su nyan rang gi mkhyen pa mtshan nyid pa dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ skabs dang po gsum du mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i don de nyid bsdus nas sgom pa'i sbyor ba la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ces pa'i tha snyad 'jog cing*/ 'on kyang rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin na/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin pas khyab ste/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ bsgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i (66) nyams skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi byang sems kyi rgyud kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/

bdag med rtogs pa gang zhig theg chen gyi sbyor mthong bsgom gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ lam shes kyi rnam pa bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ gzhi skye med tsam rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa gang zhig byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir// khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su rtogs rigs gsum po tha dad du yod de/ rtogs pa sel 'jug yin pas gang zag gi bdag med kyi rnam pa can du skyes pa'i tshe/ chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa can du skyes pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ skabs bzhi pa'i thad kyi bka' 'grel du rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i don yang rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa yin pas zhes gsungs pa ni sa thob pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin na rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin pas khyab zhes khas (67) blang pas chog la/ so skye'i skabs su de la khyab mtha' mi 'dzin pas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgra don tsam gyi dbang du mdzad pa yin no// des na sbyor ba phyi ma gsum yang 'di'i nang tshan yin te/ rtse sbyor yin na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin pas khyab/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin na/ rtse sbyor yin pas khyab/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin na yang*/ rtse sbyor yin pas khyab bo// kha cig skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin na mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/

chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rims su bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i sbyor bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa gcig char du bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir zhe na 'dir dgos gnas shig yod pa 'og tu 'god do// de ltar na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul lnga la mkhas pa'i tshogs lam khyad par can nas/ rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ rtse sbyor ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod thob ma thag pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni/ drod skad cig ma gnyis pa nas rgyun mtha'i (68) bar na yod/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni rgyun mtha' kho nar yod do// kha cig bka' 'grel gyi dgongs pa la mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sa dang po nas yod bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ bka' 'grel las phar phyin drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sa dang po nas yod par bshad nas/ spyir mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i sa mtshams sa dang po nas 'jog par gsung ba mi snang bas so// dngos po brgyad po 'bras bu chos sku ni sbyor bzhi'i sgom pa'i rnam smin yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang*/ de'i brgyud kyi yon tan mtha' dag go /bsdus don bstan zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad la/ rnam mkhyen rgyas par bshad pa sogs brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen rgyas bshad la yang don bcu yod pa las/ dang po sems bskyed la gnyis te/ gzhung gis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul dang*/ dka' ba'i gnad la dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes pa 'phros nas/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhe na/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces pas bstan/

mtshan nyid ston pa'i skabs kyi sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa byang chub dang*/ gzhan don de ni/ sher mdo ji lta ba bzhin du 'dir yang bsdus pa dang*/ rgyas par gnyis kyi sgo nas brjod par bya'o// zhes pa ni/ de dang de ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/

(69) tshul ji ltar na/ sa lta bu'i skabs su byang chub dang*/ gzhan don gnyis mdor bsdus nas bstan/ gser/ zla ba/ me lta bu gsum gyis byang chub rgyas par bshad/ gter lta bu man chad kyis gzhan don rgyas par bshad pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de yang sa gser zhes pa nas rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de nas sems bskyed pa ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed dang*/ de dang de ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed dang*/ de yang sa zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed rnams yin khyab mnyam du 'dod dgos so// 'o na 'grel pa don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni/ chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po nyid kyis las dang po pa'i sas bsdus so// zhes pa lta bu'i sems bskyed tshogs lam chung ngus bsdus par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni ma mtha' ngos 'dzin pa yin pas skyon med de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed de ma mtha' theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ ya mtha' sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ de bzhin du gser lta bu dang*/ zla ba lta bu'i sems bskyed gnyis kyang rim bzhin mtha' tshogs lam 'bring po dang chen po nas/ ya mtha' sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ me lta bu'i sems bskyed ni/ ma mtha' theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas/ ya mtha' sangs rgyas (70) kyi sa'i bar na yod pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sems bskyed dang*/ me lta bu'i sems bskyed don gcig sa dang po thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sems bskyed dang*/ gter lta bu'i= sa gnyis pa thob pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ rin po che'i 'byung khung lta bu'i= sa gsum pa thob pa'i= rgya mtsho lta bu'i= sa bzhi pa thob pa'i= rdo rje lta bu'i= sa lnga pa thob pa'i= ri rab lta bu'i= sa drug pa thob pa'i= sman lta bu'i= sa bdun pa thob pa'i=

dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu'i= sa brgyad pa thob pa'i= yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i= sa dgu pa thob pa'i= nyi ma lta bu'i= sa bcu pa thob pa'i= glu dbyangs lta bu'i= sa brgyad pa'i khyad par lam thob pa'i sems bskyed dang*// rgyal po lta bu dang*/ bang mdzod lta bu dang*/ lam po che lta bu dang*/ gzhon pa lta bu dang*/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams don gcig sa bcu pa'i khyed par las thob pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ sgra snyan lta bu'i= chu bo'i rgyun lta bu'i= sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams don gcig ste/ don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni/ zhe sogs sngar drangs pa de'i rjes su de'i 'og tu gcig ni sbyor ba'i lam gyi bsdus so// de'i 'og tu bcu ni rab tu dga' ba la sogs pas bcus bsdus te/ mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam gyi spyod yul can yin no// de'i 'og tu lnga ni khyad (71) par lam gyis bsdus so// de 'og tu sems bskyed pa gsum ni/ sbyor ba dang dngos dang mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas sas bsdus te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du don gsal las/ 'dun pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa ni/ zhes pa'i bar nyer gnyis gsungs pa dang*/ yang don gsal las/ chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po dang*/ byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos mtha' dag rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pa dang*/ sems thams cad tshim par byed pa dang*/ zhes sogs nyer gnyis gsungs pa rnams kyang sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs nyer gnyis dang*/ thad sor thad sor don gcig tu shes par bya'o// 'dir nyer gnyis gsungs pa ni sher phyin gyi mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te yin la/ yang blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te mdo sde rgyan las kyang nyer gnyis su gsungs te/

bskyed pa sa dang mtshungs pa ste// gzhan ni bzang po'i gser dang 'dra// zla ba yar gyi tshes pa bzhin// gzhan ni me dang 'dra zhes bya// gzhan ne gter chen bzhin shes bya// gzhan ni rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin// rgya mtsho 'dra bar shes bya gzhan// rdo rje dang 'dra ri rab 'dra// sman gyi rgyal po 'dra ba ste// (72) gzhan ni mdza' chen 'dra zhes bya// yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba dang*// gzhan ni nyi ma 'dra zhes bya// gzhan ni dri zā dbyangs snyan bzhin// gzhan ni rgyal po 'dra zhes bya// de bzhin gzhan ni mdzod lta bu// lam po che dang 'dra zhes bya// theg pa 'dra ba shes bya ste// sems bskyed bkod ma 'dra ba yin// kun dga'i sgra dang 'dra ba ste// klung chen rgyun dang 'dra ba'o// rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa// sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyan phan tshun gyi sa lta bu sogs kyang don gcig tu shes par bya ste/ de yang sa zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed dang*/ bskyed pa sa dang mtshungs pa ste// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed don gcig pa sogs rim pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// 'o na sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa ste// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin par thal/ sprin rnams kyi zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ tshig rkang de'i dbur rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa// zhes gsungs pa la go don gcig yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir ma nges te/ bskyed pa sa dang mtshungs pa ste/ zhes sogs kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed (73) nyer gnyis po gang rung yin na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pas khyab pas na/

rgyal sras rnams kyi zhes sogs gsungs pa yin la/ rgyan gnyis kyi dngos bstan gyi nyer gnyis la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed gnyis ka yod pa ni gnad don yinapas so// de skad du 'di nyid las/ byang sems kyi rgyud la de gsum med pa ni ma yin te/ shes phyin gyi mdo dang*/ mdo sde rgyan du sems bskyed nyer gnyis pa thams cad byang sems kyi rgyud la bzhag pa'i phyir dang*/ sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed ni/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la 'jog pa skabs kyi don yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ zhes pa'i skabs kyi sems bskyed la smon 'jug gnyis su bshad nas/ de nyid dpe'i sgo nas nyer gnyis su byas nas ma mtha'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas bzhag pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang rgyan gnyis dang shes phyin gyi mdo'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed la sbyor shes dgos so// gnyis pa dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa/ mtshan gzhi sems sems byung gang yin dpyad/ smon 'jug gnyis 'gal mi 'gal dpyad/ de dang don dam sems bskyed kyi gzhi mthun yod med dpyad pa dang gsum las/ dang po (74) ni/ 'phags seng gnyis kyi 'grel pa rnams las/ sems bskyed pa zhes pa'i sems de rnam shes tshogs drug gi nang tshan du gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes yin par bzhed pas gtso bo sems su bzhed la/ gzhung 'dir yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems byung ba// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis/ yon tan gnyis sam gsum la dmigs pa'i sems dpa' ni sems bskyed po zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan gzhir sems byung smos par mdzad do// gnad kyi don ni/ byang chub kyi mchog tu bskyed par bya rgyu'i sems ni gtso sems yin pas/

'phags seng gnyis kyi 'di ltar du bshad la/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa byang chub kyi mchog tu bskyed cing smon pa na/ de'i gnas skabs na yod pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ sems pa dang*/ dad pa la sogs pa dge ba'i sems byung kun byang sems bskyed du 'gro bas/ mtshan gzhir sems sems byung gnyis char yod do// de bzhin du bslab pa dang sdom pa rnams la gtso sems gtso che yang de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung rnams kyang de dang der 'gyur bas na/ bslab pa dang*/ sdom pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro dang sbyor ba dang*/ nyams len sgrub pa la sogs pa kun la mtshan gzhi sems sems byung (75) gnyis char yod do// bslab pa gtso sems gtso che ste/ rang gi sems yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs las bsrung ba la bslab pa srung bar 'jog pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ bslab pa srung bar 'dod pa yis// rang tu sgrims nas sems bsrung ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sdom pa la yang gtso sems gtso che ste/ sngags sdom gyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs khyad par can bzhag cing*/ yid ni gtso sems yin pas so// yang don dam pa'i chos mngon pa la shes rab gtso che ba dang*/ snyoms 'jug la ting nge 'dzin gtso che ba sogs sems byung gtso bor gyur pa yang yod do// sems bskyed la de ltar bshad pa ni 'phags seng gi lugs bzhin yin la/ rang lugs kun mkhyen bla ma chen po'i bzhed pa ni/ sems bskyed sogs la sems byung gtso che ba yin no// 'dir kha cig sems bskyed pa ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis dngos bstan gyis sems bskyed yin na/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid ni rnam pa gnyis so zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pas khyab/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la/ sems ni rnam par shes pa ste// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin na/

rnam par shes pa yin pas khyab/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems byung ba// (76) zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin na/ sems byung yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi skyes bu'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ smon 'jug gang rung gi sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ smon 'jug gang rung gi sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam du gyur pa'i sems byung mdun pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ sems bskyed pa ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ gtso sems yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal// sems byung yin pa'i phyir te/ gsum pa la/ theg (77) chen gyi mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ yon tan gnyis sam gsum la dmigs pa'i sems pa ni sems bskyed pa'o zhes pa'i bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che// don che ba dang 'byung ba che// byang chub sems dpa'i sems pa ste// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/

sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la// zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de ni zhes pa la bsnyag mtshams gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ ma dag sa bdun gang rung la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems sa dang po pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ sems byung ma yin par thal/ gtso sems ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam par shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sems dang yid dang rnam shes rnams don gcig ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pas spyir smon pa la smon pa'i sems/ smon pa sems bskyed (78) pa/ smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang gsum/ 'jug pa la yang 'jug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa sems bskyed pa/ 'jug pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang gsum du mdzad nas// smon 'jug gnyis kyi khyad par ni sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa dang*// sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du lam la slob par 'dod pa yin pas blo gnyis po de rgyud la skyes nas sdom pas ma zin pa'i tshe na smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems dang*/ sdom pas zin pa'i tshe na smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ de man chad du nyams su len pa thams cad smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ 'jug pa mi nyams par srung ba yin no// zhes bzhed pas na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed mi 'gal te/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa la sdom pas zin pa'i sems bskyed rgyud la skyes dgos shing*/ de skyes pa'i tshe 'gro ba'i bya bas zin pa'i sems bskyed skyes pas na lam du zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// des na smon pa sems bskyed thams cad kyang 'jug pa sems bskyed yin te/

de thams cad kyang theg chen lam zhugs kyi rgyud kyi slob pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa sems bskyed thams cad kyi smon pa sems bskyed yin te/ de thams cad sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed yin pa gang zhig de dang der mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed thams (79) cad don gnyer 'gro 'dod kyi dpes mtshon pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ don gnyer 'gro ba'i bya ba'i dpes mtshon pa'i sems bskyed ni 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pas/ theg chen lam zhugs kyi rgyud kyi slob pa'i sems bskyed thams cad 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i shes byed de yin no// de skad du spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi// bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di nyid kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa yin no// 'dir kha cig don gnyer 'gro 'dod kyi dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin na/ 'gro bar 'dod dang zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi 'gro 'dod kyi dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas khyab/ byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang chub kyi sems yin na/ byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems yin pas khyab/ ces dang*/ yang kha cig don gnyer 'gro 'dod kyi dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin na/ don gnyer 'gro ba'i bya bas zin pas dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas khyab ste/ 'jig rten gyi 'gro 'dod kyi blo dang 'gro bzhin pa'i bya ba gnyis tha dad du 'gal

(80) ba'i phyir zhe na mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i so skye'i rgyud kyi smon pa'i sems tsam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir te/ de thob 'dod kyi smon pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir te/ de thob 'dod kyi smon sems tsam yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na rtsod gzhi de de yin par thal/ rtsod gzhi de yod pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyid las/ theg chen gyi lam du 'jug kha ma'i dus su smon 'jug gi sems tsam yod la/ de'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa skyes pa dang*/ theg chen lam du zhugs pa dus mnyam zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la yang rtsod gzhi de ka chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ bsod nams rgyun chags su mi 'byung ba'i smon sems yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de smon sems tsam yin par thal/ smon sems tsam yod pa'i phyir te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ smon pa'i sems smon pa sems bskyed pa zhes sogs gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phan yon du ma dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ (81) khyab ste/ sems de zhes pa la bsnyeg mtshams gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen sems bskyed ma yin pa'i phyir te/ smon sems tsam dang 'jug sems tsam gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi byang sems sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i smon pa sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'gro bar 'dod dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'gro 'dod kyi dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir te/

byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir te/ smon pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de smon pa sems bskyed yin pa thal/ rtsod gzhi de yod pa'i phyir/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi smon 'jug gi sems bskyed thams cad byang sdom yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi de thams cad mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i spong sems dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ sa paṇa gyi sems bskyed chen mo las/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed la mi mthun phyogs kyi spong ba'i spong ba'i spong sems yod na/ gnyis pa'ang sdom par 'gyur te/ sdom pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ don gnyer 'gro ba'i bya bas (82) zin pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin par thal/ 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'jug sems yin pa'i phyir te/ bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ji ltar 'jug pa'i zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi 'jug tu/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams// mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa// de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ rgyun mi chad pa dum zhig nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir// gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi dpe 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de gnyis 'gal bar sgrub pa ni ha cang thal te/ 'o na sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang*/

zla ba lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs kyang 'gal bar thal/ sa dang zla ba 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gcig nyid brgya byin sogs dpe dgu'i sgo nas ston pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ dpe brgya byin dang*/ rnga dang*/ sprin la sogs pa 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dag so so'i dpes bstan (83) pa'i don yang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ yang 'dir brtog dpyod zhugs pa kha cig dbu ma pa'i lugs la smon 'jug gi sems bskyed stabs gcig tu len pas smon 'jug mi 'gal bar 'thad kyang*/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la smon 'jug cho ga tha dad pas snga phyi rim can du len pas smon 'jug don gcig pa la gnod de/ de yang*/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi 'jug pa sems bskyed len pa'i snga rol tu sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas smon pa sems bskyed blangs ma thag pa'i sems bskyed chos can/ 'jug pa sems bskyed yin par thal/ smon pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ 'dod na/ de chos can 'jug pa sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi snga rol tu blangs pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi snga rol tu blangs pa'i smon pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi snga rol tu smon pa sems bskyed len pa yod pa'i phyir te/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la de ltar yod pa gang zhig sems tsam pa'i lugs la de ltar yod pa de theg chen gyi lugs srol tshad ldan gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ kho bo (84) ni de gnyis gang rung gcig skyes pa na/ gcig shos kyang nges par skyes pas na/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la yang de gnyis rim can du blangs pa med cing*/ rim can du skyes pa yang med pas/

'dir rtags dang po ma grub zer ba las 'os med do// 'on kyang sems tsam lugs kyi smon 'jug rim can du len pa dang skyes pa yod cing*/ spyir smon 'jug rim can du len pa dang skyes pa med do// des na sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas sems tsam lugs kyi smon 'jug rim can du len pa yod cing*/ de yod pas spyir de ltar yod par mi 'gyur te/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas smon pa sems bskyed blangs ma thag pa'i sems bskyed de sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug pa sems bskyed ma yin kyang*/ spyir 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i byang sems kyi bslab pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la kho na re/ de chos can/ sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug pa sems bskyed du thal/ sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas thob pa gang zhig 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir ma nges te/ 'o na nyan thos lugs sogs kyi cho ga la brten nas sdom gsum rim can du blangs pa'i dge slong (85) rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi dge slong gi sdom pa chos can/ nyan thos kyi cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i sngags sdom yin par thal/ nyan thogs lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas thob pa gang zhig sngags sdom yin 'i phyir/ khyab pa stobs mtshungs so// mdor na lugs mchog 'di la theg chen sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa lam ma zhugs na med cing*// theg chen lam zhugs kho na nas yod de/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes pa'i skabs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed thams cad smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis su bsdus shing*/ gnyis po de nyid dpe'i sgo nas nyer gnyis su byas pa'i ma mtha'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas bzhag pa'i phyir te/

de la dang po gsum ni chung ngu dang zhes sogs sngar drangs pa de'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ mkhas pa phal cher smon 'jug gang rung gi sems bskyed yin na/ kun rdzob sems bskyed yin pas khyab gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid ni rnam pa gnyis so zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ smon 'jug gang rung gi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir zhes pa'i (86) dngos bstan gyi byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de'i dngos bstan gyi byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed thams cad smon 'jug gnyis po gang rung du 'dus dgos pa de/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo nyid ni rnam pa gnyis so zhes pa'i bstan don yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dud na/ de chos can/ kun rdzob sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ don dam sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir// yang de chos can/ smon 'jug gang rung gi sems bskyed yin par thal/ 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa'i nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ de'i dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ de'i sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'ur/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gsum po de 'jug pa sems bskyed dbye bar gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims yin pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ des na byang sems 'phags pa mnyam bzhag pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed thams cad smon pa sems bskyed dang*/

'jug pa sems bskyed dang*/ don dam sems bskyed gsum ka yin te/ (87) de thams cad theg chen lam zhugs kyi rgyud kyi gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi byang chub kyi ched du lam sgrub pa'i sems dpa' mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro// des mtshon nas byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed thams cad dang*/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed thams cad smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed gsum ka yin no// sa dang po'i khyad par lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin seṅge rnam bsgyings dang*/ thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug sogs ni ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa yin pas/ mnyam bzhag gi ming gis btags pa yod kyang*/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su 'byung bas kun rdzob sems bskyed yin no// 'khrul gzhi 'di bsal ba'i phyir du 'di nyid las/ chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag 'i sems bskyed thams cad ces bshad do// mdor bsdu na/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba dang*/ byang sems kyi sdom pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba gang zhig mi mthun phyogs spong pa'i sems dpa' (88) mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa mngon gyur dang dbang ldan gang rung rgyun chags pa'o// sgrub pa khyad par ba smos pa'i dgos pa ni rnam bcad la theg dman gyi sgrub pa rnams bcad nas yongs gcod la theg chen gyi sgrub pa rnams sdud pa'i ched yin te/ dbu ma nges don rab gsal las/ mthar thug theg pa gcig ba'i lugs la/ theg pa gsum gyi sgrub pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa yin mod kyi/

theg pa 'og ma gnyis kyi sgrub pa las dmigs pa sogs gsum gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ni theg chen gyi sgrub pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnad 'di ma rtogs par nyang stod ka chen pas/ byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ nyan thos kyi byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba nyan thos kyi sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ rang rgyal gyi sems bskyed dang*/ theg chen gyi sems bskyed la yang de dang de'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba mtshan nyid du 'jog par mdzad pa dang*/ kha cig khyad par smos pa ni/ rnam mkhyen sdud pa'i chen yin pas/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba yin zhing*/ de'i sgrub pa ma yin zhes gsungs pa rnams ni bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa ma yin no// rang gi lugs ni theg pa gsum gyi sgrub pa thams cad rdzogs (89) pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa yin no// mthar thug theg pa gcig pa pa'i lugs la lam thams cad sangs rgyas kyi lam dang rigs thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir ro// theg pa 'og pa gnyis kyi sgrub pa ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa tsam dang*/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa ni de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba zhes gsungs shing*/ rnam mkhyen ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba ma zad de'i sgrub pa yang yin te/ sa paṇa gyi sems bskyed chen mo'i cho gar/ sgrub pa'i sgra sgrub par byed pa dang*/ bsgrubs zin pa gnyis ka la 'jug pas sangs rgyas kyis lam khyab par thal ba'i skyon med par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na skyon 'di spong ba don med par 'gyur ro// nyan rang gi byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba ni gzhung lugs tshad ldan las bshad tshod med do// byang sdom gyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du dbang ldan rgyun chags pa sbyor ba ni/

kha cig zhe sdang drag po mngon gyur du ldan pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la byang sdom med par thal/ de'i rgyud la mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i sems dpa' mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa med pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la gzhan la gnod sems drag po mngon gyur du yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir ma nges te/ de'i rgyud la gzhan la gnod pa spong ba dang gzhan (90) la phan pa sgrub pa'i sems dpa' mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dbang ldan du yod pas byang sems kyi sdom pa ma btang ba yin no// zhes shes pa'i phyir du mngon gyur dang dbang ldan gang rung rgyun chags pa smos pa yin no// dbye ba la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spangs ba'i sems bskyed dang bzhi yod de// mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams dang*// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam pa smin pa gzhan du 'dod// de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// de yang dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu/ gnyis pa ni ma dag sa bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu/ gsum pa ni dag pa sa gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o// dpe'i sgo nas dbye na sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs nyer gnyis so// dmigs yul gyi sgo nas dbye na smon pa sems bskyed dang 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par gang zhig 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dang de gang zhig

(91) byang chub kyi ched du lam sgrub par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis bsdus pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba dang*/ des ma bsdus pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrub pa khyad par ba'o// don dam sems bskyed dang chos nyid bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes don gcig mtshan gzhi ni sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag ye shes nas sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi bar yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab bsnyen byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ rgyu rigs sad pa'i= dge rtsa byas pa'i= theg chen gyi mdo sde la thos bsam byas pa'i= dge ba yun ring du goms pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po bzhi ni slar ldog sla bas mi brtan pa dang*/ lnga pa ni ldog dka' bas rgyun brtan pa'i sems bskyed ces gsungs shing*/ lnga char yang rags pa brda las byung zhing*/ (92) gzhan rkyen rgyu'i gtso bor byas pa las byung ba'i sems bskyed yin te/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyi bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed bstan zin nas// ༈ //gnyis pa gdams ngag bshad pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi 'og tu theg chen gyi gdams ngag 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed thob pa'i byang sems des sems bskyed kyi skabs su dmigs yul du byas pa de thob pa'i phyir du gdams ngag nyan dgos pa'i phyir/

gdams ngag dngos ni/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag dmigs yul 'phags pa'i bden bzhi la= sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la= sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs sel bar byed pa'i ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus la= yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la= lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la= sgrub pa'i yon tan lnga la= mngon shes drug la= theg chen gyi mthong lam la 'doms pa'i= theg chen gyi bsgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag dang bcur yod do// zhes pa ni sgrub dang zhes pa nas bcu'i bdag nyid shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ gdams ngag don du gnyer ba'i byang (93) sems la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i ched du bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sher phyin sgrubs shig ces 'doms par byed pa'i mdo tshig go /gnyis pa ni/ de la de'i ched du dmigs pa bden bzhi las mi 'da' bar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas de sgrubs shig ces 'doms par byed pa'i mdo tshig go /gsum pa ni/ de la de'i ched du rten dkon mchog gsum las mi 'da' bar sogs dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ de la de'i ched du ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ lnga pa ni/ de la de'i ched du yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ drug pa ni/ de la de'i ched du lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ bdun pa ni/ de la de'i ched du sgrub pa'i yon tan spyan snga las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ brgyad pa ni/ de la de'i ched du mngon shes drug las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ dgu pa ni/ de la de'i ched du bsgrub pa'i khyad par mthong lam las mi 'da' bar zhes sogs dang*/ bcu pa ni/ gdams ngag don du gnyer ba'i byang sems la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i ched du sgrub pa mthar thug par byed pa'i rgyu bsgom lam las mi 'da' bar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo

(94) nas sher phyin sgrubs shig ces 'doms par byed pa'i mdo tshig yin te/ 'di nyid las/ yul byang chub tu sems bskyed nas gdams ngag don du gnyer ba'i byang sems la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i ched du bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sher phyin sgrubs shig ces 'doms par byed pa'i mdo tshig go ces dang*/ de dag la 'doms par byed pa'i gdams ngag gi ngos 'dzin ni/ snga ma la dpags nas shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// des na 'dir bstan gyi gdams ngag bcu po gang rung yin na/ sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pas khyab pa yin no// sgrub dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa ni/ byang sems so skye'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa yin te/ 'di ni spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi'i sgrub pa gtso che ba'i phyir sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la mtha' dpyad na/ don gnyis mthar phyin gyi skyabs gnas dang*/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ 'bras bu chos sku rnams don gcig zag med rnam byang gi bden pa dang*/ chos dkon mchog dang 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gang rung rnams don gcig yon gnas su gyur pa'i 'phags pa dang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams don gcig go /kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin (95) bdag gzhan kun gyi rgyud la 'jug par shog 'dir kha cig 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i mthar thug gi skyabs gnas yin na/ sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin pas khyab/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam bden dang 'gog bden gang rung yin na/ de'i dngos bstan gyi chos dkon mchog yin pas khyab/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i rgyal sras yin na/ de'i dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/

dang po la/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas sa'i rang don dang gzhan don gyi yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud bla nas bshad pa'i 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gsum ni sangs rgyas sa'i rang don gyi yon tan dang*/ mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa ldan zhes pa'i de gsum ni sangs rgyas sa'i gzhan don gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i mjug tu/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ des thal/ don gnyis mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ (96) chos sku yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ yon tan drug gam brgyad dang ldan pa'i chos sku ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog ces gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ chos sku ma yin par thal/ gzugs sku yin pa'i phyir te/ longs sprul gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i spangs pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam sngon song gi byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi spangs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi 'gog lam gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/

der thal/ theg dman dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ rgyal sras 'phags pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ rgyal sras skye yin pa'i (97) phyir/ byang sems so skye yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems tshogs lam pa dang byang sems sbyor lam pa gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi lugs ni 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa'i yon tan drug gam brgyad dang ldan pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid kyi sku de sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid yin te/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// gzhan gyi rkyen gyi rtogs min pa// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan// don nyid ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni zhes sogs kyi dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings don gcig pa yum don rab gsal du bshad do// bsam med gnyis med la sogs pa'i/ 'gog lam gyi yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi zag med rnam byang gi bden pa de/ de'i dngos bstan gyi chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid yin te/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa// dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyi// gang zhig gang gi chags bral ba// bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni byang 'phags kyi 'gog lam mtha' dag go /rig grol gyi (98) yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar ji snyed nang gi ni// ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir// blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// mtshan gzhi ni sa bcu gang rung la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa rnams so// 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyas par bshad na/

mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog nyi shu yod de/ rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gi tshul du bzung ba'i byang sems 'phags pa gnyis/ de'i steng du rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po dang dad mos pa dang mthong thob pa dang*/ rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dang mos pa dang mthong thob pa/ rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dang mos pa dang mthong thob pa'i tshul bzung ba'i byang 'phags drug ste brgyad/ de dag gi steng du rgyun tu zhugs rigs nas rigs skyes pa'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig gi bar chad gcig pa'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ bar 'da' ba'i phyir mi 'ong gi tshul bzung ba dang*/ skyes tsam nas 'da' ba'i de'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba'i de'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba'i de'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ 'og min mthar thug 'gro ba'i de'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ srid rtse mthar thug 'gro ba'i de'i (99) tshul bzung ba dang*/ gzugs med nyer 'gro'i de'i tshul bzung ba dang*/ mthong chos bzhi'i phyir mi 'ong gi tshul bzung ba dang*/ lus mngon byed kyi phyir mi 'ong gi tshul bzung ba'i byang 'phags te bcu dgu/ se ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi tshul bzung ba'i byang 'phags gcig bcas nyi shur yod do// ces pa ni/ dbang po rtul dang zhes pa nas// se ru dang ni nyi shu'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams ni 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog ma yin te/ de rnams theg dman 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ spyan dang mngon shes la mtha' dpyad na/ spyan lnga ni theg chen gyi gang zag kho na'i rgyud la yod cing*/ rgyu'i gtso bo yang phar phyin drug nyams su blangs pa las byung zhing*/ bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten la/

mngon shes drug ni theg pa gsum ka'i gang zag dang*/ dang po lnga ni lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag la yang yod/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni 'phags pa kho na'i rgyud la yod/ rgyu'i gtso bo phar phyin drug gi nyams len med kyang*/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bsgom pa dang*/ rnam gnas yid la byed pa las byung zhing*/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten no// spyan lnga dang ni mngon shes kyi// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi spyan dang mngon shes gang rung yin na/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi spyan dang mngon shes gang rung yin pas khyab cing*/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan rjes mthun (100) pa yin pas khyab par shes par bya'o// de ltar spyan snga dang mngon shes drug las sha'i spyan ni phyin drug nyams su blangs pa las byung zhing*/ bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten pa'i dbang shes la 'jog 'dis gang shes na/ yar ston pa dang mar slob ma gang na yod pa shes/ lha'i spyan ni phyin drug nyams su blangs pa sogs la brten nas/ gdul bya rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes shing*/ tshe snga mar bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bsgom pa las byung ba'i bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus kyi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten pa'i shes pa la 'jog 'di dang sha'i spyan gnyis ka dbang shes yin pas lam du ni mi 'jog gam snyam ste dpyad par bya/ skabs gnyis pa'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/ gzhan rgyud la yod pa gzhan rig gi tshul gyis shes par bya ba ni sngar bshad pa ltar byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lha'i spyan dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi nyan thos rang rgyud la yod pa rtogs pa'i lam rnams dang*/ zhes gsungs pa ni tshig zur cung zad yi ge pas ma dag pas/ sngar bshad pa ltar byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan dang zer rgyu yin te/ 'di'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/

shes rab kyis bsgom par bya ba'i bdag med gnyis shes/ chos kyi grogs dge 'dun gyi rtogs pa shes/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs gzigs pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// gzhan du na sngar bshad pa ltar 'dir yang 'byung rigs pa yin pas/ 'dir ni lha'i (101) spyan gyis gdul bya'i 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes pa tsam las/ grogs dag 'dun gyi rtogs pa shes par ma gsungs pas snga phyi bsgrigs nas thugs rtogs zhib mos dpyod pa gal che'o// shes rab kyi spyan ni/ chos thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ye shes dang don gcig chos kyi spyan ni/ rang dang rgyu tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang po rno rtul sogs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa la 'jog pas/ chos kyi spyan yin na/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rjes thob ye shes yin pas khyab/ 'di dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi yul gyi khyad par la/ 'di nyid las/ 'di'i yul ni 'phags rgyud kyi rtogs pa kho na yin la/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi yul ni gzhan rgyud kyi shes pa thams cad do// ces gsungs pas kyang bshad ma thag pa ltar skabs gnyis pa'i lam shes su chos kyi spyan 'byung bar 'thad do// sangs rgyas kyi spyan ni/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i yul can ye shes la 'jog pas/ mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod/ rjes mthun pa slob dpon ltar na sa bdun pa'i rjes thob nas yod/ ar la sogs pa 'ga' zhig rjes mthun pa sa dang po nas yod par bzhed do// 'dir bstan rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems

(102) la brten nas gdul bya gang na yod pa'i yul du gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo bo byang sems kyi rgyud kyi yon tan khyad par ba zhig la 'jog 'dir bstan gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ni/ sems can gzhan gyi spyod pa dang sems 'dod chags dang bcas ma bcas sogs shes pa'i byang sems kyi yon tan khyad par ba la 'jog 'dir bstan lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes ni/ rang dang rgyu tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi sems can mtha' yas pa'i skad rnams so sor ji lta ba bzhin go zhing shes pa'i byang sems kyi yon tan khyad par ba la 'jog 'dir bstan sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga ma du ma rjes su dran zhing*/ shes pa'i byang sems kyi yon tan khyad par ba la 'jog 'dir bstan lha'i mig gi mngon shes ni/ yul thag nye ring kun gyi gzugs phra rag thams cad shes shing mthong ba'i byang sems kyi yon tan khyad par ba la 'jog 'dir bstan zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni/ zag pa zad pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de'i thabs nges par 'byung ba'i lam gang rung mngon sum du shes pa'i byang sems kyi yon tan khyad par ba la 'jog drug ka yang bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten pa yin no// 'dir zag pa zad pa'i thabs kyi mngon shes ni/ theg pa gsum ka'i mthong lam nas yod/ zag zad rang gi ngo bo'i mngon shes ni/ theg dman gyi mi slob lam dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas yod pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i (103) dngos slob nyang stod bka' chen pa bzhed pa ltar 'thad do// de ltar na 'dir bstan mngon shes drug ni rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu gzhan don yongs su rdzogs byed yin pas/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mngon shes drug po gang rung yin na/ byang sems rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mngon shes yin pas khyab/ de'i rgyud kyi lam yin pas khyab par shes par bya'o// gdams ngag bstan zin nas//

༈ //gsum pa nges 'byed yan lag 'chad pa ni/ theg chen gyi gdam ngag gi 'og tu theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems las dang po pas theg chen gyi gdams ngag nyan te/ gdams ngag gi don bsgom pas nyams su blangs pa las/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'di 'chad pa la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ dogs pa dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ bzhi po de gang zhe na/ nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi yin no// zhes pa ni/ sbyor lam ston byed kyi gzhung 'di dag gis ston la/ khyad par 'phags tshul ni/ rten gyi khyad par byang chub sems dpa'i slob pa'i rgyud la yod pa/ ngo bo'i khyad par 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i drod sogs bzhi po gang rung yin pa/ ldan tshul gyi khyad par dgag rtog bzhi'i ngo bo ldan zhing (104) brten pa/ dbye ba'i khyad par bzhi po re re la yang chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du yod pa'i sbyor lam chos can/ nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags te/ dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ rgyu dang*/ yongs 'dzin bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni zhes pa nas/ bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum rgyas par bshad// ldan pa rnam rtog rgyas par bshad/ yongs su 'dzin pa rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam drod chung ngu la sogs pa bcu gnyis po re re yang dmigs rnam rgyu'i khyad par gsum gsum dang ldan pa yin no// zhes pa ni rgyas bshad kyi gzhung 'di dag gis ston la/ de yang bden bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag sogs bcu drug drod chung ngu'i dmigs pa yin pa ni/

dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can zhes pas bstan/ drod chung ngu'i rnam pa ni mi rtag sogs su mngon zhen 'gog pa'i rnam pa khyad par ba yin no// zhes pa ni/ de yis ni/ rnam par mngon zhen la sogs 'gog ces pas bstan/ drod chung 'bring sogs sbyor lam bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pas rgyu'i khyad par dang ldan pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ theg pa gsum char thob pa'i rgyu zhes pas bstan/ khyad par 'di dag gis nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa grub ste/ nyan rang (105) gi sbyor lam ni dmigs pa bden bzhi tsam la dmigs pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtag sogs su mngon par zhen pa dang*/ theg pa gcig dang gnyis kyi rtogs rigs kyi rgyu byed kyang*/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs kyi rgyu mi byed pas so// drod 'bring ni dmigs pa gzugs sogs la dmigs pa'i 'du 'god de/ dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa ni chos nyid kyi sgo nas gnas te ming dang bral ba rgyun mi 'dra ba dang*/ gnas ni rgyun 'dra ba de dag don la ma grub par rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god gnas bral dang*// gnas dang zhes pas bstan/ drod chen po ni/ dmigs pa chos thams cad brdar btags pa'i tha snyad tsam yin zhing*/ rnam pa ni don dam par dge sogs gang du yang brjod du med par rtogs pa'i zab pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ rtags dang brjod du med zhes pas bstan/ rtse mo chung ngu ni dmigs pa gzugs sogs la don dam par mi gnas pa dang*/ rnam pa ni don dam par gzugs sogs stong pa nyid la rtag mi rtag sogs su zhen pa med pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni gzugs sogs mi gnas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de yang rkang pa dang po gnyis ni dmigs pa ston byed do// rtse mo 'bring ni dmigs pa gzugs sogs mi rtag pa dang stong nyid phan tshun rang gzhan gcig pa ba dang*/

rnam pa ni gzugs la sogs (106) pa'i chos rnams bdag gir mi 'dzin pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de rnams zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ rtse mo chen po ni dmigs pa gzugs sogs la sngon po la sogs pa'i mtshan mo so so'i dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa ni shes rab kyi chos thams cad bden pa'i dmigs su med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no zhes pa ni/ de dag ces sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ bzod pa chung ngu ni dmigs pa gzugs sogs la spyi dang khyad par sogs kyi ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ rnam pa ni gzugs sogs bden pa'i ngo bor med pa gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no zhes pa ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid// de med pa ni ngo bo nyid ces pas bstan/ bzod pa 'bring gi dmigs pa gzugs sogs la skye ba 'khor ba dang*/ nges 'byung myang 'das med par dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa ni/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid rtog pas rang gi sgo gsum rnam par dag pa rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de dag skye med nges 'byung med// dag dang zhes pas bstan/ bzod pa chen po ni/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa la dmigs shing*/ rnam pa ni/ mtshan ma'i rten dang bral ba'i mos pa yid byed dang 'du shes med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no zhes pa ni/ de dag mtshan ma med pa/ de'i mtshan mar mi brten pas// mos min 'du shes med pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ chos mchog chung (107) ngu ni/ chos thams cad skye med rtogs pa dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom par dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa ni/ ting 'dzin de'i byed pa ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyod yul la spyod pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ ting 'dzin de'i byed pa nyid// zhes pas bstan/ chos mchog 'bring ni/ lung ston pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i ting 'dzin la dmigs shing*/ rnam pa ni/

ting 'dzin rang gi ngo bo spros bral du 'du shes pas/ bdag ni mnyam bzhag pa'o snyam pa la sogs pa'i rlom pa'i mngon zhen dang bral ba'i rnam pa yin no zhes pa ni/ lung ston pa dang rlom par zad/ ces pas bstan/ chos mchog chen po ni/ ting 'dzin dang byang sems dang sher phyin gsum phan tshun dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bo gcig pa la dmigs shing*/ rnam pa ni ting 'dzin la 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa mthong lam skye ba'i thabs dam par rtogs pa'i rnam pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ gsum po phan tshun ngo bo gcig ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa ces pas bstan/ de ltar na nges 'byed cha mthun drod sogs chung 'bring chen po rnams dmigs rnam rgyu'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rtog pa rgyas bshad ni/ skabs 'di nas dngos su bstan pa'i skabs don (108) gyi rtog pa la dbye na/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis las/ dang po la/ gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang*/ gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog gnyis su yod ces pa ni/ gzhi dang de'i gnyen po yi// gzung ba rtog pa rnam pa gnyis// zhes pas bstan/ 'dir bstan gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang rang yul dor bya'i gzung ba la dmigs nas dor byar mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtog pa don gcig de la dbye na/ rang yul du gyur pa'i ma rig pa la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa/ rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa/ ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen pa la gzung rtog mtha' gnyis la chags pa'i zung rtog kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang mi shes pa la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa/ 'phags pa'i lam la mi gnas pa la= dmigs pa la= bdag la= rnam dag bskyed byed la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod cing*/

'dir bstan gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang*/ rang yul blang bya'i gzung ba la dmigs nas blang byar mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtog pa don gcig de la dbye na/ rang yul du gyur pa'i rnam byang gi phung po la gzung bar rnam par rtog pa dang*/ rnam byang gi skye ba'i sgo la= rnam byang gi rigs la= rnam byang gi skye ba la= (109) stong nyid rtogs pa'i rigs la= pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la= mthong lam la= bsgom lam la= mi slob lam la gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod do// ces pa ni/ rmongs dang zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ de'i rmongs pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog gi dor bya'i yul du gyur pa'i ma rig pa yin zhing*/ 'di'i phung po ni/ rnam byang gzung rtog gi yul du gyur pa'i rnam byang gi phung po yin la/ yul lhag ma brgyad mtshan gnyis ni sogs sgras ston/ gzhi'i rten can gyi dang po brgyad ni kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos la dor bya'i gzung bar zhen pa yin pas/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog ces kyang bya zhing*/ rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i ris su gnas pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog yin la/ dgu pa ni theg dman gyi rnam byang gi chos la dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa yin pas/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i ris su gnas pa'i shes sgrib yin no// gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog rnams ni rang yul rnam byang gi chos la dmigs pa yin pas/ rnam byang gzung rtog ces bya zhing*/ lnga pa dang drug pa byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs dang*/ gzhan bdun ni rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog yin no// 'di bstan theg chen gyi mthong spangs 'dzin rtog la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis su yod do ces pa ni/ rdzas dang (110) dang zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ 'dir bstan rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/

theg chen gyi mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong spangs nyon sgrib dang*/ rang yul gang zag dang chos gang rung rdzas yod la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtog pa rnams don gcig de la dbye na/ rang dbang can gyi bdag la 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gcig pu'i bdag la= rgyu'i bdag la= lta ba po'i bdag la= kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten la= 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rten la= mthong lam gyi rten la= bsgom lam gyi rten la= don byas pa'i rten la= 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod cing*/ dang po'i ngos 'dzin ni/ rang yul rang dbang can gyi bdag la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo lta bu/ phyi ma brgyad la'ang rigs 'gre/ 'dir bstan 'dzin rtog gnyis pa dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ rang yul gang zag dang chos gang rung btags yod la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spangs rnams don gcig de la dbye na/ phung po la brten nas btags par yod pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang skye mched la= khams la= rten cang 'brel bar 'byung ba la= rnam par byang ba la= (111) mthong lam la= bsgom lam la= khyad par lam la= mi slob lam la brten nas/ btags par yod pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod do ces pa ni/ rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang*// phung sogs rten las de bzhin no// zhes pas bstan/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ rang yul phung po la brten nas btags par yod pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo lta bu/ phyi ma brgyad la'ang rigs 'gre'o// gsum pa yongs 'dzin rgyas bshad ni/ theg chen sbyor lam theg dman du mi ltung bar/ theg chen du yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'i khyad par gyi chos de 'dir bstan yongs 'dzin gyi ngo bo yin cing*/

de la dbye na/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i nang gi yongs 'dzin thabs mkhas dang*/ de'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin dge bshes gnyis/ dang po ni/ stong nyid kyi don la rang gi sems mi skrag cing mi 'gong ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba de yin cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sems sbyor lam pa la chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la sogs pa'i chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems gong ma rnams yin no zhes pa ni/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs zhes pa nas/ yongs 'dzin yin zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan no// gsum pa dogs dpyod la dmigs rnam gyi khyad par la 'phros nas/ (112) blo rigs ngos bzung ba/ rgyu'i khyad par la 'phros nas rtogs rigs gsum po gcig dang tha dad spyad pa/ 'dir bstan rtog pa'i dka' gnas la dpyad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pas khyab ste/ de yin na/ rang yul bdag med pa'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i sgom byung gi rtogs pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ gzhan dag de yin na/ rang rig mngon sum yin pas khyab ste/ de yin na/ sgom byung gi sgo nas chos nyid rang gi myong ba khyad par can gyi rig pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ 'ga' zhig de yin na/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin pas khyab ste/ de yin na bdag med gsum po gang rung don spyi'i tshul gyi rtogs pa'i blo yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ chos dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir te/

chos dbyings la mnyam gzhag pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig chos dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos

(113) can/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen sbyor lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rtogs rigs gsum ka yod pa'i phyir te/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa des rtogs rigs gsum ka bsgom dgos pa'i phyir te/ des mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ mngon sum yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir te/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs rigs gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rgyun zhugs tsam gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems sbyor lam pas nyon sgrib kyi lhag ma spong ba'i ched du gang zag gi bdag med la mnyam par bzhag pa'i lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyun zhugs tsam gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi nyon sgrib kyi lhag ma spong ba yod pa'i (114) phyir te/ des gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rdzogs pa bsgom pa yod pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa ma yin par thal/ mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/

chos can yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin na/ bdag med rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi bdag med ma rtogs par thal/ khyod kyi bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa gang zhig khyod kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyi ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa thal/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis don spyi'i tshul gyi ma rtogs pa thal/ khyod mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen gyi sbyor lam phal che ba sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin zhing*/ der 'gyur ba'i rnal 'byor mngon (115) sum dang*/ rang rig mngon sum gnyis kyang yod par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su sgra don 'dres 'dzin du gyur pa'i rtogs rigs gsum po dus snga phyi dang rdzas tha dad du yod de/ rtog pa de sel mjug yin pas/ gang zag gi bdag med kyi rnam pa can du skyes pa'i tshe/ chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa can du skyes pa ma yin pa'i phyir// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na theg dman 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis 'gal ba yin no// yang de'i gnas skabs su nyan rang 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon song la rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/

bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi 'phags lam sngon song la rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur pa'i bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs ldan pa'i skabs yod kyang rtogs rigs ngo bo tha dad la rdzas gcig dang gcig char du mi ldan te/ de'i gnas skabs kyi der gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs rigs des gang zag gi bdag med tsam las bdag med gzhan ma rtogs/ de'i gnas skabs kyi der gyur pa'i bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs des bzung ba chos kyi bdag med tsam las bdag med gzhan ma rtogs pa'i phyir de'i gnas skabs su der gyur (116) ba'i 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs ni med/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa la theg chen gyi 'phags lam thob dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i gnas skabs kyi rang rig mngon sum ni rtogs rigs gsum po gang yang ma yin te/ bdag med ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ sa dang po yan chad la rtogs rigs gsum po phan tshun 'gal kyang dus mnyam rdzas gcig tu yod de/ theg chen 'phags pa'i ye shes gcig nyid kyis spros pa thams cad gcig char du bkag nus la/ de'i tshe bden bzhi'i steng du rtag sogs bcu drug gi spros pa bkag ste/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag gi skye med du rtogs pa'i ldog cha ni gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ bzung ba phyi rol gyi don du zhen pa'i spros pa bkag ste/ gzhi bzung ba chos kyi skye med du rtogs pa'i ldog cha ni/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi spros pa bkag ste/ lam 'dzin pa dang rnam pa 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag gi skye med du rtogs pa'i ldog cha ni/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'di'i dngos bstan gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam de theg pa gsum po gang gi rtogs rigs yin snyam na/

theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kho na yin te/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du skabs bzhi pa'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/ spyir (117) byang sems kyi sbyor lam la yon tan gyi ldog pa mi 'dra ba du ma yod pas skabs dang por byang sems kyi rtogs rigs kyi ldog pa nas bstan/ skabs gnyis par nyan rang gi rtogs rigs ldog pa nas bstan/ skabs gsum par de dag la gzhan spyod pa bkag pa'i rtogs rigs kyi ldog pa nas bstan/ 'dir ni rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa yin la/ zhes gsungs so// 'o na dang po'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pas da lta yang theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang zhes pa'i don no// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na skyon med de/ skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam la theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs dngos su ma tshang kyang rgyu'i tshul gyis tshang ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtog pa'i dka' gnas la dpyad pa la/ ngo bo dang spangs bya gang du ldan dpyad/ dgag rtog dang sgrub rtog gang yin dpyad/ mthong spangs dang bsgom spangs gang yin dpyad/ sgrib pa gnyis po gang yin dpyad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa snga ma kha cig rtog pa bzhi po spangs byar ldan pa yin zhes gsungs kyang*/ spangs byar byed pa la ldan pa'i sgra sbyor na ha cang thal bas mi 'thad la/ rang lugs ni skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag bzhi la/ bzhi dang de'i gnyen po yin zhes sogs kyi shugs (118) bstan gyi dgag rtog bzhi po ngo bor ldan zhing brten pa yin te/ rnam rtog bzhi po ldan brten pa// ces pa'i don no// des mtshon nas byang sems kyi sbyor lam rjes thob bzhi la/

bzhi dang de'i zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi sgrub rtog bzhi po ngo bor ldan pa yin te/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ de lta bu'i rnam par rtog pa bzhi dang*/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi po grangs bzhin du ldan pa yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub rtog bzhi po byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag bzhi la ldan pa ma yin te/ rtog pa bzhi po 'di dag sbyor lam mnyam bzhag bzhis rim bzhin spang byar byed pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dir bstan sgrub rtog bzhi po theg chen gyi mthong spangs yin zhing*/ de'i spongs ba gnyen po la sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ bar chad med pa'i lam gnyis yod pa las/ snga ma ni sbyor lam mnyam bzhag bzhi char dang*/ phyi ma ni mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod gcig nyid la 'jog pa/ gzhung gi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ drod mnyam bzhag gi theg chen gyi mthong spangs nyon mongs gzung rtog mngon gyur spong zhing*/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang thob/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan/ rtse mo mnyam bzhag gis theg chen gyi mthong spangs rnam byang gzung rtog mngon gyur ba spong zhing*/ rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal (119) snang thob/ bzod pa mnyam bzhag gi theg chen gyi mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur ba spong zhing*/ gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa gsal snang thob/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan/ chos mchog mnyam bzhag gis theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtag 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur ba spong zhing*/ skyes bu rtags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang thob/ mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis de dag gi sa bon bzhi po gcig char du spong bas de gcig nyid la mthong lam rtse sbyor bzhi dang*/ mthong lam bar chad med lam bzhi dang*/

mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhir 'jog cing*/ rnal 'byor sa bzhi'i nang tshan spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa mtshams kyang theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma dang po nas yod par shes par bya'o// bzhi'i nang tshan gyis bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can nas yod do// sbyor lam rjes thob bzhi la sgrub rtog dang*/ mnyam bzhag bzhi la dgag rtog ldan tshul sogs ni bka' 'grel nyid du lta bar bya'o// gnyis pa dgag rtog dang sgrub rtog gang yin dpyad pa ni/ gzhi dang zhes sogs rgyas bshad kyi dngos bstan gyi rtog pa ni sgrub rtog yin te/ 'dzin stangs sgrub pa'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ yul dgu bzhi so drug po gang rung la (120) dmigs nas gzung ba'i rnam pa can dang*/ 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gang rung gi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gzhi dang zhes sogs rgyas bshad kyi shugs bstan gyi rtog pa dang*/ rnam rtog bzhi po ldan brtan pa ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi rtog pa ni dgag rtog yin te/ 'dzin stangs dgag pa'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ yul so drug po gang rung la dmigs nas gzung ba rang bzhin med pa dang*/ 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa gang rung gi rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig sgrub rtog yin na/ mthong spangs rtog pa yin pas khyab/ dgag rtog yin na/ bsgom spangs rtog pa yin pas khyab/ dman lam sngon du ma song zhing kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod mnyam bzhag yin na/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pas khyab/ de bzhin du dman lam sngon du ma song zhing*/ rnam byang gi gzung ba dang gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa dang*/ skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa de dang de rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtse mo mnyam bzhag sogs de dang de yin na/

rnam byang gi gzung ba sogs de dang de rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byams pa tshad med pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ (121) ma grub na/ der thal/ rtog pa gang zhig 'dzin stangs sgrub pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes min pa gang zhig byang sems kyi sbyor lam rjes thob ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ 'dzin stangs sgrub pa'i rnam pa can yin par thal/ sems can thams cad la phan pa sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi byams pa tshan med pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jug par/ 'gro la phan pa nyer sgrub pa// byams pa chen po zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'o na gnyen po mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi spangs bya'i rigs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ gnyen po theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i rjes thob kyi nyams len khyad par can yin pa'i phyir te/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags/ zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi nyams len yin pa'i phyir te/ sbyor lam rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi byams pa tshad med yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la mnyam par bzhag pa'i (122) theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'dzin stangs dgag pa'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rtog pa gang zhig 'dzin stangs dgag pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/

dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyi rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la mnyam par bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ 'dzin stangs bdag med kyi rnam pa can yin phyir/ 'dzin stangs chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa can yin phyir/ chos kyi bdag med la mnyam par bzhag pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ bsgom spang yin pa thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ spang bya lhan skyes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi drod mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba gang zhig byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi drod mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo ma yin par thal/ khyod rang yul la mngon

(123) zhen bkag pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ mtshan 'dzin yin par thal/ de rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mdor/ gzugs stong zhes bya bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam mthong bsgom gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma gsum la'ang rigs 'gre'o// des na drod mnyam bzhag tu kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i tshe/ de rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo 'byung yang gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ de rang bzhin mngon par zhen pa'i blo gnyis 'dzin stangs gcig pas ngo bo gcig tu ldan zhing*/ 'on kyang phan tshun de der khas mi len te/ gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa ni lam dngos dang*/ de dang dus mnyam ngo bo gcig pa'i gzung ba rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo ni lam phyi mas spangs byar byed pa'i mtshan 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ dper na gcig du bral gyi rtags las/ myu gu bden med du rtogs pa'i tshe/ skad cig gnyis par myu gu bden med du mngon par zhen pa'i blo 'byung bas/ de'i tshe lam dang lam min so sor phyed dgos te/ (124) myu gu bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi cha ni thos bsam gyi dbu ma'i lta ba dang*/ myu gu bden med du mngon par zhen pa'i blo ni/ slar rtogs pa phyi mas spangs dgos pa'i mtshan 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ des mtshon nas rtse mo mnyam gzhag sogs su rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i tshe na'ang*/ rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa'i blo gnyis ma 'dres par shes par bya'o// gnad 'di go na/

byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag bzhi la dgag rtog bzhi ngo bor ldan tshul yang shes par 'gyur ro// de ltar na dge phyogs pas sngon gyi mkhas grub gong ma bzhed pa'i lta ba rnams ha shang gi lta ba yin zhes pa dang*/ stong par mngon par zhen pa dgag tu mi rung zhes sogs mang du smra ba yang rna ba'i bdud rtsi ma yin zhing*/ dge phyogs pa la skyon 'phen mkhan gyi mkhas pa dag gis kyang so skye'i gnas skabs su dbu ma'i lta ba dang mtshan 'dzin dus mnyam du 'byung ba de so sor ma 'dres par dbye theng 'byed dgos rgyu yin pa la/ de mi mdzad par lam snga ma snga ma rnams gzung ba rang bzhin med par mngon par zhen pa sogs su bzhed pa ni/ mtshan 'dzin dang dbu ma'i lta ba gcig tu 'chab 'tshal bas dpyod ldan dag gis dpyad par bya'o// kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa ni kho bos bshad pa 'di la 'grig ste/ 'di nyid las/ ngo bor ldan pa'i tshe sbyor lam 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa yin zhes pa dang*/ 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa de sbyor lam yin zhes pa ni khas mi (125) blangs te/ 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa ni mngon par zhen pa'i cha nas 'jog dgos shing*/ sbyor lam ni mngon zhen bkag pa'i cha nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i legs bshad 'di ding sang kho bo 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du gyur pas so// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ so skye'i skabs su thos dang sgom byung gi /dbu ma'i lam dang mtshan 'dzin chabs cig tu// 'byung yang gcig tu ma 'dres rnam dbye gces// dper na lcags gong me ru 'bar ba'i skabs// lcags dang me rdul tha dad yod la ltos// gnad 'di ma rtogs snga phyi'i mkhas rlom mang*// rang rang yus pa'i tshul gyis rig pa'i mda'// mang du 'phen yang phan tshun ngal ba tsam// kho bos 'dir bshad legs pa'i lam phye yang*// khro dang rmongs pas sgrib rnams ci byar yod// de lta'i legs bshad mchod sprin rnam rol la// rgyal ba sras bcas dge bas yid rab tshim// gsum pa mthong spangs dang bsgom spangs gang yin dpyad pa ni/

'dir dngos bstan gyi sgrub rtog bzhi po theg chen gyi mthong spangs yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ nyi snang du/ de la mthong ba'i lam gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni/ rnam par rtog pa rnam pa bzhi ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na gnyen po mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi spang bya dang mthong spangs don gcig gam zhe na/ mi gcig ste/ nyan thos kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i bsgom spangs (126) nyon mongs dang*/ rang rgyal spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i bsgom spangs shes sgrib gzung rtog rnams ni dman lam sngon du ma song bar theg chen gyi lam du spong na theg chen sbyor lam mnyam bzhag gi spong ba gnyen po sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi bar chad med lam byas te/ spong bas gnyen po theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi spang bya yin par grub bo// dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi spang bya 'di la theg pa gsum ka'i snga bya'i rigs yod de/ 'dir bstan rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ni bden 'dzin kho na yin cing*/ de la gnyis las/ gang zag la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa rnams ni nyan thos kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyon sgrib yin cing*/ de la mthong spangs dang bsgom spangs gnyis yod par nges la/ gang zag dang chos kyi zlas phye ba'i chos la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa rnams ni/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib yin/ 'dir bstan gzung rtog dang po'i dgu pa dang*/ gzung rtog gnyis pa'i lnga pa dang drug pa de gsum ma rtogs pa'i gzung rtog lhag ma rnams ni rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog yin cing*/ de la yang mthong spangs dang bsgom spangs gnyis su yod par nges la/ rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs min pa'i gzung rtog gsum dang*/
