'dir bstan rtags 'dzin rtog pa rnams ni byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i mthong spangs shes sgrib yin zhing*/ theg chen gyi bsgom spangs la (127) ni theg pa gzhan gyi spang bya'i rigs med cing*/ bsgom spangs kho nar nges so// de ltar na 'dir dngos bstan gyi sgrub rtog bzhi char la mthong pas spang bya dang bsgom pas spang bya gnyis gnyis su mi 'byed kyang*/ spyir 'dir dngos bstan gyi sgrub rtog la de gnyis tshangs bar yod de/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ mthong ba dang bsgom pas spang bar bya ba gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa bzhi po 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul dang 'brel par 'byung ba zhes dang*/ nyi snang du 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam gyis spang bar bya ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'chad par 'gyur ba ni/ bzhi dang de'i gnyen po yi zhes sogs skabs dang por rtog pa rgyas bshad kyi skabs su yin no// mthong spangs dang bsgom spangs kyi khyad par ni/ spang bya gzhi med dang gzhi bcas kyi khyad par yin pas mthong spangs dang spang bya kun btags don gcig bsgom spangs dang spang bya lhan skyes don gcig cing*/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi spangs bya thams cad gnyis po 'dir 'dus so// bzhi pa sgrib pa gnyis po gang yin dpyad pa ni/ bod snga ma rnams 'dir bstan sgrub rtog bzhi byang sems lam gyi spang bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i shes sgrib kho na yin pas/ 'di la nyan thos kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyon sgrib dang*/ rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib kyi gzung (128) rtog med do ces mgrin gcig tu gsung yang*/ rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ma yin te/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi po de gang zag gi ngos nas byang sems lam gyi spang bya kho na yin kyang*/ theg pa gsum char gyi spang bya'i rigs tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/

tshang tshul ni bshad zin ma thag pa ltar ro// mdor na theg dman 'phags pa'i lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi spang byar gyur pa'i rtog pa'i nang du theg pa gsum char gyi spang bya'i rigs 'dus pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po byang sems kyi sbyor lam la mnyam bzhag dang*/ sbyor lam gyi 'bras bu theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam la theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba dang*/ de'i 'bras bu rnam dag bsgom lam la theg pa gsum char gyi spang bya spangs pa'i rnam dag tshang ba ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu snang zhes kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung ngo*// de ltar nges 'byed yan lag bshad zin nas/ de'i 'og tu theg chen sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs ston te/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag thob nas sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi rten du gyur pa'i rigs 'jog pa'i phyir// 'dir 'chad pa la/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rtsod pa spong ba dang*/ rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// zhes pa la (129) 'phros nas/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs 'di la du zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu gsum du yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog mthong lam/ ma dag pa'i bsgom lam ste rtogs pa chos drug gi rten du gyur pa'i rigs so sor dbye bas drug dang*/ gnyen po sa brgyad pa'i sbyor ba'i lam gyi rten rigs dang*/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon dngos su spong ba'i sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam gyi= rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya yongs su gtugs pa ste spangs pa sa brgyad pa'i rnam grol gyi rten= shes rab dang snying brtse zung du 'brel ba'i sgrub pa sa brgyad pa'i khyad par lam=

slob pa nyan thos dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa sa dgu pa'i rten= gzhan don go rims su byed pa'i sgrub pa sa bcu pa'i= sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la dngos su 'jug pa'i sgrub pa rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi rten rigs dang bcu gsum du yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*/ zhes pa nas 'jug pa'i rten la rigs zhes bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa brtsod pa spong ba la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no/ chos dbyings chos can/ khyod la bcu gsum du dbyer mi rigs par thal/ khyod spros bral yin pas rnam par dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rtsod pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings la zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten du (130) gyur pa'i chos dbyings chos can/ khyod la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med kyang*/ rten chos sgrub pa'i sgo nas dbye ba yod de/ rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum tha dad pa'i bye brag gis/ khyod kyi dbye ba yang bcu gsum du brjod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ bstan pa'i chos kyi zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa la gnyis te/ dngos smra ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs so// dang po ni/ mdzod las/ ma chags 'phags rigs de dag las// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha che bye brag smra bas/ sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa la rigs su 'dod/ mdo sde pas/ 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/ mdo sde pa dag gi rigs zhes bya ba ni/ sems kyi sa bon nus pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zag med kyi dge ba'i sa bon 'bras bu 'byung rung gi nus pa la rigs su 'dod/ sems tsam pas/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs de ni/ thog ma med pa nas 'ong ba/ chos nyid kyis thob pa skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye mched drug gi khyad par kun gzhi'i rnam shes la yod pa'i sa bon rkyen dang phrad na byang chub thob par byed pa'i nus pa la rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod la/

'on kyang de dag 'dus byas yin pas/ dbu ma pas gzhal na rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ gzhi dus kyi rigs mtshan nyid pa ma (131) yin te/ sdom gsum kha skong las/ gzhi la grub mtha'i bye brag gis// sems 'byung zag med sa bon dang*// skye mched drug gi khyad par sogs// 'dod pa yod kyang 'dus byas yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ ngo bo/ ming gi rnams grangs/ dbye ba/ rten du 'gyur tshul/ rigs su 'gyur tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ mthun rkyen sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug tu rung*/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa spang du rung*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung du rung ba'i chos dbyings de/ rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan nyid yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer ma phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying po dang*/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po dang*/ dri ma las ma grol ba'i chos dbyings dang*// rang bzhin gnas rigs rnams don gcig go /rdzogs sangs sku ni zhes pa'i sku de la rtogs pa chos sku dang*/ bstan pa chos sku gnyis/ dang po ni/ glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ zab mo stong nyid ston pa'i gsung rab dang*/ brjod bya sna tshogs ston pa'i gsung rab lta bu/ de bzhin nyid dbyer zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi de bzhin nyid ni/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi rang (132) bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid dang don gcig cing*/ 'di la dbye ba ma bshad la/ rigs yod phyir zhes pa'i rigs la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ rigs dang po gnas gyur pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku/ rigs gnyis pa gnas gyur pa las byung ba'i// longs sprul gnyis te/

lngar phye zhing*/ rtogs pa chos sku sogs sngar gyi don mtshan bzhi dang bsdebs pas don dgur 'gyur te/ rgyud bla mar/ 'di'i rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste// de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni// lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig rtogs pa chos sku yin na/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos sku dang po yin pas khyab/ rtogs pa chos sku yin na rtogs pa yin pas khyab/ ngo bo nyid sku yin na/ spangs pa chos sku yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ spyir 'gog lam gang rung yin na/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gong du ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi lam bden yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*//

(133) zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos dbyings yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ngo bo nyid skur thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ rtogs pa ma yin par thal/ spangs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi spangs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ rtogs pa chos sku yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ de la kha cig de chos can/ spangs pa chos sku yin par thal/ spangs pa gang zhig chos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na de chos can/ spangs pa'i chos 'khor yin par thal/ spangs pa gang zhig chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ stobs mtshungs/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ des na spangs pa chos sku dang*/ spangs pa'i chos 'khor gyi tha snyad rang mi 'thad pa yin te/ de 'dra gzhung lugs tshad ldan las bshad pa (134) med pas so// yang rigs yod phyir zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rigs dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs rnams don gcig yin zhing*/ rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku gsum gang rung du 'gyur du rung zhing*/ dri ma las ma grol ba'i chos dbyings dang*/ rigs bsad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dge rtsa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i rgyu'i cha sangs rgyas rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin no// 'di'i zur dang po ni/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa ste/

zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing*/ zur phyi ma gnyis ni rigs kyi dbye ba gnyis pa'i ngo bo bsdus pa yin no// de la kha cig theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang gi ngo bo longs sprul gang rung du 'gyur du rung bar thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags par 'gyur rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ shes pa gang zag tu 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir zhe na/ kho bo ni 'di ltar sems te/ theg chen gyi sbyor mthong sogs rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs rnams spyir longs sprul du mi 'gyur yang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi longs sprul du 'gyur ba yin te/ mnyam nyid ye shes dang sor rtog ye shes sangs rgyas (135) rang snang gi longs sku dang*/ bya grub ye shes sangs rgyas rang snang gi sprul sku gang zhig rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs rnams mnyam nyid ye shes sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na rigs kyi skabs 'dir bshad pa'i sku phyi ma gnyis po gang rung dang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi longs sprul gang rung dang*/ gnyis pa yi ni phyi ma gnyis zhes pa'i phyi ma gnyis po gang rung rnams don gcig cing*/ mtshan gzhi ni mnyam nyid ye shes sogs la 'jog go /de skad du skabs brgyad pa'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/ mdor na sangs rgyas rang gi gnas lugs 'chad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan nyid pa chos sku gcig po yin te/ de'i tshe longs sprul gnyis kyang mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i gzugs sku la mi 'jog par ye shes phyi ma gsum la 'jog pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa yin no// de ltar na 'di nyid las/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems gang zag gi cha longs skur 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa yang byang sems rgyun mtha' pa/

mnyam nyid ye shes dang sor rtog ye shes su 'gyur ba min pa'i don yin pas/ blo la mi bde ba bya mi dgos so// gzhan du na sgra ji bzhin du 'khrul na/ byang sems rgyun mtha' pa skad cig gnyis par longs skur 'gyur nges de longs skur mi 'gyur na/ longs skur 'gyur ba mi rnyed par 'gyur ro// mdor na/ gnyis pa yi ni phyi ma gnyis zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi longs sprul gnyis po de sangs rgyas rang snang gi (136) longs sprul du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la 'jog pa gnad kyi yin zhing*/ 'di'i longs sprul sangs rgyas 'phags pa la mi byed de/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba yin gyis/ gang zag tu gnas 'gyur ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rigs kyi mtshan nyid kyi skabs 'dir bshad pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ dang po'i sku ni dang po ste zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sku dang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi ngo bo nyid sku rnams don gcig rang snang gi ngo bo nyid sku yin na/ ngo bo nyid sku yin pas ma khyab ste/ de la dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de yang der gyur pa'i dbyings ni glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings dang*/ der gyur pa'i ye shes ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes yin no// de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sems ye shes bzhir gnas gyur pa na/ de'i sems kyi nang sel kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa la me long lta bu'i ye shes su 'jog de'i rgyud kyi sems kyi chos dbyings gnas gyur pa la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings su 'jog cing*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang dag pa gnyis ldan pa'i chos dbyings dang sangs rgyas rang snang gi ngo bo nyid sku yin pas/ de la gnyis yod par grub bo// de skad du 'di nyid las/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi sems ye shes bzhir gyur cing*/

sems kyi chos dbyings de glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings su gyur pa'i tshe na/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ dbyings (137) rnam dag dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang zhes gsungs pa yin no// yang de'i rgyud kyi sems dang sems 'byung lam gyi bsdus pa rnams rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin pas/ de gnas gyur pa na sangs rgyas rang snang gi longs sprul gnyis sam ye shes phyi ma gsum du 'jog pa gnad kyi don to// legs par bshad pa'i mchod sprin 'dis kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dges pa'i zhal gyi 'dzum dkar las byung ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i byin brlab bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ rigs dang khams dang sa bon la sogs pa spyir rigs pa tsam gyi rnam grangs dang*/ bde gshegs snying po dang*/ chos dbyings dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi khams la sogs pa rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi rnam grangs tsam yin zhing*/ don gcig tu 'khrul par mi bya ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po dang*/ chos dbyings de rang bzhin gnas rigs ma yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin na/ bde gshegs snying po dang chos dbyings yin pas khyab ste/ de de gnyis kyi nang sel gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes pa'i zur gyi rang bzhin 'di la dbu sems gnyis 'dod tshul so sor yod de/ sems tsam pas de'i zur gyi rang bzhin dang zag med kyi ye shes kyi rgyu don gcig par byas nas rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus byas su (138) 'dod/ de la dbu ma pas 'o na rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyang rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'gyur te/ de zag med kyi ye shes kyi rgyur gyur pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i skyon brjod nas/ rang lugs la chos nyid kyi rigs dang*/ rang bzhin gnas rigs don gcig par rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus ma byas su 'dod pa yin te/

kha skong las/ rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus byas su// 'dod pa dngos smra'i lugs yin gyis// dbu ma pa yi lugs la med// ces bshad pa ltar ro// 'di'i rgyab rten gyi lung ni nyi snang yin te/ de nyid las/ de dag gis ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la rang bzhin du brjod pa'i don brjod dgos so// rgyu'i rnam grangs yin no zhe na/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa yang de yin pas na don gyi khyad par ci yod/ chos kyi rnam grangs yin pa la ni nyes pa 'di med do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dbye ba la/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rten chos sgrub pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po la gnas skabs ma nges pa'i rigs dang*/ gnas skabs nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs nyan thos kyi lam du zhugs kyang nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par ma nges shing*/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du rung ba'i nyan thos slob pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings dang*/ gnas skabs rang rgyal gyi lam du zhugs kyang rang rgyal gyi byang chub thob par ma nges shing*/ sha (139) rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du rung ba'i rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings dang*/ gnas skabs theg chen gyi lam du zhugs kyang*/ rkyen dbang gis theg dman du lhung nges kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings lta bu'o// gnyis pa gnas skabs nges pa'i rigs la/ gnas skabs nyan thos su nges pa'i rigs dang*/ gnas skabs rang rgyal du nges pa'i rigs dang*/ gnas skabs theg chen du nges pa'i rigs dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dang po nyid nas nyan thos kyi lam du zhugs te rkyen dbang gis gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du sgyur du mi rung bar nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/

dang po nyid nas rang rgyal lam du zhugs te rkyen dbang gis gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du sgyur du mi rung bar rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ dang po nyid nas theg chen lam du zhugs te rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du mi rung bar theg chen gyi byang chub thob par nges pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi chos dbyings lta bu'o// mdor na/ gnas skabs nyan thos su nges pa'i rigs dang*/ gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs don gcig yin zhing*/ des phyi ma gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o// de gsum ka'ang mthar thug theg chen du nges pa'i (140) rigs yin te/ mthar thug nyan thos rang rgyal du rigs nges pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs yin na/ mthar thug sangs rgyas su nges pa'i rigs yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig gnas skabs nyan thos su nges pa'i rigs yin na/ nyan thos su nges pa'i rigs yin pas khyab/ gnas skabs rang rgyal du nges pa'i rigs yin na/ rang rgyal du nges pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ dang po nyid nas nyan thos lam du zhugs te zhes sogs sngar smos pa'i rtsod gzhi dang po de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ rkyen dbang gi rang rgyal dang theg chen gang rung du sgyur du mi rung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rkyen dbang gi de gang rung du sgyur du rung bar thal/ rkyen dbang gis theg chen du sgyur rung ba'i phyir te/ nyan thos kyi byang chub thob rjes su theg chen du zhugs te bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur nges pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mthar thug theg pa cig tu grub pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs grub cing khyab ste/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ theg pa gsum rnam par bzhag pa ni/ dgongs pa can yin gyi zhes sogs dang*/

skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs byang chub tu mngon par 'gro ba can yin pas zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sngar smos pa'i (141) mtshan gzhi gnyis pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ 'don na 'gre/ des nas gnas skabs nyan thos dang rang rgyal du nges pa'i rigs yin na/ nyan thos kyi rigs dang rang rgyal gyi rigs yin pas khyab ste/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi rten rigs la nyan thos kyi rigs dang*/ rang rgyal gyi lam gyi rten rigs la rang rgyal gyi rigs su 'jog pas so// 'on kyang gnas skabs nyan thos dang rang rgyal du nges pa'i rigs yin na/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal du nges pa'i rigs ma yin pas khyab ste/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal du rigs nges pa yin na/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur mi rung dgos pa las/ 'dir mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pas/ nyan rang gang rung yin na/ mthar thug theg chen lam du 'jug pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gnas skabs nyan thos su nges pa'i gang zag yin na/ nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ gnas skabs rang rgyal du rigs nges pa'i gang zag yin na/ rang rgyal du rigs nges pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ dang po nyid nas nyan thos lam du zhugs te nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par nges pa'i nyan thos bsgom lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gnas skabs der nges pa'i nyan thos bsgom lam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ nyan (142) thos su rigs nges pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ rkyen dbang gi theg pa gzhan du sgyur du rung ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ rkyen dbang gis theg chen lam du 'jug nges kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang gang rung yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ dang po nyid nas rang rgyal gyi lam du zhugs te rang rgyal gyi byang chub thob par nges pa'i rang rgyal gyi rigs can sgom lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal 'gre/ des na mthar thug la ltos te rigs ma nges pa med cing*/ rigs yin na/ mthar thug theg chen du nges pa'i rigs yin pas khyab/ theg chen du nges pa'i rigs yin na/ theg chen gyi rigs yin pas ma khyab ste/ nyan rang gi rigs rnams theg dman gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gal te nyan thos kyi rigs chos can/ theg chen gyi rigs yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ 'o na nyan thos kyi lam chos can/ theg chen gyi lam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ stobs mtshungs/ ma grub na/ der thal/ lam yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na/ nges pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ theg pa gsum po gang rung gi rigs gang zhig rkyen dbang gis gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du sgyur du mi rung ba'o/ ma nges pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rigs gang zhig gnas skabs theg pa gsum po gang rung gi rigs su ma nges pa'o// 'di la dbye na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gnas (143) skabs kyi ma nges pa'i rigs dang*/ lam zhugs kyi gnas skabs kyi ma nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam ma zhugs kyi sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs so// gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal du 'gyur nges kyi gcig car ba'i rgyun zhugs kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ theg dman du lhung nges kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs rnams so// 'di la kha cig rigs gang zhig rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du mi rung ba nges pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ rigs gang zhig rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du rung ba ma nges pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin gsungs pa mi 'thad de/

dang po la/ gnas skabs nyan thos su nges pa'i rigs chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ gnas skabs theg pa gsum po gang rung du nges pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ nges pa'i rigs med par thal/ gnas skabs theg pa gsum po gang du nges pa'i rigs yin na/ nges pa'i rigs yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ rkyen dbang gis der sgyur du mi rung ba ma yin par thal/ rkyen dbang gi theg chen du sgyur du rung ba'i theg dman gyi rigs

(144) yin pa'i phyir te/ rkyen dbang gis mthar thug theg chen du sgyur du rung ba'i theg dman gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mthar thug theg chen du nges pa'i theg dman gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ log sred can 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su sdod pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi rgyud kyi chos dbyings chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur phyi ma der thal/ ma nges pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs theg pa gsum po gang rung ma nges pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ theg pa gsum po gang rung gi lam du ma zhugs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du sgyur du rung ba ma yin par thal/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gsum po gang du yang sgyur du mi rung ba ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsod gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de de yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir te/ bdag nyid chen po'i thub pa dgongs gsal las/ sems tsam pa rigs chad pa 'dod/ dbu ma pa rigs chad pa mi 'dod mod/ 'on kyang 'khor ba mtha' med du sdod pa de dag ni don gyi rigs chad pa yin par lta ste/ dper na rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi byi ba'am/ rgya nag gi byis pa'i gtam rgyud bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don gyi rigs chad yin na/ rigs chad yin pas ma khyab bo// gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo (145) nas dbye ba la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ ngo bo nyid skur gnas 'gyur rung gi dri ma las ma grol ba'i dbyings so// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi thar lam gyis bsdus pa'i dri ma las ma grol ba'i dge rtsa gang zhig dri ma las rnam par dag pa na ye shes phyi ma gsum du 'gyur du rung ba'o// yang na mtshan nyid kyi zur dang po de gang zhig

dri mas rnam par dag pa na/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi gzugs sku gnyis su 'gyur du rung ba ste/ gang bzhag kyang gnad gcig go /de gnyis kyi rten gyi gang zag ni/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs sems can thams cad la yod/ rgyas pa'i rigs ni byang chub tu sems bskyed nas yod kyis ma bskyed pa la med do// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// 'di gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ni/ rgyud bla mar/ rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blang ba mchog yin no// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyas pa dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// mdor na/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam dang*/ rigs kyi nus (146) pa gong 'phel du rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rigs rnams don gcig ste/ 'di nyid las/ mdor na/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin na/ theg pa gzhan du ma zhugs par rang gi theg pa de nyid nus pa mthar thug sgrub nus pa ni gnad kyi don to zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa brten chos sgrub pa'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ nyan thos kyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs dang*/ rang rgyal gyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs dang*/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs dang gsum las/ phyi ma la/ 'dir bstan sgrub pa'i rten rigs bcu gsum du dbye ba sngar bshad zin pa ltar/ kha cig theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rigs yin na/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rigs yin pas khyab/ sbyor mthong bsgom gsum gang rung la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi chos dbyings yin na/ tshig rkang gnyis po de'i dngos bstan gyi chos dbyings yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs yin pa'i phyir te/

de'i rgyud kyi tshogs lam gyi rten rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de de yin par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi tshogs lam de de'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings la brten pa'i (147) phyir/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad chos dbyings la brten par bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sa bcu pa'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi lam la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi chos dbyings chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ byang sems bsgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems sa bcu pa'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'dir bstan theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rigs bcu gsum po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sa bcu pa'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi lam de 'dir bstan sgrub pa bcu gsum po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de gzhan gyi don gyi go rim dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa yang ma yin/ de ye shes stsol ba mi mnga' ba// 'jug pa zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa yang ma yin/ de rtogs pa yi ni zhes pa nas slob ma thun mong min nyid dang*/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa yang ma yin pa'i (148) phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de sa bcu pa'i rjes thob ye shes ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ de rgyun mtha'i ye shes ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ de sa bcu pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa sgrub pa'i rten du 'gyur tshul ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sems kyi chos dbyings de thabs kyis zin te/ dge rtsas bsad pa la rten rnam byang 'phags pa'i chos thams cad bskyed par byed pas na/ sgrub pa'i lam gyi rten zhes bya ste/ nyir snang du/ des na 'di ni chos kyi dbyings nyid 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs sgrub pa'i rten yin no zhes ston par byed do// ces gsungs pa'i phyir// zhib tu byas na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings la rten dgos pa yin no// lnga pa rigs su 'jog tshul ni/ rigs 'di nyid las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa ste// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ rigs gnyis po 'di sku gsum du gnas gyur gyi rgyu yin pas/ rigs zhes bya ste/ rigs kyi don ni rgyu'i don yin pas so// sgrub pa'i rten bstan zin nas// de'i 'og tu mtshon byed kyi chos lnga bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa 'chad de/ rigs bsad pa'i gang zag gis dmigs pa la sgro 'dogs bcad nas sgrub pa nyams su len dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di 'chad pa la mdor bstan/ cung zad (149) bshad/ rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa dag dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ dmigs pa de gang zhe na/ chos thams cad chos can/ 'dir bstan theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ zhes pa 'di byung*/ gnyis pa ni/ chos de yang dbye na gsum du yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ de yang dge la sogs pa yin// zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni 'dir bstan sgrub pa'i dmigs pa chos can/ khyod la rgyas par phye na brgyad yod de/ lam gyi sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos gnyis/

spang gnyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zag bcas zag med gnyis/ bden gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas/ slob ma nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i yon tan dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ 'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ tshig rkang phyi ma 'dis 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i chos rnams kyang sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin par bstan no// de sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de rnams da lta mngon sum du (150) rtogs pa ma yin kyang*/ 'bras bu mthar thug thob pa la yon tan de dag la sgro 'dogs chod nas bsgom pas nyams su blangs pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa yin no// sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bstan zin nas// de'i 'og tu sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ston te/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i don de yang ched du bya ba chen po gsum thob pa'i ched du 'bad pas nyams su blangs dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang ched dang ni zhes pa la 'phros nas/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba de gang zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gsum du yod de/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems chen po dang*/ de ltar byed pa'i spong pa chen po dang*/ de ltar byed pa'i rtogs pa chen po dang gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa na/ sems can kun mchog ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sems chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed don gcig 'di'i dngos bstan gyi spong ba chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi spong ba don gcig 'di'i dngos bstan gyi rtogs pa chen po dang*/ rnam mkhyen don gcig yin cing*/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba yin na/

theg chen sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ched du bya ba dang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug yin pas khyab pa yin no// kha cig theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba chen po gsum po gang rung yin na/ ched du bya ba 'dir shes bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi (151) ched du bya ba yin pas khyab/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ched du bya ba yin na/ ched du bya ba 'dir shes bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi ched du bya ba yin pas khyab/ sems can kun mchog zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems can gyi mchog yin na/ sems can yin pas khyab zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sems chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ theg chen sgrub pa'i gnas skabs kyi ched du bya bar gyur pa'i chen po gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ der gyur pa'i sems chen po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ der gyur pa'i sems chen po yod pa'i phyir te/ der gyur pa'i chen po gsum ka yod pa'i phyir te/ ched du bya dang mngon shes drug ces gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ched du bya ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la longs sku chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug yin pa'i phyir te/ 'bras bu chos sku yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ched du bya bar gyur pa'i chen po gsum po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi spangs rtogs gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ gzugs sku (152) yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ sems can kun gyi mchog yin pa'i phyir te/ de kun gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/

'gro ba kun gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ 'gro ba kun gyi bla ma yin pa'i phyir te/ ston pa sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na sla/ des na rigs drug gi sems can nas byang sems sa bcu pa'i bar ni/ sems can kun zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems can dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams ni kun mchog ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi mchog yin no// sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba bstan zin nas// de'i 'og tu sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo ston te/ ched du bya ba de yang sgrub pa rang gi ngo bos sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di la yul gyi sgrub pa dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi sgrub pa'i khyad par/ sgrub pa bzhi'i sa mtshams/ sgrub pa bzhi'i grangs dang go rim nges pa/ so so'i don la 'jug pa dang bzhi las/ dang po yul gyi sgrub pa dang*/ spyi'i sgrub pa dang*/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba min par gyur pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i nyams len rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam phal pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa de yin te/ de'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa de/ dkar po'i chos kyi rten gyi bya ba tsam gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub (153) pa yin zhing*/ phar phyin drug ldan gyi mngon rtogs nyams su len tshul la mkhas pa'i sgrub pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon par rtogs pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ bye brag gi sgrub pa dang*/ rnam rdzogs sbyor bas bsdus pa'i sgrub pa rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can yan chad kyi sgrub pa yin te/ de yan chad kyi sgrub pa de mngon par rtogs pa re re bzhin phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len tshul la mkhas pa'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam phal pa dang*/ khyad par can gyi khyad par ni/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag la thos bsam byed bzhin pa tsam las sngar bsgom pa lam bzhugs pas sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul lnga la mkhas pa'i dad sogs lnga ma thob pa'i tshogs lam ni/

tshogs lam phal pa dang*/ gdams ngag la thos bsam mthar phyin nas/ de'i don bsgom pas sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul lnga la mkhas pa'i dad sogs lnga thob pa'i tshogs lam ni/ tshogs lam khyad par can te/ 'di skad du nyir snang dang*/ don gsal gyi lung drangs pa des shes nus so// tshogs lam khyad par can la bdag med rtogs pas khyab/ phal pa la bdag med rtogs ma rtogs gnyis sa yod do// gnyis pa sa mtshams ni/ don gsal las/ de ltar ji lta ba bzhin du sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang bsgom pa dang*/ khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ go cha dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ tshogs dang*/ nges (154) par 'byung ba rnams zhes gsungs pas/ sgrub pa bzhi'i sa mtshams ston te/ go sgrub ni/ mthong lam la rgyud nas sbyor ba'i tshogs lam khyad par can nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ 'jug sgrub ni mthong lam la nye bar sbyor ba'i sbyor lam drod skad cig ma dang po nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ snying rje'i tshogs sgrub sogs tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga ni/ mthong lam la mngon sum du sbyor ba'i sbyor lam chos mchog chen po nas/ rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ sa'i tshogs sgrub ni/ sa bcu'i rjes thob na yod de/ sa'i yongs sbyong dang don gcig pa'i phyir/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub ni/ mthong lam dang bsgom lam mnyam bzhag na yod de/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam dang*/ bsgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub yin na/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ sa brgyad pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de/ de yin na/ dag sa'i nyams len khyad par can yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig sgrub pa bzhi phyi ma phyi ma la/ snga ma snga mas khyab zer yang ji ltar 'thad brtag par ya dgos so// gsum pa grangs dang go rim ni/ 'dir spangs bya mthong spang dang bsgom spangs gnyis spong bar byed pa la/
dang po go sgrub/ de nas 'jug sgrub sogs go rim nges pa can yin te/ 'jig rten gyi dmag dpon dpa' bo de pha rol gyi g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa la/ dang po go cha

(155) bgos pa/ de nas g.yul du 'jug pa/ de nas dpung gi tshogs ma lus par bsog pa/ de nas pha rol dang g.yul bskrad de/ de las rgyal ba dang bzhi yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang spang bya gnyis po de spong ba'i ched du bsam pas go bgos pa ni go sgrub/ sbyor bas tshul bzhin du zhugs pa ni 'jug sgrub/ gnyen po'i spung tshogs bsog ste spang bya dang g.yul bskrad pa ni tshogs sgrub/ mi mthun phyogs las nges par 'byung ba thob pa de nges 'byung sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na grangs dang go rim gnyis char nges so// de skad du nyi snang las/ go cha sgrub pa la sogs pa 'di rnams go rim gyi tshul 'di rigs pa nyid yin te/ go bgos pa ni 'jug go /zhugs pa ni dpung gi tshogs so// dpung gi tshogs bsog pa ni mi rgyal ba las rgyal bar thob pas nges par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs la/ de yang go bgos pa ni zhes pas go sgrub bstan/ 'jug go ces pas 'jug sgrub dang*/ zhugs pa ni dpung gi tshogs so zhes pas tshogs sgrub dang*/ de man chad kyi nges 'byung sgrub pa bstan pa shes par bya'o// bzhi pa so so'i don la lnga las/ dang po go sgrub ni/ go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ go sgrub gang zhe na/ 'di la sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi go sgrub sogs drug yod cing*/ drug po re re yang sdud byed kyi phar phyin de dang de'i nang du/ rang gi sdu bya'i phar phyin (156) drug tshang bar nyams su len pa'i nyams len khyad par can yin no zhes pa ni/ de dag so sor zhes pa nas drug mtshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug tshan drug ni sbyin pa lta bu gcig la sbyin pa'i sbyin pa nas/ sbyin pa'i shes rab kyi bar drug tshul khrims la yang tshul khrims kyi sbyin pa nas/ tshul khrims kyi shes rab kyi bar drug de bzhin du bzod pa sogs gzhan bzhi la'ang drug drug tu phye bas sum cu rtsa drug tu 'gyur ro// mdor na phar phyin re re'i nang du yang phar phyin drug tshang bar nyams su len cing*/

bsam pas go bgos pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yin no// skabs 'di'i phar phyin drug ni/ rgyu sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs kyi nyams len la/ phar phyin gyi ming btags pa tsam yin te/ phar phyin mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyu sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs kyang sa dang po nas yod par bzhed pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi slob lam yin na/ go sgrub yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam phal pa'i ma nges so// gnyis pa 'jug sgrub ni/ 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ 'jug sgrub gang zhe na/ 'jug sgrub chos can/ khyod la 'jug bya theg chen gyi sgo nas dgur yod de/ mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsam gtan gzhi la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bzhi la (157) 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ phar phyin drug la 'jug= byams sogs tshad med bzhi la= dmigs med kyi shes rab dang ldan pa la= 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa la= gnas skabs kyi ched du bya ba chen po gsum la= rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu mngon shes drug la= rnam mkhyen dngos la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang dgu yod do// ces pa ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med ces pa nas 'dzeg pa yin pa shes par bya/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mdor na rang gi 'jug bya'i theg pa dgu po gang rung la stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyi 'dzeg par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yin no// kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor mthong bsgom gsum po gang rung yin na/ 'jug sgrub yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ theg chen gyi mthong bsgom bar chad med lam rnams gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub tsam las/ go sgrub dang 'jug sgrub yin pa la shes byed med pa'i phyir/ gal te yin na go sgrub drug po gang yin dang*/

'jug sgrub dgu po gang yin smra dgos te/ dpyad pas gsal lo// gsum pa tshogs sgrub la/ tshogs bcu bdun spyir bstan pa/ rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshogs ni zhes pa las 'phros nas/ tshogs sgrub gang zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye (158) na bcu bdun yod de/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub dang*/ sbyin pa'i dang*/ tshul khrims kyi dang*/ bzod pa'i= brtson 'grus kyi= bsam gtan gyi= shes rab kyi= gzhan don la rtse gcig pa'i gzhi gnas kyi= stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi= shes rab dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i= gzhan don byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi= bsod nams kyi dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mthong ba'i lam gyi= mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyi= sī dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang bcu bdun yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ brtse dang zhes pa nas/ rim pa yin par shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mdor na tshogs bcu bdun po gang rung gi sgo nas mthar thug gi byang chub sgrub pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ don gsal las/ snying rje la sogs pa 'di dag gis yang dag par sgrub pa'i ngo bos byang chub chen po 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir/ snying rje chen po la sogs pa ni/ tshogs yin pa'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa rnam pa bcu bdun no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po thob pa'i sems dpa' rnal 'byor yin na/ tshogs sgrub yin pas khyab gsungs yang brtag par bya ste/ theg chen gyi mthong bsgom rnam grol lam rnams tshogs sgrub bcu bdun po gang yin dpyad na/ dka' bar (159) snang ngo*// gnyis pa rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ ye shes kyi tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang*// zhes pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs de la/ gzhung rtsa bar rgyas bshad dngos su med kyang*/ 'brel bar 'byung bas/ de bzhin bshad na ye shes kyi tshogs chos can/ khyod la yul stong nyid kyi sgo nas nyi shur yod de/ nang stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ phyi stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i dang*/ de gnyis ka= stong pa nyid stong pa nyid= chen po stong pa= don dam pa'i stong= 'dus byas stong= 'dus ma byas stong= mtha' las 'das pa stong= thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa stong= dor ba med pa stong= rang bzhin stong= chos thams cad stong= mtshan nyid stong= mi dmigs pa stong= dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong= dngos po stong= dngos med stong= rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs dang nyi shur yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ don gsal las/ nang dang phyi rol rnams dang ni// gnyis dang stong pa'i dngos po dang*// phyogs dang mya ngan 'das lam dang*// rkyen nas skyes dang gcig shos dang*// mtha' 'das thog ma dor ba med// rang bzhin dang ni chos kun (160) kun dang*// chos skye la sogs 'das sogs dang*// ldan dang gcig shos ngo bo dang*// mkha' dang stong pa zhes bya dang*// chos kyi gzhan gyi ngo bo nyid// rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir// stong pa nyid ni nyi shur 'dod// ces pas bstan/ sa mtshams ni/ dang po gsum tshogs lam nas/ bzhi pa sbyor lam nas/ lnga pa nas bcu gcig pa'i bar bdun ni rim pa bzhin/ sa dang po sogs ma dag sa bdun na yod/ bcu gnyis dang bcu gsum pa sa brgyad pa nas/ bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa sa dgu pa nas/ bcu drug pa dang bcu bdun pa bcu pa nas/ phyi ma gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi sar yod par slob dpon gyi 'grel chen las bshad do// de la ye shes kyi tshogs dang po gsum tshogs lam na yod kyang*/

de'i tshogs sgrub sbyor lam chos mchog chen po nas yod pa dang*/ stong nyid phyi ma gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes ya mtha' sangs rgyas sar yod kyang*/ de'i tshogs sgrub slob pa ma yin pas rnam dbye rnams shes par bya ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni chos sku thob byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bor gyur pa'i nyams len yin pas so// des na ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs sgrub la spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod do// gnyis pa sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa la/ sa dgu yongs sbyong gi sgo nas bstan pa dang*/ sa bcu pa la 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa'i tshogs sgrub pa dang*/ sa'i yongs sbyong don gcig ste/ nyi snang du sa'i tshogs na byang chub sems (161) dpa'i sa bcu po rnams so sor 'di nyid kyi yongs su sbyong ba'i dbye bas rnam pa bcur 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ gzhung rtsa bar rgyas bshad dngos su ma bstan kyang de'i rjes thog tu tshogs gnyis bsog pa'i nyams len khyad par can ni sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong yin no// des na 'dir sa dang po'i tshogs sgrub rgyas par bshad pa sogs dgu yod pa las/ dang po ni/ lam dang gzung dang sa bcu dang*// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ sa bcu'i tshogs sgrub gang zhe na/ rim bzhin bshad par bya ba las// thog mar sa dang po'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu yod de/ dge ba sgrub pa'i lhag bsam gyi yongs sbyong dang*/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i dngos po theg chen gyi chos 'dzin pa'i dang*/ sems can rnams la sems nye ring med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi dang*/ phyi nang gi bdog pa kun gzhan la gtong ba'i dang*/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa tshol ba'i dang*/ khyim na gnas pa la yid mi dga' bar nges par 'byung ba'i dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par 'dod pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/

gdul bya dang 'tshams par dam pa'i chos ston pa dang*/ dam bcas pa'i tshig bden par smra ba'i yongs sbyongs dang bcur yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis// zhes (162) pa nas/ tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bcu po 'di dag kyang*/ rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi brtsis zin te/ sa'i spang bya skyon spong zhing*/ yon tan gong 'phel du byed pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyongs shing*/ sa dang po ma lus par mthar phyin par byed pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ 'di dag ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ khyad chos 'di ni phyi ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// de bzhin du sa gnyis pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na brgyad yod de/ dge ba chos sdud sogs tshul khrims gsum la bslab pa'i yongs sbyongs dang*/ gzhan la phan par byas pa la drin gzo ba'i dang*/ gzhan gyi gnod pa la khong mi khro ba'i bzod pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la rab tu dga' ba'i dang*/ sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i dang*/ bla ma la phyag sogs kyis bkur stis dang*/ bla ma la gus pas chos ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin sgrub pa'i dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug la brtson pa'i yongs sbyong dang brgyad du yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ tshul khrims byas pa zhes pa nas/ brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa gsum pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyed la dbye na lnga yod de/ mngon par zhen pa'i rlom pa med pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos thos pas mi ngoms pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ zang zing gi bsnyen bkur 'dod pa med par chos ston pa'i dang*/ rang gi sangs rgyas (163) kyi zhing rten dang brten pa kun sbyong ba'i dang*/ phan lan du gnod pa byas kyang yid yongs su mi skyo ba'i dang*/ rang gzhan la ltos nas mi dge ba mi byed pa ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa'i yongs sbyong dang lngar yod pa'i phyir/

zhes pa ni/ thos pas zhes pa nas/ rlom med bdag nyid de rnams lnga// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa bzhi pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu yod de/ nags khrod dgon par gnas pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ rnyed pa ma thob kyang mngon par 'dod pa chung ba'i dang*/ rnyed pa thob kyang don gnyer dga' ba med pas chog shes pa'i dang*/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms pa sogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par sdom par bsten pa'i dang*/ bslab pa blang ba srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba dang*/ 'dod yon la nyes par lta ba'i smod pa dang*/ gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par myang 'das la 'god par gzhol ba'i dang*/ phyi nang gi bdog pa kun gtong ba'i dang*/ dge ba sgrub pa la sems mi zhum pa'i dang*/ dngos po la mngon zhen gyi lta ba med pa'i yongs sbyong dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ gnas nas zhes pa nas/ mi zhum pa lta ba med// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa lnga pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu yod de/ rnyed bkur gyi don du skye bo'i tshogs dang 'dris pa spong ba'i yongs sbyong dang*/ dad pa can gyi khyim la 'khren pa spong ba'i dang*/ skye bo mang po'i grong la sogs pa 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas la zhen pa spong ba'i dang*/ (164) bdag la bstod pa spong ba'i dang*/ gzhan la brnyas pa spong ba'i dang*/ mi dge ba'i las lam bcu spong ba'i dang*/ yon tan gyi rlom pas khengs pa spong ba'i dang*/ dge sdig la blang dor phyin ci log tu zhen pa spong ba'i dang*/ log lta la sogs pa'i blo ngan spong ba'i dang*/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum la bzod pa ste zhen pa spong ba'i yongs sbyong dang bcur yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ 'bris dang zhes pa nas/ sa lnga pa ni yang dag thob ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa drug pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/

sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs drug rdzogs pa'i yongs sbyong drug dang*/ gnyen po phar phyin drug rdzogs pas spang bya slob ma nyan thos la dga' ba'i sems dang*/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal la dga' ba'i sems dang*/ stong pa nyid la skrag pa'i sems spangs pa yongs spyod gsum dang*/ phyi nang gi bdog pa gang blang na'ang sems mi zhum pa dang*/ phyi nang gi bdog pa kun btang yang mi dga' ba med pa'i dang*/ rang nyid dbul yang slob pa po'i skye bo mi spong bar de'i re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i yongs sbyong dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni sbyin dang zhes pa nas sa ni drug pa yang dag thob// ces par gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa bdun pa'i tshogs sgrub kyi ngos skal gyi spang bya la nyi shur yod pas/ gnyen po yongs sbyong kyang nyi (165) shur yod pa las re zhig spang bya ni/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ sems can du 'dzin pa= srog tu 'dzin= gang zag tu= chad par= rtag par= mtshan mar= rgyur= phung por= khams su= skye mched du= khams gsum po la rtog pas 'dzin cing gnas pa dang*/ de la blang dor du 'dzin cing chags pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen thob mi nus snyam pas sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang*/ gzugs sku la sangs rgyas su lta ba'i mngon zhen dang*/ gsung rab yan lag drug bcu gnyis la chos su lta ba'i mngon zhen dang*/ zung bzhi ya brgyad la dge 'dun du lta ba'i mngon zhen dang*/ 'chal tshul gyi gnyen po la tshul khrims su lta ba'i mngon zhen dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid la the tshom za bas rtsod pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong pa nyid yin pa dang*/ snang cha mngon sum mthong ba 'gal bar 'dzin pa dang*/ nyi shur yod de/ nyes pa nyi shu po 'di rnams 'og gi yongs sbyong nyi shus spangs pa na sa bdun par rdzogs par thob ste/ brgyad pa na 'phos pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa ni/ bdag dang zhes pa nas/

de yis sa ni bdun pa thob// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan// des na sa bdun pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la spang bya de dag gi gnyen po'i sgo nas nyi shur yod de/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ 'khor gsum

(166) rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas dge bcu goms pa'i dang*/ skye bo kun la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i dang*/ dngos por mngon par zhan pa'i rlom pa med pa'i dang*/ chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i dang*/ mthar thug theg pa chen po'i tshul gcig tu shes pa'i dang*/ ming dang gzugs sogs mi skye bar shes pa dang*/ chos sku skye 'gag med pa la bzod pa shes pa'i dang*/ chos rnams gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par rnam pa gcig tu ston pa'i dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa'i dang*/ mtshan mar 'du shes pa spong ba'i dang*/ 'jig lta sogs lnga spong ba'i dang*/ nyon mongs pa chags sogs spong ba'i dang*/ gzhi gnas bsgom pa'i dang*/ bden med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong la mkhas pa'i dang*/ rtog pa'i sems nye bar zhi zhing dul ba'i dang*/ chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi dang*/ mngon par chags pa'i gnas ma yin par shes pa'i dang*/ rang nyid ji ltar 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu dus mnyam du 'gro ba'i dang*/ zhing kun tu gdul bya dang mthun par bdag gi lus sna tshogs su ston pa'i yongs sbyong dang nyi shur yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ rnam thar sgo gsum zhes pa nas// stong pa nyid dang nyi shu'o// zhes pa'i bar 'di byung*/ de bzhin du sa brgyad pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la brgyad yod de/ sems can kun gyi yid kyi spyod pa 'dod chags (167) dang bcas ma bcas sogs ji lta ba bzhin shes pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas rtse zhing rol pa'i dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snod kyi zhing gser gyi sa gzhi la baiḍū ryas spras pa yongs su sgyur ba'i dang*/ rnam pa kun tu chos la yongs su brtag dpyad bya bas sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa'i dang*/ sems can kun gyi dbang po dang khams sogs rdzogs par shes pa'i dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi bcud kyi zhing sbyong ba'i dang*/

thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i dang*/ sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba mkhyen bzhin pa'i blo sngon du btang nas skye ba len pa'i yongs sbyongs dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ sems can kun gyi yid ces pa nas/ las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sa dgu pa'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu gnyis su yod de/ smon lam mtha' yas pa ji ltar btab pa bzhin sgrub pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ lha la sogs pa'i sems can kun gyi skad shes pa'i dang*/ spobs pa chu bo ltar rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dang*/ bud med kyi skyon so gnyis dang bral ba'i ma'i mngal du 'jug pa chog gi dang*/ nyi ma sogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i dang*/ rgyal po sogs rus phun sum tshogs pa'i dang*/ sngon skyes bu dam pa byung ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i cho (168) 'brang gi dang*/ bsgo ba bzhin nyan pas 'khor dag pa'i dang*/ skyes ma thag 'jig rten gyi khams 'od kyis khyab cing sa rnam pa drug tu g.yo bar byed pas skye ba dag pa'i dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pas bskul te 'khor bye ba khrag khri brgya stong mang po dang lhan cig nges par rab tu 'byung ba'i dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i shing a shwad tha la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i yongs spyod dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs sogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i yongs sbyong dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang*/ zhes pa nas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de ltar na 'dir dngos bstan gyi yongs sbyong la grangs dgu bcu go lnga yod/ mkhas pa dag gi yongs sbyong thun mong ba bshad pa ni/ sa snga ma dang phyi ma'i yongs sbyong gi gzhi mthun yod par bzhed pa ma yin la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ smon lam mtha' yas pa'i yongs sbyong ni brgyad pa na yang yod/

dgu pa na yang yod pas yongs sbyong thun mong ba zhes smos la/ de bzhin du mngal du 'jug pa mchog gi yongs sbyong la sogs pa sa dgu pa dang bcu pa gnyis ka na yod pa sogs yongs sbyong thun mong ba mang du yod do// des na sa dang po la yongs sbyong bcu dang*/ gnyis pa la brgyad bshad pa sogs kyang sa de dang de'i rjes thob tu sbyong ba gtso (169) che bas de ltar yin gyis/ sa phyi ma rnams su'ang bsam pa'i yongs sbyong sogs dang*/ tshul khrims kyi yongs sbyong sogs med pa ma yin no// 'on kyang sa dgu la gzhung gi tshoms so sor bcad pa'i gzhung tshogs de dang de'i dngos bstan gyi yongs sbyong la/ sa de dang de'i yongs sbyong gi khyab po// gnyis pa sa bcu pa 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan pa ni/ dman sa sa brgyad dang*/ de'i steng du byang sems kyi sa bsnan pas sa dgu las 'das nas/ smon lam gyi mthus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sangs rgya ba'i sbyor ba shes pa'i ye shes ni/ 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i dgos pa gang gis sangs rgyas sar ming btags pa'i chos kyi sprin la gnas pa de ni chos can/ byang sems kyi sa bcu pa yin par shes par bya ste/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyi sgo nas nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kun la khyab cing*/ gdul bya la chos kyi char 'bebs pas so// zhes pa ni/ sa dgu 'das nas zhes pa nas/ bcu pa yin par shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'dir bstan 'das sa dang po rigs kyis ni/ gnas skabs theg dman du rigs nges pa'i sbyor lam gyi rtogs rigs dang*/ 'das sa gnyis pa brgyad pa'i sa ni rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ gsum pa mthong ba'i sa ni/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po'i rtogs rigs dang*/ bzhi pa srab pa'i sa ni/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po'i (170) rtogs rigs dang*/ lnga pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa na phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po'i rtogs rigs dang*/

drug pa byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ bdun pa nyan thos kyi sa ni/ nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas khyad par can gsum gyi rtogs rigs dang*/ brgyad pa rang rgyal gyi sa ni/ bse ru blta bu dang*/ tshogs ni spyod pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams yin pas/ 'dir bstan 'das sa dang po brgyad po gang rung yin na/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i theg dman gyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa yin no// 'das sa dgu pa byang sems kyi sa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sa dang po nas dgu pa'i bar la byang sems kyi sa zhes gcig tu bzhag pa yin no// gsum pa gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ gnyen po'i de la dbye na du zhe na/ 'dir bstan gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod la spang bya'i sgo nas brgyad yod de/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi dang*/ bsgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi ste/ brgyad du yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ mthong dang zhes pa nas gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gcig nyid kyi mthong lam gyi spang bya'i rtogs pa bzhi'i sa bon gcig char du spong (171) bar byed pas na/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhir 'jog dgos la/ de ltar na mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang po dang gnyis pa sogs don gcig de bzhin du sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam nas bcu pa'i bar chad med lam gyi bar dgu po re re yang*/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur pa'i bsgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi bzhir 'jog ste/ bsgom lam rtse sbyor bzhi bzhir 'jog tshul yang de bzhin no// nyang stod bka' chen pas/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub sbyor lam chos mchog chen po nas yod par bshad pa ni mi 'thad de/

de'i rgyu mtshan brtags na/ de rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs kyi spong ba gnyen po yin pa'i cha nas mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub yin pa'i dgongs rtse gtad mod/ 'o na theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod rtse bzod pa mnyam bzhag gsum kyang mthong spangs gnyen pa'i tshogs sgrub tu 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sa mtshams chos mchog chen po nas bzhag pa dang 'gal lo// bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ lus mdor bstan du nges par 'byung bcas rnams zhes pa las 'phros nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa gang zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la nges par 'byung ba'i sgo nas brgyad du yod de/ ched du bya ba nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang*/ mnyam pa nyid du dang*/ sems can (172) gyi don byed pa dang*/ 'bad med lhun grub dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dang*/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs thob pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du dang*/ lam gyi yul can du nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang brgyad du yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ ched du bya dang zhes pa nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mdor na rang gi nges par 'byung ba brgyad po gang rung du mtshan 'dzin gyi bar ma chod par 'byin par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// nges par 'byung ba dang po bdun sangs rgyas kyi sa dang*/ lam gyi yul can rgyun mtha' na yod par kun mkhyen bla mas bzhed la/ de ltar na dang po bdun du dngos su nges par 'byung ba rgyun mtha' na yod/ lam gyi yul du dngos su nges par 'byung ba rgyun mtha'i snga rol du yod do// skabs dang po bstan zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa lam shes ni/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid// ces pa la 'phros nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'og tu lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob pa la rgyu lam shes bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di la lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis/ dang po ni/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ lam shes kyi yan lag lnga po gang zhe na/ yan lag dang po 'gal rkyen dang bral ba'i yan lag ni/ lha rnams (173) zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa mthun rkyen yul nges pa'i yan lag ni/ yul nges pa dang zhes pas bstan/ lam shes kyi khyab pa'i yan lag ni/ khyab pa dang zhes pas bstan/ rang bzhin dang ni zhes pas rang bzhin gyi yan lag bstan/ de'i las zhes pas byed las kyi yan lag bstan/ de ltar lnga las/ yan lag dang po gsum po gang rung yin na/ lam shes dngos su skye ba dang rgyud nas skye ba gang rung gi rten gyi gang zag yin pas khyab/ phyi ma gnyis po gang rung yin na/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi yongs sbyong yin pas khyab po// mdor na chos lnga gang rung gis bsdus pa'i lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos de lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin no// 'dir kha cig gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur pa bcom pa'i byang sems so skye yin na/ lam shes dngos su skye rung gi gang zag yin pas khyab/ rang gi skad cig gnyis par de dngos su skye rung gi gang zag yin na/ de dngos su skye rung gi gang zag yin pas khyab/ lam shes skye rung gi sems can yin na/ khyab dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gang zag yin pas khyab/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs yin na/ nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba ni lam shes kyi rang bzhin yin no zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dgra bcom pa'i rtogs

(174) pa sngon song gi byang sems so skye yin pa'i phyir te/ de sngon song gi byang sems tshogs lam pa yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ lam shes rgyud nas skye ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po ma thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems tshogs lam pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems rgyun mtha' pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ rang gi skad cig gnyis par 'bras bu lam shes dngos su skye rung gi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis par rnam mkhyen dngos su skye rung gi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis par rnam mkhyen dngos su skye kha ma'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ de dngos su skye rung gi gang zag ma yin par thal/ de dngos su skyes zin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sbyor lam chos mchog chen po skad cig tha ma la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ lam shes dngos su skye rung gi sems can yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi 'phags lam dngos su skye rung gi sems can yin pa'i phyir te/ de dngos su skye kha ma'i sems can yin pa'i ra/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de dngos su skye kha ma'i sems can yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen 'phags par (175) 'gyur kha ma'i sems can yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ lam shes rgyud nas skye ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ skad cig gnyis par theg chen 'phags par 'gyur kha ma'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi 'khor ba'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la yid mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir te/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs brgyad po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa ni 'di dag gi ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir te/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la mi skyo ba dang*/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs brgyad gsungs pa'i gcig yin no// zhes bshad pa'i gcig po de bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba len pa la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ dge (176) rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs gnyis pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs bzhi par bshad 'dug pa'i phyir/ des na lha rnams zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi dngos bstan gyi gang zag dang*/ yul nges pa dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gang zag dang*/ lam shes dngos su skye rung gi rten gyi gang zag rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// khyab pa dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gang zag dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po ma thob pa'i sems can don gcig mtshan gzhi ni lam ma zhugs kyi sems can thams cad dang*/ nyan rang kun dang*/ chos mchog chen po ma rtogs pa'i byang sems tshogs sbyor ba thams cad do// rang bzhin dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rang bzhin dang*/

don gsal las/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i 'khor ba ji srid par sems can gyi don byed par bzhugs pa nyid kyi nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba ni/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin yin no zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyon mongs dang*/ dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs brgyad kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i nyon mongs gnyis pa rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni sngar smos pa ltar yin la/ 'di dag nyon mongs

(177) mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ sa dang po nas nyon mongs spangs zan pa'i phyir/ de'i las zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi las dang*/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan don mdzad pa phrin las don gcig go /gnyis pa yan lag can gyi lam shes la/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes sogs gsum las/ dang po la lam shes dngos dang*/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus mdor bstan du/ slob ma'i lam gang dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ shes bya'i lam de gang*/ de shes pa'i tshul de ji lta bu zhe na/ byang 'phags rang rgyud la yod pa'i nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i lam rnams 'di'i dngos bstan gyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin zhing*/ de shes pa'i tshul yang*/ rang rgyud kyi lam de mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sgo nas shes bya de gzhan don du mngon sum du shes par bya ba tsam yin gyis/ mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par bya ba ni ma yin te/ zhes pa ni/ lam shes nyid kyi zhes pa nas/ nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ der gyur pa'i rtse mo mnyam bzhag ni/ de dag mi dmigs pas/ rtse mor (178) mnyam bzhag ni/ de dag mi dmigs pas/ rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod// ces pas bstan/ der gyur pa'i bzod pa'i mnyam bzhag ni/ de la rtag la sogs tshul gyis// gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams// zhes pas bstan/ der gyur pa'i chos mchog mnyam bzhag ni/ sa bcu dag las zhes pa nas// mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'di dag gi dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam bzhi po gang rung yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med la bsgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pas khyab bo// 'dir kha cig shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin na/ nyan thos lam 'di zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam yin pas khyab/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/

nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes yin pas khyab/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes yin na/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ma yin pas khyab zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ de sems can gyi rgyud nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin par thal/ 'dod (179) pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan thos rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir te/ lam shes gang zhig khyod kyis de'i rgyud la yod pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ 'di nyid las/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan gyis 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs pa mkhyen par gsungs pa dang*/ zhes bshad pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'di nyid las/ rtogs rigs snga ma gnyis ni gzhan don du mthong lam mngon sum du shes par bya ba tsam yin gyis/ de yan chad du rgyud ldan du bsgom par bya ba ma yin pas shes par bya zhes pa'i tshig gi khyad par gsungs pa yin no// zhes bshad pa de 'thad pa'i phyir/

gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen (180) gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la yang rtsod gzhi de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags bsgrubs zin/ gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ rang rgyal rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gong gi rigs 'gre/ de nas shes bya nyan thos kyi lam la/ byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas shes par bya ba'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ gzhan rgyud la yod pa gzhan rig gi tshul gyis shes par bya ba'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang 'phags rang rgyud la yod pa'i nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mtha' dag yin zhing*/ gzhung 'dir dngos su smros pa ni/ slob ma'i lam gang dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ nyan thos lam 'di zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam rnams so// dngos bstan gnyis po 'di ni/ shes bya'i lam dang shes byed kyi lam shes gnyis ka yin pas/ nyan thos lam 'di zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ shes par bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes byed kyi lam shes don gcig go /gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa sogs dang*/ rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam rnams yin te/ de (181) rnams byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyis rtogs pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la shes bya dang shes byed ngo bo gcig pa dang*/ ngo bo tha dad pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ mi dmigs pas rnam pas zin pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi shes bya dang shes byed yin te/ des zin pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang*/

des zin pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rnams don gcig pas so// des mtshon nas byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas zin pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi des zin pa'i shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rnams don gcig de bzhin du byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas zin pa'i byang sems kyi rtogs rigs dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi des zin pa'i shes bya byang sems kyi lam dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rnams don gcig ste/ 'di nyid las/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas zin pa ni gnyis ka yin par grub bo// ces dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas zin pa'i tshes shes bya'i lam dang*/ shes byed kyi lam shes gnyis ngo (182) bo gcig yin pas lus rnam bzhag tu ni gsum char la yang shes par bya/ zhes pa'i tshig gi khyad par ma gsungs te/ sngar bshad zin to// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes bya dang shes byed ngo bo tha dad pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas ma zin pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ shes byed kyi lam shes gnyis tha dad gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i 'gal ba yin te/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas ma zin par mngon zhen can gyi gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs de shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin kyang*/ de shes pa'i lam shes ma yin pa'i phyir/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas zin pa dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi zin pa don gcig cing*/ de'i rnam pas zin pa dang*/ de'i rnam pa la khyad par yod de/ de'i rnam pa can gyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud la yod pa rnams 'dir dngos bstan gyi shes byed kyi lam shes yin zhing*/

nyan thos lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa sogs kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mi dmigs pa rnam pa dang*/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kyi gzhi mthun yin pa la gnod byed ma mthong ba'i phyir/ mi dmigs pa rnam pa dang*/ spros bral gyi rnam pa dag theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i phyir/ de skad du 'di nyid las/ de lta bu'i nyan thos kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs (183) de yang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs rigs mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas shes par bya dgos so// zhes bstan/ zhes dang*/ mi pham dgongs rgyan du'ang 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag gi rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa bcu drug po rnams rtogs rigs thun mong ma yin pa'i mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas zhes gsungs la/ de'i don yang mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa'am/ mi dmigs pa'i shes rab de theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yin par bzhed kyi/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi shes byed kyi lam shes la theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yod par bzhed pa ma yin no// legs par bshad pa 'dis kyang kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras dges pa'i byin brlabs bdag sogs rjes 'jug kun gyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig yang 'di nyid las/ shes bya byang sems kyi lam dang*/ de shes pa'i lam shes gnyis rtogs rigs gcig yin pa dang*/ rtogs rigs snga ma gnyis dang*/ de shes pa'i lam shes gnyis rtogs rigs tha dad yin par gsungs pa'i don ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam dang*/ de shes pa'i lam shes gnyis ka byang sems kyi rtogs rigs gtso che bas/ rtogs rigs gcig yin la/ rtogs rigs snga ma gnyis shes pa'i lam shes la/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs gnyis yod par ma zad/

byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi chos kyi (184) spyan gyis gzhan rgyud la yod pa gzhan rig gi tshul gyi shes pa'i skabs su shes byed kyi lam shes su gyur pa'i chos kyi spyan de theg chen gyi rtogs rigs gtso che bas shes bya dang shes byed rtogs rigs tha dad par 'chad do// gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi lam shes dang po gnyis ni/ shes bya dang shes byed gcig pas rtogs rigs kyang gcig par 'chad dgos pas gzhung gi dngos bstan sbyar ma sbyar dang*/ spyi dang bye brag gi rnam dbye 'chad par gyis shig mdor na nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa de lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig gi nang mtshan du gyur pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes sub zung ba'i ched du nyan thos lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mthong lam de skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin no// skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs so sor 'jog pas phan tshun 'gal zhing*/ spyir de gsum mi 'gal te/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan de nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ rang dang (185) rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa mtha' dag shes pas na/ lam shes gsum ka yin par grub cing*/ sangs rgyas sa'i lam shes kyang lam shes gsum ka yin te/ de nyan thos lam gyi dmigs pa rnam sogs gsum ka mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/

lam shes dngos dang*/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ dang po ni/ bse ru'i lam gang dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi lam gyi khyad par gang*/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi ye shes ni srid pa tha ma'i rten la gzhan la ma brten par rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byas shing*/ gdul bya la sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pas na nyan thos las khyad par du 'phags so// zhes pa ni/ rang byung bdag nyid ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de la 'phros nas sgra med pa dang chos ston pa 'gal lo zhe na/ de'i rtsod pa spong ba ni/ gang gang don ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ dri ba gnyis pa'i lan skabs don rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i tshul ni/ 'dir bstan shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam 'di nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs las khyad par 'phags te/ gzung rtog spong ba'i phyir dang*/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs las dman te/ 'dzin rtog (186) mi spong ba'i phyir dang*/ yang nyan thos las khyad par 'phags te/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rten rigs kyi khyad par du byas pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i khyad par gsum ldan gyi shes bya rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs de gzhan don du mthong lam du mngon sum du shes par bya ba yin no// zhes pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa zhes pa nas/ yang dag bsdus pa shes par bya zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la bzhi las/ dang po rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i drod mnyam bzhag ni/ rtags pa'i chos nyid ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ der gyur pa'i rtse mo mnyam bzhag ni/ rtse mor gyur pa gzugs la sogs// 'grib pa med la sogs pas phye// zhes pas bstan// der gyur pa'i bzod pa mnyam bzhag ni/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa yis// gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa// zhes pas bstan/

der gyur pa'i chos mnyam bzhag ni// gzugs sogs skye ba med sogs kyi// rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog /ces pas bstan/ gzhung tshig de dag gi dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi po gang rung yin na/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pas khyab bo// 'dir kha cig shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam yin na/ rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam zhes bya ba'i dngos bstan gyi lam yin pas khyab/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ yang dag (187) bsdus pa shes par bya/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes yin pas khyab/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ma yin pas khyab zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ rang rgyal rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs chos can der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal gong gi rigs 'gre/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa la yang*/ byang sems sa brgyad pa ba'i rgyud kyi chos kyi spyan chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal gong bzhin 'gre/ des nas bse ru'i lam gang dang zhes pa'i lam dang*/ rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ yang dag bsdus par shes par bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes byed kyi lam shes rnams don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug go 'di'i dngos bstan la yang sngar theg chen bsgom lam med de/ 'di nyid las/ skabs der bsgom lam ma bshad pa'i gnad kyang rtogs rigs de byang sems kyi bsgom lam du bsgoms par mi byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor na rang rgyal lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes mtshan nyid yin pa sogs gong gi rigs 'gres te shes par bya'o// gsum pa shes bya byang
