(188) sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/ mthong lam dang bsgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ theg chen mthong lam de gang zhe na/ bden pa bzhi la bzod pa dang*/ zhes pa'i skad cig ma bzhi bzhir phye ba'i sgo nas mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod do// zhes pa ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de dag kyang rim pa bzhin du mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ de chos shes dang*/ sdug bsngal rjes bzod dang*/ sdug bsngal rjes shes dang*/ kun 'byung chos bzod dang*/ de chos shes dang*/ kun 'byung rjes bzod dang*/ de rjes shes dang*/ 'gog pa chos bzod dang*/ de chos shes dang*/ 'gog pa rjes bzod dang*/ de rjes shes/ lam chos bzod dang*/ de chos shes dang*/ lam rjes bzod dang*/ lam rjes shes rnams bar ma chad par skye ba yin no// de dag rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad na/ de bzhin nyid dang de rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas phan tshun rnam grangs kyi gnas par khas mi len par/ nges par rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs dang*/ gzugs sogs don dam par chos nyid kyi ngo bo chen po yin pa la de ltar dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid 'jal byed kyi tshad ma med pa la dang*/ gzugs sogs de dag gi tshad gzung du med pa la nges par 'dren nus kyi bden pa mngon rtogs ni rim pa bzhin sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs bzhi'i (189) ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang zhes pa nas/ tshad med pa dang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba la nges par 'dren nus dang*/ gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid la gzhan gyi sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'dzin pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ don dam par blang dor dang skye 'gag med pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/

shes rab kyis zin pa'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa la nges shes 'dren nus kyi bden pa mngon rtogs rnams ni rim bzhin kun 'byung chos bzod sogs kyi ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ mtha' med dang zhes pa nas/ byams la sogs dang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du gzugs sogs rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid yin pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngos pas rang gi sangs rgyas thob pa la de 'dren nus dang*/ rnam byang gi rigs sbyin sogs sher phyin du 'dus pa la de 'dren nus dang*/ gzhan gyi 'jigs pas nyams nga ba dang*/ nang gi nyer 'tshe nad gdon sogs kun zhi ba la nges shes 'dren nus kyi bden pa mngon rtogs rnams ni rim pa bzhin 'gog pa chos bzod sogs kyi ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang zhes pa nas/ nad kun sel zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du sher phyin bsgoms pas myang 'das la bden 'dzin zhi ba la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi srung skyob mdzad pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ rjes thog tu srog gcod (190) spong ba la sogs pa'i dge bcu nas bzung*/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs kun nyams su len pa la rang nyid gnas shing*/ gzhan dag kyang de la 'god pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ sbyin sogs kyis dge rtsa gzhan don du rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i nus pa thob pa la nges shes 'dren nus kyi theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs rnams ni/ rim bzhin lam chos bzod sogs de dang de'i ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ mya ngan 'das 'dzin zhi nyid dang*// zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de ltar na lam shes kyi skabs kyi skad cig ma bcu drug gi rnam pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa de ltar yin no/ zhes pa ni/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma zhes pas bstan/ nges shes de dag 'dren pa'i nus pa mthong lam du thob nas gang du 'dren na rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su dngos su 'dren pa yin no// des na 'dir ni tshad ma smra ba'i grub mtha' dang mi 'dra bar nges shes la rtog pas ma khyab ste/

'phags lam du gyur pa'i nges shes du ma bshad pa'i phyir/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa la yang*/ rang yul mi gsal bar snang bas ma khyab ste/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag phal che ba sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin kyang*/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa sogs la gsal snang thob par bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug bshad pa las/ skad cig ma dang po sdug bsngal chos bzod kho na bar chad med lam yin te/ rtsa bar skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel pa don gsal las/ skad cig ma gcig pa sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pas (191) bsdus pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na skad cig ma phyi ma bco lnga mthong lam rnam grol lam yin zhing*/ bar ched med lam skad cig ma dang po kho na yin pa ni/ mdzod kyi lugs la mthong lam bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam du 'dod pa dang*/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi lugs la mthong lam chos bzod bzhi bar chad med lam du 'dod pa sogs grub mtha' 'og ma'i mthong lam gyi 'dod tshul las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i lugs mchog 'di'i rjes su 'brang ba dag ni skal pa bzang bar shes par bya'o// gzhan dag gi 'dod pa ni mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi grub mtha' bsres nas ca col smra ba snang bas/ don dang ldan par ma mthong la// kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa ni// rgyal ba mi pham mgon po dang*// 'phags seng sogs rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams dang*/ bod kyi rjes btsun gong ma sogs tshad ldan gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig pa yin no// //'dir smras pa/ yab gcig kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed srol ni// mi pham zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i snying po kun// gcig tu spungs 'dra skal ldan lha bu yis// thob kyis lha min rnams la ci byar yod// dpyod ldan kun kyang lta grub bzang po 'di'i// rjes zhugs tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom pa yi// ngal bas dal 'byor lus 'di don yod par// byas na legs sam snying nas bsam par rigs// zhes kyang gdams so//

(192) 'dir kha cig byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam yin na/ phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa nas bya ba 'di ni bsgom pa'i lam// zhes pa'i bar gyi dngos bstan gyi lam yin pas khyab/ rgyud byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi mthong lam yin pas khyab/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs su gyur pa'i shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas ma zin par mngon zhen can gyi gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshan 'dzin mngon gyur du ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong bsgom gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ mtshan 'dzin yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ (193) sa dang po rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sa dang po rjes thob pa de byang sems mthong lam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa yod pa'i phyir te phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su gyur pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa yod pa'i phyir te/

blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam ma yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la yang*/ sa dang po rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi byang sems rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang*/ sa gnyis pa thob pa'i bsgom lam gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mos pa bsgom lam sogs kyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas 'jog par bshad pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de gang rung ma yin par thal/ sa dang po'i rjes thob (194) ye shes yin pa'i phyir te/ sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ byang sems lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ de mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa chos bcu gcig gi nang tshan du gyur pa'i shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i rgyu lam shes kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gdul bya byang sems kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba dang*/ rang nyid rgyud ldan du bsgom pa gang rung gi ched du byang sems lam gyi dmigs rnams mi dmigs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong bsgom mnyam bzhag gang rung du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ 'di la mthong bsgom gnyis ka yod do// yang chos dbyings mngon sum du mthong ba'i mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs gang zhig

theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi skabs don du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun skabs dang por bstan zin pa la dgongs nas 'dir dngos su ma bstan pa'i gnad kyis kyang*/ 'dir bstan shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes su gyur pa'i mthong bsgom gnyis ka theg chen gyi (195) rtogs rigs yin par grub bo// kha cig skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi mthong lam yin na/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab zer ba/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs skabs don gyi mthong lam la blo rtse gtad kyang*/ cung zad sbom yor te/ nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mthong lam yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsod gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na sla/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi mthong lam theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su nges na/ 'di nyid las/ byang sems kyi mthong lam skad cig ma dang po chos can/ skabs gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i sdug bsngal chos bzod yin te/ zhes sogs dang*/ de bzhin du skabs gsum pa nas bstan pa'i sdug bsngal chos bzod yin te zhes sogs rtags 'god dang bcas te gsungs pa nang 'gal lo zhe na/ 'di dag ni khyad bzhi chos can la zhib cha ma sbyar bar gzhung lugs kyi go babs spyi lam pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin pas/ don la skyon med de/ bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnams las kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du byung bas skyon gtong pa ga la rigs/ 'on kyang rigs lam du zhugs pa'i rtsod ngor zhib (196) cha sbyar dgos pas/

de'i tshe na theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i mthong lam skad cig ma dang po chos can du gzung nas skabs gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i sdug bsngal la chos bzod yin pa'i shes byed du gtan tshigs 'god pa yin la/ de bzhin du theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma dang po chos can du gzung nas skabs gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i sdug bsngal la chos bzod yin pa'i shes byed du sdug bsngal bden pa rtag mi rtag gi spros pa dang bral ba la nges shes rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i mnyam bzhag yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i gtan tshigs 'god pa yin zhing*/ de bzhin du skad cig ma gnyis pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar la yang rtogs rigs de dang der gyur pa'i zhes zhib cha sbyar nas yin no// gzhan du na skabs gsum pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi mthong lam la theg dman gyi rtogs rigs kyis ma khyab par gyur la/ de ma khyab na/ 'di nyid las/ skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bas/ rang gi grub mtha'i sde snod dang 'gal 'gro bas zab 'tshal lo// de ltar na kun mkhyen chen po'i gzhung lugs tshig rling zhing don rgya che ba 'di rnams gong 'og gi bab sgrigs nas grub mtha'i skyongs lugs shes dgos so// gnyis pa bsgom lam la/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi bsgom lam gnyis/ (197) dang po ni/ byed pa dang ni mos pa dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa gang zhe na/ 'dir bstan bsgom gyi byed pa drug yod de/ sems rgyud zhi zhing dul ba dang*/ skye bo dam pa thams cad la 'dud pa dang*/ bsgom spangs nyon mongs las rgyal ba dang*/ me chu mtshon sogs kyi gnod pas rdzi ba med pa dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa dang*/ rten bsgom lam pa zhugs pa'i sa phyogs kyang mchod pa'i zhing du byed pa dang drug tu yod pa'i phyir/

zhes pa ni/ kun nas zhi dang zhes pa nas/ rten mchod nyid ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mdor na theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de theg chen gyi bsgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ 'dir bstan byed pa drug po gang rung yin na/ bsgom lam ma yin pas khyab bo// gnyis pa byed pa can la mos pa bsgom lam sogs lnga las/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ phan yon gnyis/ dang po ni/ mos pa dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ 'dir mos pa bsgom lam chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ mos pa rang gi zhes pa nas/ rnam gsum shes bya zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum po de la yang chung 'bring chen po gsum du dbye bas/ so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod cing*/ de gsum chung ngu la/ chung ngu'i chung ngu*/ chung ngu'i 'bring*/ chung ngu'i chen po/ 'bring la/ 'bring gi

(198) chung ngu*/ 'bring gi 'bring*/ 'bring gi chen po/ chen po la/ chen po'i chung ngu*/ chen po'i 'bring*/ chen po'i chen po dang gsum du dbye bas/ de ltar na mos pa bsgom lam nyi shu rtsa bdun du yod do// zhes pa ni de yang ni/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mdor na/ theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig sher phyin rang don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa dang*/ de gang zhig sher phyin gnyis don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa dang*/ de gang zhig sher phyin gzhan don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa ni/ rim bzhin rang don mos pa bsgom lam dang*/ gnyis don mos pa bsgom lam dang*/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin no// mtshan nyid 'di bzhin ltar na/ mos pa bsgom lam la sems byung gi khyab la/ gtso sems dang sems 'byung gnyis ka yod par bzhed na/ mos pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zhe sbyor/ mos pa bsgom gyi mos yul gyi sher phyin dang*/ 'bras bu sher phyin don gcig bsgom lam gsum po 'di'i sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar gyi rjes thob so so na yod de/ rang don mos pa bsgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu dang*/ sa gnyis pa rang don mos pa bsgom lam don gcig de chung ngu'i 'bring dang*/ sa gsum pa'i rang don mos pa bsgom lam don gcig pa nas de chen po'i chen po dang*/ sa bcu pa'i rang don mos (199) pa bsgom lam don gcig pa'i bar du shes par bya zhing*/ des gnyis don dang*/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam dgu sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar la 'jog tshul yang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa phan yon ni/ bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ gang la bstod bkur bsngags pa yin zhe na/ sher phyin rang don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa la bstod pa dgu dang*/ gnyis don mos pa la bkur ba dgu dang*/

gzhan don mos pa la bsngags pa dgu mdzad pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ mdor na/ mos pa bsgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir du mos pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi cha de 'dir bstan mos pa bsgom lam gyi phan yon gyi mtshan nyid 'di yin na/ sher phyin gyi mdo tshig yin pas khyab bo// gnyis pa bsngo ba bsgom lam ni/ mdor bstan du/ bsngo dang rjes su yi rang dang*/ yid la byed pa bla med dag ces pa la 'phros nas/ bsngo ba bsgom lam gang zhe na/ 'dir bstan bsngo ba bsgom lam chos can khyod la khyad chos bcu gnyis yod de/ spyi'i rang bzhin gnyis ni/ mos pas bsags pa'i dge ba bla med byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba/ nyan rang las khyad par du 'phags pa dang byed las gzhan la lam ston pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pas mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ (200) rdzas la zhen pa 'gog pa'i phyir bsngo bya'i rdzas dmigs med du rtogs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ bsngo byed kyi sems la zhen pa 'gog pa'i phyir 'du shes dang lta bar phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid can dang*/ bsngo ba byed pa po la zhen pa 'gog pa'i phyir// bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de bya byed kyi dbyen par shes pa dang*/ bdag dang sangs rgyas kyi dge ba tha dad du mi lta ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin kun rdzob tu skye zhing*/ don dam par skye 'gag med pa'i chos nyid du dran pa'i spyod yul can dang*/ phyin drug rjes su sgrub pas na thabs shes bzung 'brel dang bcas pa ste/ dngos por mngon zhen 'gog pa lnga dang*/ stong nyid kyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa med pas dngos med du zhen 'gog pa gcig dang*/ zung 'jug gi rnam pa ni lam thams cad kun rdzob tu snang cha ma dor zhing*/ don dam du mi dmigs pas sangs rgyas kyi rjes su yi rang byin pa dang*/

mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas khams gsum 'khor bar lhung ba ma yin pa dang*/ rnam pa'i rab dbye ni/ chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i bsngo ba dang gsum du dbye ba'i khyad par bcu gnyis su yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de ltar chung 'bring che gsum du dbye ba'i bsngo ba (201) de yang 'bras bu bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bdag nyid yin no// zhes pa ni/ bsod nams che chung bdag nyid do// zhes pas bstan/ 'dir bstan bsngo ba bsgom lam yin na/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can la sogs pa'i khyad chos bcu gnyis dang ldan pas ma khyab ste/ bsngo ba bsgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dbye ba khyad par chung 'bring che gsum dang mi ldan pa'i phyir te/ khyod la chung 'bring che gsum du dbye rgyu med pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na sa gnyis pa thob pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam rjes thob ye shes gang zhig dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa 'dir bstan bsngo ba bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin no// 'dir bstan bsngo ba bsgom lam la/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ chung ngu'i chung ngu nas/ chen po'i chen po bar dgu yod pa las/ chung ngu'i chung ngu dang*/ sa gnyis pa'i bsngo ba bsgom lam don gcig pa nas chen po'i chen po dang sa bcu pa'i bsngo ba bsgom lam don gcig pa'i bar ni mos pa bsgom lam gyi skabs ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa rjes su yi rang bsgom lam ni/ rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla med dag ces pa la 'phros nas/ rjes su yi rang bsgom lam gang zhe na/ thabs khyad par can dang mi dmigs pa'i shes rab zung 'brel gyi sgo nas dge ba'i

(202) rtsa ba la dad pas yi rang gi dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ rjes su yi rang gi bsgom lam yin par 'dir brjod do ces pa ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ des na sa gnyis pa thob pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam rjes thob ye shes gang zhig dge rtsa la dga' ba yang dag par bsgom pa'i dad pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa 'dir bstan rjes su yi rang gi bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin no// dbye na chung ngu'i chu ngu nas chen po'i chen po'i bar dgu sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar la sbyor tshul sngar ltar ro// mos bsngo rjes su yi rang gi bsgom lam gsum la/ 'phags seng gi 'grel par/ zag bcas bsgom lam du bshad pa yod kyang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dang bcas pa la zag bcas kyi ming gi btags pa tsam yin gyis/ zag bcas mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgrub pa'i bsgom lam ni/ sgrub dang zhes pa la 'phros nas// sgrub pa bsgom lam gang zhe na// chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag sbyor ba nyer rtogs kyi lam dang*/ bar chad med lam gyi bsdus pa rnams ni sgrub pa bsgom lam de'i ngo bo dang*/ de ni shes rab kyis mi zin pa'i sbyin sogs kyi nyams len las khyad par du 'phags pas mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ de'i rnam pa ni chos kun skye med du rtogs pas kun la mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang*/ de'i byed (203) las ni gnas skabs su rang rgyud la chos rnams dmigs su med par rtogs pa bskyed cing mthar thug don chen po sangs rgyas nyid du byed pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de'i ngo bo nyid mchog nyid ces sogs tshig bcad gcig gis bstan/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa bsgom lam de yang*/ mthun rkyen rgyu tshogs tshangs shing*/ 'gal rkyen bar chad spong ba'i sgo nas sgrub dgos pas/ mthun rkyen ni sangs rgyas rten dang zhes sogs rkang pa gsum dang*/

'gal rkyen ni chos kyi 'phongs pa'i zhes sogs rkang pa lngas bstan/ sgrub pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi bsgom spangs shes sgrib kyi spong ba gnyen po'o// 'di la dbye na sa gnyis pa'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang*/ bar chad med lam nas bcu pa'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang*/ bar chad med lam gyi bar dgu gnyis bco brgyad du yod do// lnga pa rnam dag bsgom lam ni/ shin tu dag pa shes/ bya ba 'di ni bsgom pa'i lam// zhes pa las 'phros nas/ rnam dag bsgom lam gang zhe na/ 'di la spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad par so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i 'og ma gsum gyi rnam dag so so'i ngos skal gyi dri ma tsam dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag dri ma kun gyi rnam par dag pas na/ rnam dag de'i yul gzugs sogs kyang 'phags pa (204) 'og ma gsum gyi gzigs ngo na ngo skal gyi dri ma so sos rnam par dag pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang la dri ma kun gyi dag pa yin no// zhes pa ni 'bras bu dag pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib tsam gyi dag pa'i phyir na/ nyan thos kyi rnam dag dang*/ de dang shes sgris gzung rtog tsam gyis dag pa'i phyir na/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag dang theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi sgrib gsum dag pa'i phyir na/ byang sems kyi rnam dag dang*/ sgrib pa ma lus pa dag pa'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag tu 'jog cing*/ de rnam dag shin tu ba yin no// zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ skabs don theg chen gyi rnam dag bsgom lam ni/ rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste/ zhes pa 'dir ston kyang 'di'i dngos bstan gyi rnam dag la rnam dag bsgom lam gyi ma khyab ste/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi rnam dag dang*/

byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rnam dag 'dus byas dang*/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rnam grol lam rnams don gcig pas/ byang sems kyi mthong lam rnam grol lam rnams 'di'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems kyi rnam dag yin no// theg chen gyi rnam dag bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes gang zhig (205) rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol de'o// sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khams gsum sa dgu po re re la sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po nas chung ngu'i chung ngu bar dgu yod pa thams cad theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam chung ngu'i chung ngu nas/ bsgom lam bar chad med lam chen po'i chen po'i bar dgu po des spong ba gnyen po byas nas rim pa can du spong ba gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ni gnyen po de kun rdzogs pa'i rjes su byung ba'i rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ sa dgu la ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'dis ni gnyen po chung rim nas skye ba dang*/ spang bya che rim nas 'gag pa bstan zhing*/ 'dir bstan bsgom lam bar chad med lam chung ngu dang*/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam don gcig chung ngu'i 'bring dang sa gsum pa'i bar chad med lam don gcig chung ngu'i chen po dang sa bzhi pa'i bar chad med lam don gcig 'dir bstan bsgom lam bar chad med lam 'bring gi chung ngu dang*/ sa lnga pa'i bar chad med lam don gcig pa nas/ 'dir bstan bsgom lam bar chad med lam chen po'i chen po dang*/ sa bcu pa'i bar chad med lam don gcig pa'i bar du shes par bya'o// (206) de ltar na sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam des 'dod par sa gcig bsam gtan sa bzhi/ gzugs med sa bzhi ste/ sa dgu'i bsgom spangs chen po'i chen po dgu'i gnyen po cig char byed pa nas/

sa bcu pa'i bar chad med lam des sa dgu pa'i bsgom spangs chung ngu'i chung ngu dgu'i gnyen po cig char byed pas na/ 'dir bstan bsgom spangs la dgu dgu brgyad bcu gya gcig yod la/ de bzhin du gnyen po bar chad med lam re re yang sa dgu pa'i spang bya dgu re spong ba'i ldog pa nas bar chad med lam dgu rer 'gyur bas theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam brgyad cu gya gcig tu brtsi ba yin no// sa dgu la ni zhes sogs la 'phros nas/ kha cig na re/ gnyen po chung ngu'i spang bya chen po sel ba mi srid pas spang gnyen skye 'gag gi rim pa de mi 'thad do zhes na/ de'i rtsod pa spong ba ni skyon med de/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma rags pa 'bad pa chung ngu'i sel la/ phra mo sel ba la 'bad pa chen po dgos pa'i dpes spang gnyen gyi rim pa de 'thad pa yin no zhes pa na/ de la klan ka spangs pa yi zhes pas bstan/ de ltar na byang sems kyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam de/ khams gsum gyi shes bya dang*/ shes bya mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs pa'i yul chen yin pas/ khams gsum sa dgu'i bsgom spangs shes sgrib ma (207) lus pa'i gnyen por grub bo// zhes pa ni/ lam ni 'jal dang zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ des na gnyen po chung ngu'i chung la sogs pa'i lam ni zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ lam ni 'jal dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam dang*/ gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gnyen po rnams don gcig cing*/ de la nang sel phye na theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam dgur yod do// lam shes kyi skabs bstan zin to// ༈ //gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid ces pa las 'phros nas/ lam shes kyi 'og tu gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam legs par shes pa la/ gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po rab dbye shes dgos pa'i ra/

'di 'chad pa la/ skabs gnyis pa'i lam shes rnam par dag byed kyi gzhi shes dang*/ skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ thos bsam gyi yul rnam par bsdu ba'i ched du go rim bzlog ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po la/ gzhung gi 'brel dang mtha' bcad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam ni 'jal dang gzhal bya dag /zhes pa'i skabs su theg chen gyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag dgu khams gsum gyi (208) rnam pa can gyi shes pa dang*/ shes bya mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i lam shes su bstan pa la/ 'o na rtogs pa de tsam du nges sam zhe na/ der ma zad 'khor 'das bar gsum la mi gnas pa dang*/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas skabs gnyis par bshad pa'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag de dag skabs gsum pa 'dir gzhi shes kyis bsdus pa'i lam sher phyin du 'dod pa yin no zhes pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'di ni mdor bstan du/ shes pa'i srid la mi gnas dang*// snying rje zhi la mi gnas dang*// zhes gsungs pa de'i rgyas bshad yin no// tshu rol mtha' la min/ de dag ces sogs kyis shes rab chen pos srid mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ pha rol mtha' la min/ de dag zhes sogs kyis snying rje chen pos zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes ston/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// thabs kyi ring ba ma yin nyid// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ 'bras yum la ring ba dang*/ nye ba'i gzhi shes gang zhe na/ de lta bu'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs kyi sher phyin de ni/ rjes thob tu mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod na/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pas/ 'bras yum la ring ba dang*/ mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs

(209) la spyod na rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pas/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes yin no zhes pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i rab dbye gang zhe na/ 'dir bstan mi mthun phyogs ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mtshan 'dzin dang*/ gnyen po ni byang sems kyi rgyu mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab yin pas/ spang gnyen so sor sbyar na/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid la spyod pa po nga'o snyam pa'i 'du shes nas/ byang chub kyi phyogs rnams la spyod pa po nga'o snyam pa'i 'du shes kyi bar ni/ btags pa tsam gyi gang zag la dmigs pa'i mtshan 'dzin yin pas/ 'dir bstan mi mthun phyogs yin no zhes pa ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi btags pa tsam gyi ngar 'dzin dgag pa'i mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab des ni rang gzhan chags pa'i mtha' 'gog nus pas/ mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin no zhes pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ yang 'bras bu la thob byar zhen pa dang*/ lam nyams su blang byar zhen pa dang*/ gzhi la dmigs par zhen pa'i blo rnams ni chags pa phra mo dang*/ btags pa tsam (210) gyi chos la dmigs pa'i mtshan 'dzin yin pas/ 'dir bstan byang sems kyi lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin no zhes pa ni/ rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra zhes pas bstan/ de dag mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i sgrub byed ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis// dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid// ces pas bstan/ chags pa phra mo de'i gnyen po gang zhe na/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang bzhin gcig tu shes pa'i shes rab des chags pa phra mo spong nus pas/

'dir bstan gnyen po gzhi shes yin no zhes pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// shes pas chags pa spong ba yin// zhes pas bstan/ rang bzhin gcig pa'i tshul ji ltar zhe na/ de ni rtogs pa dka' zhing bsam gyis mi khyab bo// zhes pa ni/ mthong ba la sogs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ mdor na byang sems 'phags pas rjes thob tu btags pa tsam gyi gang zag dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i mtshan 'dzin mi mthun phyogs dang*/ rjes thob tu btags pa tsam gyi gang zag dang*/ chos la mi dmigs pa'i mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyen po yin pa de/ skabs gsum pa gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir spang gnyen gyi rim pa yin no// zhes don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig gis bstan/ mi mthun phyogs zhes pas theg dman gyi gzhi (211) shes bstan par bzhed pa ni/ 'di'i thad kyi mdo sbyor rnams dang 'gal zhing*/ nyi snang gi mgo 'jug gang na'ang de ltar bshad pa med pas mi 'thad ces kun mkhyen bla mas gsung pa shin tu legs pa yin no// gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa ni/ 'dir kha cig srid mtha' dang*/ zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin pas khyab/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes yin na/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin pas khyab/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes yin na/ de ni thabs la mkhas pa yis// yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad// ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ srid zhi'i mtha' las grol ba'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin par thal/

'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rang gi rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin 'byung nges kyi sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir te/ de la ring ba'i sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag ye shes yin (212) pa'i phyir te chos can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag tu 'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par 'jog tshul gcig yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin par thal// 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di skabs gnyis pa'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes ston pa'i gzhung tshogs la 'phros pa'i 'phros tshul gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ mthong lam mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir te/ sa dang po'i mthong lam mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mtshan 'dzin spangs pa'i gzhi shes gang zhig 'bras yum ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ dag pa sa gsum gang rung gi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ dag pa sa gsum gang rung gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mnyam (213) bzhag ye shes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de ni zhes pa mnyam bzhag la byas nas/ mtshan mar dmigs ma dmigs rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su 'byung ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ des na tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin no/

theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pas khyab ste/ de yin na skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes su gyur pa'i bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes la theg pa gsum ka'i rtogs rigs yod pa khas blangs kyang chog dper na skabs gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i bsgom lam mnyam rjes rnams theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kyis khyab cing*/ de'i dngos bstan gyi bsgom lam rnams la theg dman gyi rtogs rigs yod par khas blangs kyang 'gal ba med pa bzhin no// 'on kyang tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes la mthong lam dang bsgom lam rjes thob med de/ mthong lam ni 'og tu 'byung ba la dgongs nas 'dir ma 'chad pa'i phyir/ bsgom lam rjes thob rnams ni/ rang nyid rjes thob yin pas/ rjes thob tu mtshan mar dmigs ma dmigs kyi rnam bzhag byar med pa'i phyir ro// 'dir bstan srid mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi (214) mtshan nyid ni/ dus gsum rang bzhin mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' gnon par nus pa'i byang 'phags kyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes dang*/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' gnon par nus pa'i byang sems kyi bsgom lam bzhag bzhag ye shes so// yang byang sems kyi rgyud kyi srid mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ de'i zhi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ phal cher snga ma ltar la mjug tu byang sems kyi mkhyen pa zhes sbyar ro// sa mtshams sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob na yod/ de bzhin du 'bras yum nye ring la yang spyi tsam pa dang*/

gzhung gi dngos bstan gnyis su byed dgos pas/ dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na/ rang gi rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin 'byung nges kyi byang sems kyi bsgom lam bzhag ye shes skabs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ rang gi rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin mi 'byung bar nges pa'i byang sems kyi bsgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes skabs gsum pa'i 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas nas/ rang gi rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin 'byung nges kyi byang 'phags kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes dang*/ mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la (215) spyod pa'i gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gang rung gi bsdus pa'i gzhi shes de/ byang sems kyi 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ yang byang sems ma sbyar ba spyir 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin byas kyang*/ chog ste/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes de 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de 'bras yum la nye ring gi rnam bzhag med pa'i phyir te/ de la 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas mi mkhas kyi rnam bzhag med pa'i phyir te/ de 'bras yum sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i gzhi shes ma yin pa'i phyir/ de theg dman gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ yang rang gi rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin mi 'byung bar nges pa'i byang 'phags kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes dang mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gang rung gi bsdus pa'i gzhi shes de 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes sa dang po'i mnyam rjes nas bdun pa'i mnyam rjes kyi bar na yod/

'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes sa dang po'i mnyam rjes nas bcu pa'i mnyam rjes kyi bar na yod do/ des na gnad kyi don ni/ byang sems 'phags pas rjes thob tu mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i gnas skabs kyi sbyin sogs de (216) byang sems kyi spyod pa dang dge ba yin kyang lam ma yin te/ de lam yin na/ de byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lam yin dgos pa las/ de ni byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ de rnal 'byor mngon sum ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de mtshan 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de mtshan mar dmigs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i gnas skabs su byang 'phags kyi lam med pa ma yin te/ de'i gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags kyi rgyud la lam yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags kyi rgyud la byang sdom yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de'i gnas skabs kyi byang 'phags chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la byang sdom yod par thal/ khyod byang sdom thob la ma btang ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ gnad kyi don ni/ mtshan 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur du ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud la lam gyi nyams len mngon gyur pa rgyun chad pas/ lam mngon 'gyur du med kyang*/ spyir de'i rgyud la lam yod de/ de'i rgyud la lam dbang ldan gyi tshul gyi yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab na/ byang sdom gyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du dbang ldan rgyun chags pa smos pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro// de skad du/ 'di nyid las/ rgyu gang gis nye ring du 'jog pa ni/ rjes thob tu sbyin sogs (217) la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan mar mi dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'jog dgos te/ mtshan mar mi dmigs na rjes thob kyi nyams len khyad par can du 'gyur zhing*/

mtshan mar dmigs na mtshan 'dzin gyi bar gcod yin pas/ rjes thob kyi nyams len rgyun chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang lam gyi nyams len mngon gyur ba rgyun chad pa la dgongs pa yin no// gzhan du na/ theg chen sems bskyed rgyun chad pa'i byang 'phags yod par 'gyur ro// mdor na mtshan 'dzin mngon gyur du ldan pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud la dbang ldan gyi tshul gyis yod pa'i lam dang mkhyen pa kun 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes su shes par bya'i// mtshan mar dmigs mi dmigs kyi sgo nas mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po gzhi shes kyang 'jog dgos pas/ byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mtshan 'dzin mngon du gyur pa dang*/ skabs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs don gcig dbye ba sngar song zin/ sa mtshams sa dang po'i rjes thob nas bdun pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i bar na yod/ ma dag sa bdun gang rung la gnas pa'i byang 'phags rjes thob pa'i rgyud kyi mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i lam dang*/ skabs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi gnyen po gzhi shes don gcig sa mtshams ma dag sa bdun gyi rjes (218) thob na yod/ 'on kyang skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gnyen po gzhi shes ni/ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob nas bdun pa'i bar na yod do// dag sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mtshan med rtogs pa'i lam ni 'dir bstan gnyen po gzhi shes kyi spong ba gnyen po mi byed pa'i phyir te/ des mtshan 'dzin ma yin te/ des mtshan 'dzin spangs zin pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skabs don theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i gzhi shes la gsum ste/ rgyu sbyor ba/ 'bras bu mthong lam/ bsgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la/ sbyor ba'i dbye ba dang*/ sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid las/ dang po ni/ sbyor dang de'i mnyam nyid dang*// zhes pa la 'phros nas/

theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rgyu sbyor ba la dbye na/ du zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu yod de/ gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo tsam la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba/ gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag sogs la/ gzugs sogs kyi mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba ma rdzogs pa kun btags dang*/ rdzogs pa yongs grub dang*/ des mtshon pa'i gzhan dbang dang gsum la zhen spyod= gzugs sogs la chags med gnyen po dang chags bcas spang bya'i dbye ba la zhen spyod= chos nyid gzhan du mi 'gyur ba la zhen spyod= bya dka' ba rnam gsum la= lam bsgom pa las rang rang gi skal ba bzhin 'bras bu thob pas 'bras bu yod par 'dod pa la= (219) /sher phyin bsgom pas srung ba gzhan la rag las med pa la= chos nyid chags sdang gi byed pa por med pa la= snang ba bden med shes byed rmi lam la sogs pa'i dpe bdun la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang bcur yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*/ zhes pa nas snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang dang po bzhi ni/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam dang*/ phyi ma drug ni rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam yin no/ skabs gnyis par bstan pa dang mi zlos te/ der nyan rang gi rtogs rigs tsam gyi ldog pa nas bstan/ 'dir slar de dag la zhen spyod bkag pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan rgyu sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi'i gnas lugs la zhen spyod bkag nas gzhi rang bzhin med par rtogs shing sgom pa'i byang sems so skye'i rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid ni/ mdor bstan du de'i mnyam nyid dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ rgyu sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid gang zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la bzhir yod de/ gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo rlom pa med pa dang*/
de'i khyad pa la rlom pa med pa dang*/ de'i dbye ba la rlom pa med pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i rtogs pa la rlom pa med pa'i mnyam nyid dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa rlom med pa//

(220) rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid// zhes pas bstan/ 'di ni rgyu sbyor ba'i khyad chos 'chad byed yin pas/ rgyu sbyor ba'i nang du 'dus so// gnyis pa zhugs 'bras mthong lam ni/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gang zhe na/ 'di la ngo bor mdor bstan pa dang*/ rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir bstan mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod de/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung sogs bden pa bzhi po re re la/ chos bzod dang*/ chos shes dang*/ rjes bzod dang*/ rjes shes dang bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug tu yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid rtag mi rtag gi spros pa dang bral ba la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de skye 'gag med pa sogs la nges shes 'dren nus kyi mnyam bzhag rnams ni rim bzhin 'dir bstan sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs kyi ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ de bzhin du gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid nam mkha' 'dra bar rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de rtog pas (221) chags sogs kyi nyon mongs spangs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa las grol bar rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyis ci yang brjod du med par rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus kyi mnyam bzhag rnams ni rim bzhin kun 'byung chos bzod kyi ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ mkha' 'dra zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ de bzhin du ngos skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i chos nyid sar mthong gi don tshig tu brjod pa'i sgo nas gzhan la sbyin du med par rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/

chos nyid de yul can gang gi dmigs yul du byed pa med par rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de mtha' thams cad kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus dang*/ de rtogs pa'i rjes thob tu nad mi 'byung ba la nges shes 'dren nus kyi mnyam bzhag rnams ni/ rim bzhin 'gog pa chos bzod sogs kyi ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni gang phyir 'di don zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de bzhin du lam gyi chos rtogs pas 'bras bu ngan song las grol ba'i phan yon la dang*/ 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i thabs la mi rtog pa nyid la dang*/ chos kun gyi mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel bar rtogs pa la dang*/ brjod bya dngos dang brjod byed ming gnyis po la bzung 'dzin gyi shes pa skye med rtogs pa la nges shes 'dren nus kyi (222) mnyam bzhag rnams ni rim bzhin 'dir bstan lam chos bzod sogs kyi ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni/ ngan song chad dang zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ de ltar kun shes pa nyid kyi skabs kyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi rnam pa ni bshad ma thag pa de dag yin no zhes pa ni/ kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// zhes pas bstan/ nges shes bcu drug po 'di dag 'dren pa'i nus pa mthong lam mnyam bzhag tu rim can du thob pa la 'dir bstan skad cig ma bcu drug gi rnam par 'jog cing*/ nges shes 'di dag gang du thob na/ mnyam bzhag las langs pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su thob pa yin to// 'di nyid las/ skabs gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi par gsungs pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug po thams cad dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams ni rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi nges shes 'dren pa'i khyad par kho na yin la/ de dag 'dren pa'i nus pa skad cig ma bcu drug tu rims can du thob pas shes bzod kyi khyad par rnams mnyam bzhag la 'jog go /zhes gsungs pas so// gsum pa bsgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/

skabs gnyis par mthong bsgom rim can du bstan pa ltar/ 'dir yang mthong lam gyi 'og tu bsgom lam ci'i phyir mi ston snyam na/ de'i rgyu mtshan skabs gnyis par shes bya byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/ mthong bsgom rim can du ston pa skabs don bstan bya'i gtso (223) bo theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yin pas/ rtogs rigs de gzhan don mngon sum du shes dgos par ma zad/ byang sems rang nyid kyis rgyun ldan du'ang bsgom par bya dgos pa'i gnad kyis de ltar bstan la/ 'dir ni skabs 'dir bstan gyi mthong lam rnams theg dman gyi rtogs rigs yin pas/ rtogs rigs de gzhan don du mngon sum du shes par bya ba tsam las mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par bya ba ma yin pa'i gnad kyis rtogs rigs de mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam med pa'i phyir na/ skabs 'dir mthong lam gyi 'og tu bsgom lam mi ston pa yin no// rgyu mtshan 'dis kyang sngar skabs gnyis par nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya zhes pa dang*/ rten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam// yang dag bsdus pa shes par bya// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes la mthong lam tsam las bsgom lam med par shes par bya'o// gsum pa mkhyen gsum gyi 'jug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i gzhi shes 'di dang*/ gzhi shes la ltos nas yang bshad ma thag pa'i lam shes 'di dang*/ lam shes la ltos nas yang bshad ma thag pa'i rnam mkhyen 'di yin te/ brjod bya rnam pa gsum po 'di ni rdzogs par bstan bya yin la/ rdzogs par ston byed ni mdor mkhyen gsum rdzogs pa'i 'jug thogs su 'byung ba'i don bsdu ba'i mdo tshig gsum po de yin te/ mdo tshig (224) gsum po des sngar mkhyen gsum gyi gnas skabs gsum po de dag tu thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i don go rim ldog ste/ mkhyen gsum rnam par bsdus nas bsgom dgos par shes pa'i ched du 'og gi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang mtshams sbyor zhing yongs su rdzogs par bstan pas so// zhes pa ni/

de ltar 'di dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'chad tshul 'di ni mdo dang nyi snang gi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos legs par bkral ba gdul bya rnam dpyod dang bsod nams gnyis ka dang ldan pa dag gi spyod yul du 'byung ba yin no// gzhi shes kyi skabs bstan zin to// ༈ //bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ gzhi shes kyi 'og tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis rgyas par gtan la phab pa'i don gzhi shes kyi skabs su gzhi bden gzhi'i steng du bsdu tshul gsungs pa de yang skabs 'dir rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum du bsdus nas bsgom dgos shing*/ de ltar bsgom par byed pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i nyams len ma skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi bsgom rim dang*/ de skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi bsgom rim gnyis las/ dang po la/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i don rnam pa brgya bdun (225) cu rtsa gsum du bsdu ba'i tshul/ de ltar bsgom pa la sbyor ba po'i rten gyi gang zag gang zag de rnam pa de sgom pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug tshul/ sbyor ba de nyid kyi khyad par gyi chos/ de la brten nas thob pa'i thar pa cha mthun dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang*/ zhes pa las 'phros nas/ bsgom bya'i rnam pa'i ngo bo gang*/ dbye na du yod ce na/ ngo bo ni gzhi bden bzhi'i steng du gnas tshul rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin la/ dbye na gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang lam shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang gsum yod do// zhes pa ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/

'di'i bye brag ni/ ye shes kyi rnam pa'i 'dzin stangs yin pas ye shes ngo bo zhes pa'i don de/ nyi snang du/ bye brag ni mtshan nyid do zhes bshad pas so// de ltar gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa la med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i rnam pa dang*/ dben pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mi brdzi ba'i rnam pa bzhi ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med pa rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ don dam par sdug bsngal mi skye bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ kun btags kyi bdag don gzhan gyi dben par gtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ bdag yod kyi skyon gyi mi brdzi bar rtogs (226) pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa rnams so// gnas med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rnam= brjod du med pa'i rnam= ming med pa'i rnam pa dang bzhi ni kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin/ don dam par sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gnas med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ nam mkha' ltar kun 'byung skye 'gag med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par brjod pa'i rgyu rtog spyod med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par ming bzhi'i phung por med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa rnams so// yang 'gro ba med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mi 'phrog pa'i rnam= mi zad pa'i rnam= skye ba med pa'i rnam pa dang bzhi ni 'gog bden gyi steng gi rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin/ 'gro song sogs kyi thob bya med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ sngon po sogs kyi rnam pas mi 'phrog par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par dri ma zad pa med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par dri ma skye ba med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa rnams so// yang byed pa po med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ shes pa po med pa'i= 'pho ba po med pa'i=

'dul bya'i rnam pa dang bzhi ni lam bden gyi steng gi lam dang po'i rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin/ byed pa po'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ shes pa po'i bdag med par= chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi 'pho ba med par/ don dam par spang bya'i nyon mongs 'dul rgyu med par rtogs pa'i ye shes (227) kyi rnam pa rnams so// de ltar bcu drug ni/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po'i rigs su gyur pa'i lam yin pas nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su bzhed do// de bzhin du rmi lam gyi rnam pa dang*/ sgra snyan gyi rnam pa dang*/ mig yor gyi rnam pa dang*/ mig rgyu'i rnam pa dang*/ sgyu ma'i rnam pa dang*/ lnga ni lam bden gyi steng gi lam gnyis pa'i rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin/ bzung ba phyi rol gyi don rmi lam ltar ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ sgra snyan ltar ma skyes par rtogs pa'i dang*/ mig yor ltar ma 'gag par rtogs pa'i dang*/ mig sgyu ltar gzod ma nas zhi bar rtogs pa'i dang*/ sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa rnams so// de bzhin du kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ gos pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ spros pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ rlom pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa dang drug ni lam bden gyi steng gi lam gsum pa'i rnam pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin/ don dam par kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par rnam byang gi bzung ba med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par kun nas nyon mongs kyi gos pa med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par gzugs sogs kyi dbye ba'i spros pa med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ rang gi rtogs pa la (228) rlom bya'i bzung ba med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ rtogs pa thob zin mi g.yo bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa'i bye brag rnams so// de ltar lam gnyis pa'i rnam pa lnga dang gsum pa'i rnam pa drug ste/

bcu gcig ni shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po'i rigs su gyur pa dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pas rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su bzhed do// 'dir lam bden gyi steng gi lam gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni 'grel pa don gsal las/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du zag pa med pa'i lam gcig dang*/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis rang sangs rgyas kyang bsdus pas/ de'i phyir de dag gi shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du bsgom pa'i lam zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa gnyis yin pas lam rnam pa gsum po zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong sgom mnyam bzhag ni lam dang po dang*/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i rang rgyal gyi bsgom lam rjes thob ni lam gnyis pa dang*/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong bsgom mnyam bzhag ni/ lam gsum par 'jog pa las/ bstan bcos rtsa 'grel gyi dngos bstan gyi de gsum ni byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas nyan thos kyi mthong bsgom mnyam bzhag gi rtogs rigs dang*/ rang rgyal bsgom lam rjes thob kyi rtogs rigs dang*/ rang rgyal gyi mthong bsgom (229) mnyam bzhag gi rtogs rigs byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams yin no// 'dir kha cig gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun po gang rung yin na/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pas khyab/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun po gang rung yin na/ med pa'i zhes sogs tshig rkang dang po de'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pas khyab/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin na/ gzhi shes yin pa khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ nyan thos mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i rnam pa dang po yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa gang zhig gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ skabs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes rnam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi lam du gyur pa'i shes rnam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg dman gyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ (230) nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg dman gyi 'phags lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dir bstan med pa'i rnam pa sogs dang po bcu drug gang rung yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs rigs yin dgos pa gang zhig 'dir bstan rmi lam gyi rnam pa sogs phyi ma bcu gcig po gang rung yin na/

gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod mi nus te/ theg dman gyi 'phags lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ theg dman gyi 'phags lam sngon du song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi

(231) sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang po yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa brtag pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'phags lam yin par thal/ gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na byang 'phags kyi rgyud la yod pa'i med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud la yod pa'i nyer bdun la theg dman gyi mthong lam sngon du song ba dang ma song gnyis las/ song ba med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan snga ma de'i phyir/ 'on kyang rnam pa phyi ma bcu gcig la dang po nyid nas rang rgyal lam du zhugs pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam sngon du song na/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa yin la/ de sngon du ma song na nyan thos kyi mthong lam sogs sngon du song yang gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ma yin pa shes par bya'o// theg dman gyi mthong lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun (232) ni gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ma yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par sogs don spyi'i tshul gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa ni/ de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod ces pa la 'phros nas/ lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par dbye na du zhe na/ de la sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi brgyad dang*/

tshad med pa'i rnam pa sogs lam bden gyi steng gi bdun dang*/ mi rtag pa'i rnam pa sogs sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi lnga dang*/ nang stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa sogs 'gog bden gyi steng gi rnam pa bcu drug ste/ de dag sdom pas sum cu rtsa drug yod pa'i phyir ro zhes pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de yang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa dang*/ zhi ba'i rnam pa dang*/ mi gnas pa'i= 'dod chags med pa'i= zhe sdang med pa'i= gti mug med pa'i= nyon mongs med pa'i= sems can med pa'i rnam pa dang brgyad ni/ mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin du byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam gyi 'dod chags dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag dang*/ yul la zhen pa'i tshul gyi mi gnas par rtogs pa'i dang*/ spros pa nye bar zhi bar rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par 'dod chags med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par zhe sdang med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par gti mug med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par nyon mongs med par rtogs (233) pa'i dang*/ don dam par sems can med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag rnams so// de bzhin du tshad med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel ba'i rnam pa dang*/ tha mi dad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dang*/ gzhal du med pa'i dang*/ chags pa med pa'i rnam pa dang bdun ni/ mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin du/ byang sems kyi lam gyis sems can tshad med pa byang chub kyi lam du go skabs 'byed par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel bar rtogs pa'i dang*/ chos kun chos kyi dbyings su tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i dang*/ nyan rang gi sa la mchog tu 'dzin pa med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ bdag gnyis su rnam par mi rtog par rtogs pa'i dang*/ chos nyid gzhal du med par rtogs pa'i dang*/

gang la yang chags pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag rnams so// de bzhin du mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang*/ stong pa'i dang*/ bdag med pa'i dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa'i rnam pa dang lnga ni/ mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin/ sdug bsngal bden pa mi rtag par rtogs pa'i dang*/ de sdug bsngal bar rtogs pa'i dang*/ ngo bor gyur ba'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong par rtogs pa'i dang*/ der gyur pa'i mtshan nyid gang yang med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi (234) bye brag rnams so// de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa nas/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi zhes pa'i bar bcu drug ni/ nang stong pa nyid sogs stong nyid de dang de rtogs pa'i yul can gyi ye shes kyi bye brag byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams so// 'dir kha cig byang sems kyi rgyud kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs sum cu rtsa drug po gang rung yin na/ rgyu dang lam dang zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pas khyab/ 'dir bstan lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug po gang rung yin na/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs so drug po gang rung yin na/ theg chen gyi lam yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi 'dod chags dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa yod pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyid las/ de ltar so drug po byang sems so skye'i rgyud la yod pa rnams 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs don spyi'i tshul gyi rtogs pa yin gyi/

mngon sum du ma rtogs pas lam shes kyi rnam pa dngos ma yin la/ zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ (235) lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam shes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa dang po yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di'i thad kyi 'grel pa don gsal las/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi rnam pa dang po yin pa'i phyir te/ mi rtag pa dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa mi rtag par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal bden pa rtag pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs ma yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ lnga dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa dang po bzhi po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lnga dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dang po bzhi dang*/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dang po bzhi rim bzhin don gcig pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can mthong lam pas rgyud kyi 'dod chags (236) dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs brgyad po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/

de'i steng gi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud kyi 'dod chags dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi lam ma yin par thal/ theg dman gyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ des na bden bzhi gang rung gi steng du lam gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa skabs bzhi pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi 'dod chags bral ba'i rnam pa sogs so drug rtogs rigs ni sngar gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su bzhag kyang*/ 'di la theg pa gsum ka'i rtogs rigs yod de/ kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa sogs brgyad ni/ sngar gzhi shes kyi rnam pa'i skabs su dbye ba'i lam bden gyi steng gi lam gsum pa'i rnam pa dang po dang don gcig pas/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs dang*/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi (237) rnam pa dang po bzhi mi rtag sogs bzhi rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pas/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang*/ lhag ma gzhan rnams theg chen gyi rtogs rigs yin no// mi rtag pa'i rnam pa sogs sngar gzhi shes kyi rnam par bstan zin pa dang*/ zlos pa'i skyon med de/ sngar gzhi shes kyi rnam pa'i ldog pa nas bstan/ 'dir lam shes kyi rnam pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam rnams skabs gnyis par bstan zin pas/ slar skabs gsum par bstan pa la yang zlos pa'i skyon yod par 'gyur ro// de ltar na kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi rnam pa brgyad dang*/

sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi rnam pa dang po bzhi byang sems so skye'i rgyud la yod pa rnams la/ nyan rang gi mthong lam sngon du song ma song gi khyad par las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa la sogs don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang*/ mngon sum du rtogs pa gnyis yod par khas len dgos la/ 'on kyang mngon sum du rtogs pa de rang yang lam shes kyi rnam pa ma yin te/ 'dir bstan lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug po gang rung yin na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// ces pa la 'phros nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la rgyas par dbye na du zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na (238) brgya dang bcu yod de/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi rnam pa sogs slob ma nyan thos dang thun mong gi rnam pa so bdun dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa sogs byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gnas dang gnas ma yin mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi rnam pa sogs sum cu rtsa dgu ste/ brgya dang bcur yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ zhes pa nas/ sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'dir bstan rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ lam bden gyi steng gi rnam pa'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi 'dzin stangs so// thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig sems can gyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'o// nyan thos dang thun mong pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang*/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i khyad par ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gzhir bzhag la snga ma nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang*/

phyi ma byang sems kyi rtogs rigs yin no// rnam pa brgya dang bcu po 'di dag bden bzhi gang gi rnam pa yin snyam na/ lam bden 'ba' zhig steng gi rnam pa yin te/ lam gyi bden pa'i zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i sum cu rtsa bdun ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi /tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag gi / (239) sems dran pa nyer bzhag gi /chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi rnam pa/ mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba'i yang dag spong ba'i rnam pa/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa'i yang dag spong ba'i/ dge ba skyes pa 'phel ba'i yang dag spong ba'i dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i yang dag spong ba'i rnam pa dang*/ 'dun pa'i= brtson 'grus kyi= sems kyi= spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i rnam pa/ dad pa'i dbang po'i brtson 'grus kyi dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi shes rab kyi dbang po'i rnam pa/ dad pa'i stobs kyi brtson 'grus kyi= dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi= shes rab kyi stobs kyi rnam pa/ dran pa yang dag= chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa brtson 'grus yang dag shin tu sbyangs pa ting nge 'dzin btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gi rnam pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba'i yang dag pa'i rtog pa'i yang dag pa'i ngag gi yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'i yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'i yang dag pa'i rtsol ba'i yang dag pa'i dran pa'i yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa rnams so// de bzhin du byang sems dang thun mong gi sum cu rtsa bzhi ni/ sde tshan drug las gnyen po'i lam ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ mtshan med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ sprul pa'i lam ni/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar dang gsum/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi/

ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi/ yod min med min gyi skye mched kyi rnam thar/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang lnga/ 'jig rten las 'das (240) pa'i lam ni/ bsam gtan bzhi'i snyoms 'jug gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang dgu/ spong ba'i lam ni/ yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i ldog pa bzhir phye bas/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i spong ba'i lam sogs bzhi dang*/ drug pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ste/ de dag bsdoms pas sum cu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba rnams so// thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa dgu ni/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi rnam pa dang*/ las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i= mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i= 'jig rten gyi khams du ma mkhyen pa'i= dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam byang mkhyen pa'i/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i zag pa zad pa'i stobs kyi rnam pa bcu dang*/ rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs brnyed par zhal gyis bzhes pa la dang*/ rang don spangs pa phun tshogs brnyes pa zhal gyis bzhes pa la dang*/ gzhan don du 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs spangs phyir ston pa la dbang*/ gzhan don du theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung gi lam ston pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang*/ chos dang*/ don dang*/ tshig dang spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang*/ 'khrul pa

(241) mi mnga' ba'i ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa dang*/ ca co mi mnga' ba'i dang*/ dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba'i dang*/ thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba'i dang*/ tha dad pa nyid kyi 'du shes mi mnga' ba'i dang*/ so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba'i ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa ste spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa drug dang*/ 'dun pa las nyams pa mi mnga' ba'i dang*/ brtson 'grus las= dran pa las= ting 'dzin las= shes rab las= rnam par grol ba las nyams pa mi mnga' ba'i rnam pa ste rtog pa ma 'dres pa drug sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs kyi phrin las kyi rnam pa ste/ phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum dang*/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da lta ba la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa gsum ste/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum dang bcas pas ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad yin la so drug dang so bdun pa de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag dang*/ so brgyad pa rang byung gi rnam pa ni/ chos can ji snyed pa'i dbye ba thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag dang*/ so dgu pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa ni/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag la 'jog cing*/ de ltar na sum cu rtsa dgu'o// des na 'dir bshad pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang bdun cu rtsa gsum (242) ni sgom bya don rnam dang*/ shes rnam gnyis las/ shes rnam yin te/ mkhyen pa gsum po gang rung gi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de skad du yum don las/ rnam pa brgya dang bdun cu gsum// shes rnam yin par byams pas bzhed// shes bya kun rig gsung gi ste// bsod nams seṅges de ltar go /zhes gsungs so// spyir bsgom bya'i don rnam dang*/ shes rnam gyi khyad par ni/ sgom byar gyur pa'i yul dang*/

yul can gyi khyad par yin pas/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rnam ni bsgom bya don rnam dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs rnams ni/ sgom bya shes rnam yin no// 'dir kha cig sgom bya shes rnam yin na/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes rnam yin pas khyab/ theg chen gyi bsgom bya shes rnam yin na/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang*/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pas khyab/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun po gang rung yin na/ sum cu bdun dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi so bdun po gang rung yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ nyan thos mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ (243) theg dman gyi bsgom bya 'gyur pa'i shes rnam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman slob pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman gyi mthong sgom gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi shes rnam yin pa thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rigs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ theg chen so skye'i rgyud kyi bsgom bya shes rnam yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi kun nas nyon mongs med pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/

de chos can/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de/ zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sogs gsum po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs (244) pa'i shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi yang dag pa'i lta bar gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi yang dag pa'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gal te rtsod gzhi de med do zhe na/ de yod par thal/ sangs rgyas sa'i byang phyogs su bdun po re re la theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar yod pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas sa'i byang phyogs su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs rigs med pa la lung rigs kyi shes byed med pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa yang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs kho nar thal/ snga ma (245) de dang rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi sar rtogs rigs gsum ka tshang ba'i mkhyen pa bye brag pa mi rnyed par 'gyur ro// des na sangs rgyas sa'i lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi rnam pa sogs sum cu rtsa bdun po nyan thos dang thun mong pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin gyis/

rnam pa ma sbyar bar/ de dang de ci tsam der khas blangs na rdzas spyi'i skyon 'byung la/ de bzhin du stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi sogs la yang rnam par sbyar nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par 'jog pa yin gyis/ ma sbyar na rdzas spyir 'gyur te/ de dag kun la theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar yod pas so// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i rnam pa bzhi'o// zhes dang*/ yang dag par spong ba'i rnam bzhi'o zhes sogs byang phyogs kun la rnam pa dngos su sbyar nas gsung pa dang*/ de bzhin du stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi sogs la yang rnam pa sbyar bar mdzad pa yin no// de ltar na rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par kun mkhyen gsum du phye ba'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam pa la ngos bzung ba dang*/ gsum du phye ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi sogs kyi rnam pa la ngos bzung ba des mtshon nas/ gsum du phye ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa yang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ rnam thar brgyad dang snyoms 'jug dgu la (246) sogs pa ci tsam pa de ma yin par thal/ de dang de'i rnam pa la ngos 'dzin dgos sam snyam te dpyad par bya'o// de dang de'i rnam pa ni yul can lam de'i bye brag gam 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par la 'jog pas/ theg pa che chung gang rung zhig gi rtogs rigs su nges pas na/ rgya chung la/ byang phyogs so bdun dang stobs bcu la sogs pa spyi ldog la rtogs rigs gang rung du kha mtshon chod cing*/ rgya che ba rnam mkhyen dang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la rgya che chung gi khyad par shes par bya'o// gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan gyi byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod la/ spyir byang phyogs kyi sa mtshams ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi theg pa gsum ka'i tshogs lam chung ngu nas/

theg pa so so'i mi slob lam gyi bar na yod do// yang dag pa spong ba bzhi ni/ gsum ka'i tshogs lam 'bring po nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ gsum ka'i tshogs lam chen po nas/ dbang po lnga ni/ gsum ka'i sbyor lam drod nas/ stobs lnga ni/ gsum ka'i sbyor lam bzod pa nas/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ gsum ka'i mthong lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni/ theg pa gsum ka'i sgom lam nas/ gsum ka'i mi slob lam gyi bar na yod de/ mdzod las/ sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin// las ni dang po ba dag dang*// nges 'byed cha (247) mthun rnams dang ni// mthong dang sgom la rab tu phye// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du byang sems thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi'i mthun yul du gyur pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa ni byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ma yin la/ mthun chos su gyur pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni/ rtsa bar sum cu rtsa bzhi zhes pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa don gsal las/ lam shes pa nyid la gnyen po'i lam/ lta bas byas pa'i gnyen po dang zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa bcu ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ lam shes nyid kyi lam gyi rten can gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dngos bstan yin pas// sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen par nges la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhes gsungs pa ni/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i don no// don 'di dang mthun par 'di nyid las kyang*/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi mthun yul du gyur pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum ni byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i blo yin la/ mthun chos rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i khongs su bgrang ba ni/

de'i rtogs rigs sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la (248) yod pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ de'i don yang byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs de 'dir bstan rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par bzhed pa don yin gyis/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i shes byed du 'khrul par mi bya'o// 'o na 'dir bstan sum cu rtsa bzhi po sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen par nges na/ 'dir bstan so bzhi po'i nang du spong ba'i lam gyi sde tshan la bar chad med lam bzhi bshad pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bar chad med lam med pa'i phyir/ snyam pa'i dogs pa dpyod ldan la 'byung bas lan ji ltar bya spyod cig kho bo ni re zhig 'di ltar sems te/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrib pa'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i bar chad med lam dngos med kyang*/ spong ba'i lam yod pas de la bar chad med lam gyi ming gi btags nas de nyid kyang yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas bar chad med lam bzhir bzhag pa yin no// sangs rgyas kyi sar spang bya spong ba'i lam yod de/ des spang bya spong ba'i sdom pa'i rnam bzhag mang du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de ltar sgom pa la sbyor ba po'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa nas rnam par bsdu ba'i bar gyi gang zag de la yang*/ yum nyan pa dang*/ tshig blo la len pa dang*/ don mi brjed (249) par 'dzin pa dang*/ bsam byung gi tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang bzhir yod do ces pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas zhes sogs tshig bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ 'dir bstan gyi gang zag ni/ rnam pa sgom pa la sbyor ba po'i gang zag dang*/ rnam pa sgom pa la 'jug pa'i gang zag yin gyis/ rnam pa sgom pa la zhugs pa'i gang zag ma yin te/ rnam pa sgom pa'i snga rol gyi thos bsam gyi rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/
