'di ni mdor bstan du bcas rnams dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i rgyas bshad do// gsum pa rnam pa de sgom pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug tshul ni/ rnam pa sbyor ba zhes pa la 'phros nas/ 'dir bstan rnam pa sgom pa'i sbyor ba la dbye na du yod ce na/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na nyi shu yod de/ gzugs sogs la gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mi gnas pa la zhen pa bkag pa'i dang*/ zab pa'i dang*/ gting dpag dka' ba'i dang*/ tshad med pa'i dang*/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i dang*/ lung bstan thob pa'i dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dang*/ nges par 'byung ba'i dang*/ bar chad med pa'i dang*/ byang chub la nye ba'i dang*/ myur bar byang chub pa'i dang*/ gzhan don gyi dang*/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i dang*/ chos dang chos min sogs mi dmigs pa'i dang*/ gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab par ma dmigs pa'i dang*/ rnam par mi (250) rtog pa'i dang*/ 'bras bu rin po che sbyin pa'i dang*/ rnam par dag pa'i dang*/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba dang nyi shu yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ zhes pa nas/ de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ sa mtshams ni/ dang po lnga theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ drug pa tshogs lam kho nar yod/ lung bstan thob pa drod dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa rtse mo dang*/ nges par 'byung ba bzod pa dang*/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba chos mchog dang*/ byang chub la nyer sbyor sa dang po na yod/ myur ba byang chub pa sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ gzhan don gyi sbyor ba sogs lnga sa brgyad pa na/ 'bras bu rin po che sbyin pa'i sbyor ba sa dgu pa na/ rnam dag gi sbyor ba sa bcu pa na/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba sa bdun pa man chad na yod par slob dpon bzhed do// rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pa'i mi pham dgongs rgyan las/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba 'di byang sems so skye'i rnal 'byor la ngos 'dzin par mdzad de/

sa mtshams dang bcas pa'i don yang*/ bdud las kyi bar chad mi 'byung ba'i chad du dus 'di srid cig la chos kyi sbyong ba 'di tsam zhig bya'o// zhes dang bca' brtan pos mtshams bcad nas/ sgrub pa'am sems dpa'i rnal 'byor la sa mtshams dang bcas par bzhed/ don gsal las/ (251) sa mtshams la sbyor ba zhes pa'i tha snyad gsungs pas/ sa mtshams kyi go don nges pa can zhig btsal dgos so// des na 'dir bstan sbyor ba nyi shu po re res kyang rnam par brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom la/ sgom tshul sa dang po yan chad du rtogs rigs gsum ngo bo gcig du yod pas/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lam shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa'i sbyor ba sogs mi 'gal bar gsum ka'i gzhi mthun yod la/ byang sems so skye'i gnas skabs su rtog pa sel 'jug yin pa sa der gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lam shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa'i sbyor ba sogs 'gal zhing*/ rnam pa kun rdzogs par sgom pa yang res 'jog gi tshul du rdzogs par sgom ste/ rnam pa dang po gnyis mtshan nyid rjes su sbyor ba'i sgo nas sgom rten gyi rnam par smon lam gyi rnam par sogs kyi sgo nas sgom pa yin no// de skad du 'di nyid las/ sbyor ba nyi shu po de la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyi shu po re res kyang rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom par byed pa'i phyir/ 'o na byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi sbyor bas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ji ltar sgom snyam na/ mtshan nyid rjes su spyod pa dang*/ smon lam gyi rnam pa sogs kyi sgo nas sgom par shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs so//

(252) gnad kyi don ni/ rtsa bar yang*/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste/ zhes rnam pa kun rdzogs par bsgom pa'i sbyor ba la rnam rdzogs sbyor bar bshad pa ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba zhes pa'i sgra bshad tsam yin mod/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin na/ rnam pa brgyad bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yin pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems so skye'i gnas skabs su rnam pa re re ba bsgom pa'i sbyor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang so skye'i sbyor bas rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum re mos su bsgom pas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i go don tshang zhing*/ rtsod ngo'i rigs lam gyi dbang du byas na byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin na/ rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa'i sbyor ba ma yin pas khyab par shes par bya'o// bzhi pa sbyor ba de nyid kyi khyad par gyi chos ni/ yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ yon tan sogs gsum po gang zhe na/ dang po theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan la bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs shing mkhyen pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi gzigs pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur pa dang*/ phan yon chen po dang*/ chos la bya ba byed pa dang*/ gnyen po'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gtam smra ba'i skyes (253) bur gyur pa dang*/ bdud las kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan gyi bde dge la dga' ba rgya chen po bskyed pa dang*/ dam bcas pa bzhin mngon par sgrub pa dang*/ chos zab mo mngon par 'dod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nges par tshang bar thob pa'i yon tan bcu bzhi yod do zhes pa ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o// zhes pas bstan/ mdor na theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan 'dir bstan theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/

sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi gnas skabs na yod/ kha cig tshogs lam na yod par 'dod kyang*/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pas bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ phyi'i yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas kyis dgongs shing mkhyen pas/ phyi'i yongs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku'i yongs su 'dzin pa sogs sbyor lam nas yod pa yin gyis/ tshogs lam du de dag ma thob ste/ tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su bdud las rnams kyang 'byung nye zhing*/ yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par gsungs pa yang*/ sbyor lam pa la yin gyis/ tshogs lam pa la gsungs pa ma mthong bas so// de ltar yon tan mthong bas spro ba skyes kyang*/ skyon ngo ma shes na bar chad (254) 'byung bas/ de bshad na theg chen gyi sbyor ba la bar du gcod byed kyi skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud las so// dbye na bzhi bcu zhe drug yod de/ brtson 'grus bul ba dang*/ brtson 'grus ha cang myur ba dang*/ lus kyi gnas ngan len la sogs rang la brten pa'i 'gal rkyen nyi shu dang*/ slob dpon slob ma gang rung dang 'brel ba'i 'dun pa dang*/ snyom las kyi nyams pa dang*/ 'dun pa'i yul tha dad pas nyams pa sogs mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum dang*/ bdud kyi 'byed pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ bcos ma nye bar sgrub pa sogs gzhan la brten pa'i 'gal rkyen gsum dang bcas pa zhe drug tu yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa// drug tu nges par rtogs par bya// zhes pas bstan/ skyon 'di dag phal cher sbyor lam pa la mi 'byung zhing*/ phyi rol bdud kyi cho 'phrul 'ga' zhig byung yang stong nyid la rang chan chud pas/ de'i dbang du gtan nas mi 'gro la/ des na 'di dang 'byung ba'i sa mtshams ni/ tshogs lam khyad par can la gnas pa'i skabs su 'byung zhing*/ de la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon rnams phal cher bdud las kyi dbang du mi 'gro bas/

rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob sla/ dbang rtul rnams phal cher bdud las kyi dbang du 'gro bas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob dka' ste/ rdzogs pa'i (255) byang chub rnon po yis// rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dka' bzhed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig skyon 'di dag gi sa mtshams bdun pa man chad na yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ sbyor mthong bsgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams bdud las kyi dbang du 'gro ba mi srid cing*/ de mi srid pas gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par 'jog pa yin no// de ltar skyon yon mthong bas blang dor shes pa'i sgo nas sgom par bya ba'i sbyor ba ni sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de bshad nas theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la dbye na/ shes mtshan byed mtshan zung 'jug dang khyad mtshan dang*/ ngo bo nyid mtshan rnams su yod do ces pa ni/ gang gi mtshon de mtshan nyid du// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon par byed pa'i byed sgrub dang*/ las sgrub gang rung gis bsdus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor 'dir bstan theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan gzhi/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan byed mtshan gnyis zung du chug pa dang*/ khyad mtshan ni de'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo nyid mtshan ni de'i las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// shes mtshan la dbye na (256) gsum las/ dang po theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la/ yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ phung po lnga don dam du 'jig pa med par shes pa'i shes mtshan nas/ sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gdul bya la bstan cing btags pa shes pa'i shes mtshan gyi bar bcu drug tu yod do// zhes pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang zhes pa nas// thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs te// gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya 'di// thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/

de bzhin du lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la dbye na/ yum la brten nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ mtshan ma med pa shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ smon pa med par shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ skye ba med par shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ 'gag pa med par shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ don dam du mtshan nyid med par nyid du shes pa'i shes mtshan gyi bar bcu drug tu yod do// zhes pa ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang*/ zhes pa ni rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la// lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyi ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ yang rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la dbye na/ yum la (257) brten nas mthong chos la bde bar shes pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ yum la sgo gsum gyis gus par bya ba shes pa'i dang*/ yum las mi 'da' bas bla ma nyid du byed pa shes pa'i dang*/ yum dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pas brnyes par byed pa shes pa'i dang*/ yum la me tog sogs kyi mchod par byed pa shes pa'i shes mtshan nas 'du shes 'gog pa shes pa'i shes mtshan gyi bar bcu drug yod do// ces pa ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas// gnas dang gus par bya ba dang*// zhes pa nas 'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de ltar shes mtshan gsum las/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin na/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab cing*/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor bas gzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par ro// de bzhin du lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la byang sems kyi rtogs rigs kyis khyab/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la sangs rgyas kyi rtogs rigs kyi khyab cing*/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ lam shes sbyor bas lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad pa dang*/

rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor bas rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par ro// gnyis pa theg chen (258) sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan la dbye na/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ skad cig ma ni bcu drug gi /zhes pa la 'phros nas bcu drug po gang zhe na/ chos dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ chos gang dang yang mnyam pa med pa dang*/ gzhal ba las 'das pa dang*/ bgrang ba las 'das pa dang*/ 'phags pa kun gyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan yar ldan du sdud pa dang*/ mkhas pas rig par bya ba'i chos zab mo rtogs pa dang*/ nyan rang gi spyod yul min pa'i chos shes pa dang*/ mngon shes shin tu myur ba dang*/ bden gnyis la brten pa'i chos kun la bri ba dang*/ gang ba med par rtogs pa dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas phar phyin rab tu bsgrub pa dang*/ tshe rabs snga ma'i sbyor bas tshogs gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog par chos kun la dmigs pa dang*/ sems kyi chos dbyings dge rtsas bsad pas nyan rang du mi ltung ba'i rten dang bcas pa dang*/ thabs shes kyi zin pas rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu tshogs mtha' dag tshang ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba dang*/ mngon par zhen pa'i ro myang ba med pa la nges par rang stobs kyis 'dren pa'i mnyam (259) bzhag skad cig ma bcu drug po 'dir bstan khyad mtshan yin no// zhes pa ni/ bsam mi khyab dang zhes pa nas// gang gi lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pa'i khyad par lam// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ des na theg chen gyis sbyor bas chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par/ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan sogs gsum/ gzhung 'dir dngos su bshad pa'i khyad mtshan bcu drug ni/ sbyor ba gsum ka'i thun mong gi khyad mtshan du 'chad de/

khyad mtshan ston pa'i gzhung las/ mkhyen gsum gyi sa mtshams so sor ma bcad pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin zhes kun mkhyen bla mas gsungs/ theg chen ma sbyar na gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan med de/ de'i khyad mtshan yin na/ de'i khyad mtshan des sbyor ba de gzhan theg dman la ldan pa rnam par gcod dgos pa las/ de gcod mi nus pa'i phyir te/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba theg dman la yang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin na/ shes pa khyad par byed pa ste// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin pas khyab/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan (260) yin na/ gzhung de'i dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin pas khyab/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin na/ gzhung de'i dngos bstan gyi shes mtshan yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa mtshon par byed pa'i dmigs pa sogs khyad par bzhi ldan gyi lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi sbyor ba/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon par byed pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi de de ltar du mtshon nus pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi de de ltar du sgrub nus pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*// zhes sogs mi 'thad par 'gyur ro// rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skad cig ma ni bcu drug gi /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi skad cig ma bcu drug po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzhung snga phyi de gnyis la 'brel chags kyi go don gcig 'chad rigs pa'i phyir/

gong du 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam yin (261) par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi khyad par bzhi ldan gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos dbyings rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems bsgom pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon par byed pa'i chos yod pa'i phyir te/ de theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'phags tshul yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gong bzhin rigs 'gre/ gsum pa la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar rtogs pa'i shes rab chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi de'i khyad mtshan yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags tshul (262) yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi shes mtshan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzhung de'i dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin na/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi khyad mtshan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnad kyi don ni skabs bzhi pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes mtshan khyad mtshan la sogs pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la sogs pa yin zhing*/

byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan khyad mtshan byed mtshan la sogs pa gzhung 'di dag gi shugs la bstan pa yin te/ gong du rnam pa rgyas bshad kyi skabs su dngos bstan shugs bstan bshad pa de dang phal cher 'dra bas/ yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa sogs theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug dang*/ yum la brten nas rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa sogs lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bcu drug dang*/ yum la brten nas mthong chos la bder gnas shes pa sogs rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang*/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs kyi don la 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi nges shes skyes pa'i khyad mtshan rnams dang*/ phan pa dang bde ba la sogs pa'i byed mtshan rnams dang*/ nyon mongs kyis dben pa'i ngo bo (263) nyid la sogs pa ngo bo nyid mtshan rnams so skye'i gnas skabs na yang yod do// gal te so skye'i gnas skabs na med na/ mtshon bya mtshon byed mtshan gzhi gsum du phye ba'i mtshon bya theg chen gyi sbyor ba la byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba med par 'gyur la/ de med na gong gi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba nyi shu po gang rung la byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sbyor bas khyad par 'gyur bas ha cang thal lo// de ltar na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba nyi shu po rnams ni/ rang mtshon par byed pa'i byed sgrub kyi mtshan nyid dag gis mtshon par bya ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba yin te/ 'di nyid las/ zhib tu phye na mtshon bya gang*/ mtshon byed gang gis/ mtshan gzhi gang gi steng du mtshon par byed pa ces pa gsum las/ mtshon bya ni gong du bshad pa'i sbyor ba nyi shu po re re'i steng du yang rang gi ngo bo theg chen sbyor ba yin pa dang*/ bye brag phye na mkhyen pa gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum gsum du yod do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

gal te shes mtshan khyad mtshan sogs la gzhung gi dngos bstan gyis khyab na/ byang sems bsgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ skabs bzhi pa'i gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin par thal/ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub

(264) na/ der thal/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bsam mi khyab sogs zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di dag gis/ byang sems kyi bsgom lam gyi khyad mtshan don gyis bstan pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyi// zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi khyad mtshan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam gyi khyad mtshan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ skad cig ma ni bcu drug gi /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi skad cig ma bcu drug po mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ byang sems kyi bsgom lam gyi khyad mtshan yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems bsgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mtshon byed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon byed yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba theg dman gyi/ sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ des na khyad mtshan ston pa'i gzhung 'di dag gis byang sems kyi mthong lam gyi khyad mtshan dngos su bstan nas byang sems kyi sgom lam dang*/ byang sems so skye'i (265) rgyud kyi khyad mtshan shugs la bstan par shes par bya zhing*/ de yang mthong lam la dngos su sbyar bas mthong lam gyi khyad mtshan dngos su ston byed du song ba yin gyis/ khyad mtshan rang gi ngo bo ngos 'dzin tshul la khyad par med de/ mtshon sbyor 'god pa na shes so// 'o na shes mtshan dang khyad mtshan gnyis po tsam gyi sbyor ba mtshon nus sam zhe na/ de gnyis kyi steng du byed mtshan yang dgos te/ sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa la thabs shes zung 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/

byed mtshan la dbye na du zhe na/ de la bcu gcig yod de/ ma 'ongs pa na thar pa thob rung la 'god par phan pa'i byed pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dngos su zhi bar byed pa bde ba'i byed pa dang*/ tshe 'dir dngos su 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar pa la 'god par skyob pa'i byed pa dang gsum ni/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa dang*/ gtan du phan pa sangs rgyas la 'god pa skyabs kyi byed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las zlog par byed pa gnas kyi byed pa dang*/ srid zhi'i mnyam nyid rtogs pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa med pa la 'god pa dpung gnyen gyi= 'khor bar gnas pa 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa la 'god pa'i gling gi= gzhan gyi don 'grub pa 'dren pa'i= sems can gyi don la 'bad rtsol mi dgos par lhun gyis grub pa'i= theg pa (266) gsum gyi nges 'byung 'bras bu la rang don du mngon du mi byed pa dang bdun ni lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa dang*/ chos ston pa la 'god pa rten gyi byed pa gcig ni/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan du 'jog pas so// zhes pa ni/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyir phan pa'i byed pa sogs bcu gcig po gang rung yin na/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi byed pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ phan pa'i byed pa sogs bcu gcig po kun sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs na yod pa'i phyir te/ gdul bya phan pa la 'god pa dang*/ bde ba la 'god pa'i mdzad phrin sogs sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs na yod pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen sbyor bas gzhan don sgrub pa'i char gyur pa'i mdzad pa phrin las de theg chen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan gyi byed pa bcu gcig po gang rung yin na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mdzad pa phrin las yin pas khyab par shes par bya'o// mtshon byed de dag gis mtshon bya theg chen gyi sbyor ba/

mtshan gzhi gang gi steng du mtshon par byed ce na/ mtshan gzhi la bcu drug yod de/ chags sogs nyon mongs kyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ 'bras bu lus ngag gi gnas ngan len gyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ rgyu tshul min yid byed kyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ spang bya dang gnyen po dag gi (267) dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang bzhi ni/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi dang*/ bya dka' ba'i dang*/ sangs rgyas su nges pa'i dang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bya ba'i dang*/ sgom dang bsgom pa po mi dmigs pa'i dang*/ lam la mngon zhen bkag pa'i ngo bo nyid dang lnga ni/ lam shes sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi dang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum la dmigs pa'i dang*/ 'jig rten gyi 'dzin pa dang mi mthun pa'i dang*/ chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i dang*/ chos kun bden pa'i gzhi med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ khyad par du 'gro ba med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ don dam par skye med du rtogs pa'i dang*/ de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid dang bdun ni/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi yin no// zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ shes mtshan byed mtshan zung 'jug dang khyad mtshan gyi mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa de ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ de dag mtshon sbyor du bkod pa ni/ spyi'i mtshon sbyor dang*/ bye brag gi mtshon sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bcu drug mtshan gzhi/ de theg chen gyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i mtshon (268) sbyor ni/ shes mtshan byed mtshan gnyis kyi spyi sbyor dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon/

bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes mtshon sbyor ni/ khyad mtshan gyi spyi'i mtshon sbyor yin zhing*/ 'di dag la thun mong ba'i mtshon sbyor zhes bya ste/ gzhi shes sbyor ba sogs bye brag so sor ma phye bar mtshan gzhi thun mong ba'i steng du bkod pa'i mtshon sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bye brag gi mtshon sbyor la yang*/ shes mtshan dang*/ byed mtshan gnyis kyi mtshon sbyor dang*/ khyad mtshan gyi mtshon sbyor dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs kyis dben pa'i ngo bo nyid sogs bzhi mtshan bzhi/ theg chen gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar rtogs pa sogs gzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ phan bde skyob pa'i byed pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i mtshon sbyor dang*/ bya dka'i ngo bo nyid la sogs lnga mtshan bzhi/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa sogs lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor (269) yin pa zhes pa'i mtshon sbyor dang*/ dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid la sogs pa bdun mtshan bzhi rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ mthong chos la bder gnas shes pa sogs rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ rten gyi mdzad pa gcig dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i mtshon sbyor rnams yin te/ de dag ni shes mtshan dang byed mtshan zung 'jug rtags su bkod pa'i mtshon sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khyad mtshan gyi mtshon sbyor ni/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba dang gsum so sor mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon/

bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i mtshon sbyor rnams so// de ltar na spyi'i mtshon sbyor gnyis dang*/ bye brag gi mtshon sbyor drug ste/ re zhig brgyad bshad la/ de dag kyang phye na bye brag gi mtshon sbyor snga ma gsum po de mtshan gzhi bcu drug po'i steng du so sor bkod pas bcu drug 'byung zhing*/ de dag la yang rtags 'god pa na/ byed mtshan sngar ltar gyi steng rang rang gi shes mtshan bcu drug so sor phye nas bkod pas bcu drug pa tshan pa bcu drug la nyis brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug 'byung zhing*/ de (270) dag gi steng du khyad mtshan gyi bye brag gi sbyor ba gsum la bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang*/ gzhal du med pa la sogs pa'i khyad mtshan bcu drug rtags su bkod pa'i bcu drug pa tshan pa gsum la bzhi bcu zhe brgyad 'byung ba dang*/ sngar gyi spyi sbyor gnyis bsnan pas/ kun sdom pa la mtshon sbyor gsum brgya dang drug 'byung bar shes par bya'o// dper mtshon na/ nyon mongs kyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid mtshan bzhi/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ phan bde skyob pa'i byed pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa dang*/ yang mtshan gzhi dang mtshon byed de bzhin du byas nas phung po don dam du 'jig pa med par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ phan bde skyobs pa'i byed pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gdul bya la bstan cing btags pa shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ phan bde skyobs pa'i byed pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin par zhes pa'i bar bcu drug dang*/ de bzhin du ngo bo nyid gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa gsum so sor mtshan gzhir bzung nas/

mtshon bya dang rtags 'god tshul sngar ltar bcu drug po mtshan pa re re dang*/ bya dka' ba'i (271) ngo bo nyid la sogs pa lnga mtshan bzhir bzung nas/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ yum la brten nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa nas/ don dam du mtshan nyid med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin zhes pa'i bar mtshan gzhi lnga po re re'i steng du yang bcu drug pa tshan po re re dang*/ yang de bzhin du dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid la sogs pa bdun so sor mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ mthong chos la bder gnas rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ gdul bya la chos ston pa'i mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa nas 'du shes 'gog pa rtogs pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ gdul bya la chos ston pa'i mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i bar mtshan gzhi bdun po re re'i steng du yang*/ bcu drug po tshan pa re re sbyor bas bye brag gi mtshon sbyor snga ma gsum la nyis brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhing*/ khyad mtshan gyi bye brag gi sbyor ba la (272) bzhi bcu zhe brgyad 'byung tshul dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba sogs gsum so sor mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ mtshon bya sngar bzhin la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos dbyings rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes dang*/ mnyam pa med pa'i rgyu chos dbyings rtogs pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba dang bcas pa'i chos dbyings rtogs pa khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa dang*/

mngon par zhen pa'i ro myong ba dang chos dbyings rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa'i bar bcu drug mtshan gzhi gsum po re re'i steng du sbyar bas bcu drug tshan pa gsum 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin la/ 'di nyid las/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs pa ni/ chos dbyings rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa zhes pa dang*/ don khyad par med de/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med la dgongs so// de ltar na theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon pa la shes mtshan dang byed mtshan gang rung gcig bkod na/ thabs shes zung du mi 'brel bas/ mtshon sbyor du mi (273) 'gyur la/ shes mtshan dang byed mtshan zung 'brel re bkod pas/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor du 'gro bas/ des theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon nus shing*/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na de'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid la shes mtshan khyad mtshan byed mtshan gsum du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin la/ 'on kyang zhi ba cha'i rnam dbye 'di ltar gces te/ shes mtshan dang byed mtshan tshogs pa ni theg chen sbyor ba'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid dngos yin mod/ shes mtshan rkyang pa dang*/ byed mtshan rkyang pa ni tshogs pa'i ming ya gyal la btags pa ltar/ de'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid btags pa bar 'dod dgos sam snyam ste rkyang pas theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon mi nus pa'i phyir/ khyad mtshan so sos ni theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa mtshon nus pas/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid rang skya thub pa yin no// 'dir kha cig sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa la/ shes mtshan dang*/ thabs phrin las mtshon par byed pa la byed mtshan bkod pas skyon ci yod snyam na/

rtags gsal chu thub tsam gyi mtshan (274) mtshon du 'gro na ha cang thal zhing*/ sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo mtshon pa la thabs shes zung 'brel mi dgos na/ sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo de theg chen gyi sbyor ba ma yin par 'gyur ba dang*/ thabs dang byed mtshan don 'dra bas// rang gis rang mtshon par 'gyur ro// des na theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang*/ byed mtshan gang rung yin na/ de'i byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ ma khyab par shes par bya'o// lnga pa de la brten nas thob pa'i thar pa cha mthun ni/ mdor bstan du/ thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gang zhe na/ mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs de rnam rdzogs sbyor bar gyur pa'i thar pa cha mthun yin no zhes pa ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ mkhas pa'i tshogs lam de dag gang zhe na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam khyad par can du gyur pa'i dad pa ni sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum dad pa'i yul du byed pa la mkhas der gyur pa'i brtson 'grus ni sbyin sogs phar phyin drug nyams su len pa

(275) la mkhas/ der 'gyur ba'i dran pa ni bsam pa phun tshogs mi brjed par byed pa la mkhas/ der gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa la mkhas/ der gyur ba'i shes rab ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mi dmigs par shes pa la mkhas pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyis bstan/ de ltar sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul lnga la mkhas pa'i tshogs lam khyad par can thob pa'i byang sems la dbang po rno rtul gyi bye brag gis/ gnas bla med rdzogs byang las phyir ldog mi ldog gnyis su yod do// zhes pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ des na sangs rgyas sogs dmigs zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi tshogs lam dang*/ theg chen tshogs lam khyad par can don gcig de yin na/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas khyab/ sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul lnga la mi mkhas pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam dang*/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam phal pa don gcig de yin na 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pas khyab/ dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang*/ (276) bzung ba chos kyi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang*/ bdag med ma rtogs pa'i tshogs lam dang gsum du yod/ tshogs lam la mnyam rjes kyi rnam bzhag med de/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag ma skyes pa'i phyir na/ rjes thob kyang 'byung ba mi 'thad do// gnyis pa sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i nyams skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgom rim la nges 'byed cha mthun nas thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i bar lnga las/ dang po ni/ thar pa cha mthun sgom pa las nges 'byed cha mthun skye bas/ thar pa cha mthun gyi 'og tu byang sems kyi sbyor lam ston la/ de la yang drod sogs bzhi yod pa las/ mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor gyur pa'i drod sogs bzhi ni/ skabs dang po gsum du bstan zin nas 'dir rjes thob kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i drod sogs bzhi 'chad pa skabs su babs la/

de yang dmigs pa sems can thams cad la dmigs nas rnam pa sems mnyam pa dang*/ byams pa'i sems dang*/ phan pa'i sems la sogs pa bcu po gang rung gis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam drod kyi ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de bzhin du dmigs yul sems can thams cad dge sdig (277) gi blang dor la 'god pa dang*/ blang dor la zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ mthun par byed pa dang gsum po gang rung gis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun 'dir bstan sbyor lam rtse mo'i ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni/ bdag nyid sdig pa las bzlog cing zhes pa nas/ rtse gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de bzhin du dmigs yul sems can kun la dmigs nas rang gzhan gyi rten can gyi bden pa shes pa la 'god pa sogs gsum po gang rung gis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun 'dir bstan sbyor lam bzod pa'i ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni rtse gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni/ rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa// zhes pas bstan/ yang de bzhin du dmigs yul sems can kun la dmigs nas rang gzhan smin grol la 'god pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun 'dir bstan sbyor lam chos mchog gi ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni/ chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams// smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// zhes pas bstan/ de ltar byang sems kyi sbyor lam thob pa nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun du 'jog pas/ de'i 'og tu gnyis pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun 'chad pa la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun ngos bzung ba dang*/ sgrub byed kyi rtags bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob (278) pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gang zhe na/ sbyor mthong bsgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams yin no// zhes pa ni/

nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags sogs gsum las/ dang po la nyi shu yod do zhes mdor bsdus nas 'chad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de la yang drod la gnas pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs bcu gcig ni/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba ldog pa dang*/ shes nas dad pa thob pas dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan la the tshom dang bral ba'i dad pa thob pa dang*/ mi khom pa brgyad du skye ba mi len pa'i smon lam grub pa dang*/ rang nyid dge ba bcu la gnas shing gzhan dag kyang de la 'god pa'i snying rje dang ldan pa dang*/ sbyin sogs gzhan don du bsngo ba'i spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis som nyi med par rtogs pa dang*/ sems can la byams pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas gzhan la phan pa lhur len pa dang*/ sems rgod 'gyod la sogs pa'i (279) sgrib pa lnga shas che ba dang mi 'grogs pa'i sbyor ba phun tshogs thob pa dang*/ ma rig pa la sogs pa'i bag la nyal kun gyi gnyen po stong nyid sgom pa la gnas pa dang*/ rtag tu sems rnam par ma g.yeng ba'i dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ gos sogs la sro shig med cing gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pa dang bcu gcig go ces 'chad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ rtags 'god pa ni/ sbyor lam drod rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog ste/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur pa ldog pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god la/ des phyi ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ kha cig

gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur pa ldog pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'god pa mi 'thad de/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa dbang rtul gyis ma nges so// rtse mo'i rtags drug ni/ lus kyi nang la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri mi 'byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par du 'phags pa thob pa dang*/ nyan (280) rang gis yid la byed pa sogs kyi gya gyu'i sems dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi dge rtsa rnam par dag pa thob pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod la sogs pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par len pa dang*/ sbyin sogs kyi mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang tshul 'chal sogs spangs pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang rang gi chos nyid dang ldan par shes pa dang*/ snying rjes gzhan don du dmyal bar skye ba don du gnyer ba dang drug go /zhes 'chad pa ni// lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// zhes pa nas/ sems can don du dmyal 'tshol dang*// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzod pa'i rtags gnyis ni/ bdud kyis lam gzhan du dkrir mi btub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'gal ba'i lam gzhan ston pa'i bdud la bdud nyid du rtogs pa dang gnyis yin la/ chos mchog gi rtags gcig ni/ 'khor gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa spangs pa'i rtag tu sangs rgyas dges pa'i spyod pa thob pa yin no zhes pa ni/ gzhan gyis dkrir ba mi btub dang*// zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas dges pa'i spyod pa ste// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis zhes pas sngar gyi de kun sdom pa la nyi shu yod par bstan/ drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*// chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni// zhes pas (281) shes 'dod chos can bstan// rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /zhes pas sgrub chos bstan no// gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog gi gtan tshigs la/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gis drangs pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can bcu drug yod do// zhes mdor bsdus nas 'chad pa ni/

mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ bcu drug po rgyas par 'chad pa ni/ gzugs sogs su mngon par zhen pa'i 'du shes zlog pa dang*/ bdud las mi phyed pas byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang*/ thabs shes zung du 'brel bas theg dman las sems rnam par log pa dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pas bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug sgom yang de dag tu skye ba mi len pa dang*/ lus sems yang bas dge ba la ci 'dod bskol du rung ba dang*/ mngon zhen med par 'dod yon la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas dang ldan pa dang*/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa'i tshul la gnas pa dang*/ rtag tu log 'tsho spangs nas yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang ldan pa dang*/ phung khams skye mched la dngos por zhen pa sbyor ba dang*/ phyi nas rgyun du zhen pa rjes su sbyor ba bkag pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ lam gyi bar chad du gyur pa'i chos nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam rtog la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba bkag pa'i (282) rtog pa dang ldan pa dang*/ byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs sbyin sogs la de gnyis bkag pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ dbang po dang dbang rten dbang po'i yul sogs kyi g.yul 'gyed pa la de gnyis bkag pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ ser sna dang 'chal tshul sogs la sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba bkag pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ chos thams cad rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ngo bor rtogs pas lam gyi chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ rang gis mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba la nges par thob pas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la sgom pa la gnas pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi rgyur gyur pa'i chos kyi don du srog gtong bar nus pa'i snying stobs dang ldan pa ste/ bcu drug ni mthong lam gyi rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/

gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang gtan tshigs 'god na/ mthong lam gyi rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog ste/ gzugs sogs la mngon par zhen pa'i 'du shes ldog pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ bdud las (283) kyis mi byed pa'i bla med byang chub kyi sems brtan par gnas pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs 'god pa yin no/ 'o na mdor bstan du shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug rtags su bshad pa dang*/ 'dir rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa rtags su bshad pa 'gal lo snyam na// skyon med de/ gzugs sogs mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes ldog pa sogs kyi rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa bcu drug po 'dren pa'i nus pa shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug rim bzhin thob pas na/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// zhes sogs gsung ba yin la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dngos ni/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi 'bras bu rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa bcu drug po la ngos 'dzin par kun mkhyen bla ma bzhed pa ni dpyod ldan kun gyi snying gi ga 'ur 'chang rigs te/ 'di'i thad kyi don gsal las/ de ltar na bzod pa dang bcas pa'i skad cig ma rnam pa bcu drug gis bsdus pa 'di rnams yang dag par thob pa na/ rtag pa 'jig rten pa bzung ba dang*/ 'dzin par mngon par ma zhen pa'i rnam pa can rjes thob kyi sems kyis bsdus pa rang dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu gzugs la sogs pa'i 'du shes ldog pa la sogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' (284) mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

de ltar na byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi khyab kyang*/ mthong lam pa la mnyam bzhag pas ma khyab ste/ sa dang po'i rjes thob pa kun mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ stong nyid dang mtshan ma med pa la sogs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom lam mnyam bzhag gis drangs pa'i sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis las grol ba'i don rtogs par byed pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs yin no zhes pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ gtan tshigs gang la ldan pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i sgom lam ngos bzung*/ de la rtsod pa spangs te sgo skur dang bral ba'i tshul sgrub pa/ de grub pa'i sgro skur dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs kyi dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su mthong zin gyi zab mo'i don la sems 'jal rtog gsum byed pa'i sgom lam rjes thob ye shes de sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs gang la ldan pa'i gzhir gyur (285) pa'i sgom lam gyi ngo bo yin no zhes pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de lta bu'i sgom lam de la dbye na/ chung ngu'i chung ngu nas chen po'i chen po bar dgu yod de/ de'i rgyu sgom lam mnyam bzhag de la sgom spangs chen po'i chen po la sogs pa dgu'i gnyen po chung ngu'i chung nga la sogs pa dgur yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sgom lam mnyam bzhag re re'i rjes su rjes thob re re rgyun chags su 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'dir dpyod ldan la dogs pa bkod pa ni/

gnyis pa nas bzung dgu pa'i mnyam bzhag gi rjes su rang rang rjes thob 'thad na yang bcu pa'i bar chad med lam rgyun mtha'i rjes/ bcu pa'i rjes thob 'byung ba 'thad dam ci/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa la/ sgro 'dogs pa'i rtsod pa spongs ba dang*/ skur pa 'debs pa'i rtsod pa spong ba gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis te/ bsod nams grangs med sogs mi skyed par thal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba dang*/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba mi byed par thal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po la rtsod pa dngos ni/ grangs med la sogs zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis dang*/ rtsod pa de spangs (286) nas sgro 'dogs dang bral ba'i tshul ni kun rdzob tu ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la yang sngar ltar rtsod pa dngos ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ rtsod pa de spangs nas sgro 'dogs dang bral ba'i tshul ni/ byang chub ji ltar de bzhin du zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa skur 'debs kyi rtsod pa spong ba la/ rtsod pa dngos ni/ sems ni snga mas zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ de spong ba ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni// zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa sgro skur dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs kyi dbye ba ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste zhes sogs la 'phros nas sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs de zab pa yin na/ de la dbye na du zhe na/ skye ba zab pa dang*/ 'gag pa zab= de bzhin nyid= shes bya= shes pa= spyod pa= gnyis med= thabs la mkhas pa zab pa dang brgyad yod do zhes pa ni/ skye ba dang nas zhes pa nas// thabs la mkhas pa zab pa nyid// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gtan tshigs 'god na/ sgom lam rjes thob la gnas pa'i sems dpa' pha rol po 'di chos can/ gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog ste/ skye ba zab pa'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom lam mnyam bzhag

(287) gis drangs pas rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir zhes pa ni 'dir bstan gyi gtan tshigs dang po yin zhing*/ des phyi ma bdun la'ang rigs 'gre'o// de ltar na bstan bcos rtsa ba'i dngos bstan la phyir mi ldog pa sgrub chos su byed pa'i gtan tshigs bzhi bcu zhe bzhi yod cing*/ de dag kun kyang 'bras rang ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs gsum gyi nang nas ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs dang*/ dgag rtags sgrub rtags gnyis kyi nang nas dgag rtags yin te/ dgag sgrub chos su byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir te/ gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa sgrub chos su byed pa'i rtags yang dag gang zhig de dgag pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir kun mkhyen bla mas/ slob dpon gyi 'grel chen dang*/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi lung drangs nas/ 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs zhe bzhi dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs zhe bzhi dang*/ ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs zhe bzhi bzhed pas/ kun sdom pas phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs brgya dang sum cu so gnyis so// de yang gtan tshigs dang po la dper mtshon na/ gzugs (288) sogs la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba ldog pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' pha rol po 'di chos can/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag sngon song yin te/ des drangs pa'i rjes thob tu lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir zhes pa ni 'bras rtags so// de bkod pa'i rgol ba de'i ngo bor de skor gyi sgrub bya grub nas yang gang zag de chos can/ theg pa gzhan gyi bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung du rung ste/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa ni rang bzhin gyi rtags so// de bkod pas de skor gyi sgrub bya nges pa na yang gang zag de chos can/

gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog ste/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung rung yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni mi dmigs pa'i rtags so// de bzhin du the tshom spangs pa dang*/ mi dal ba spang pa sogs kyi rjes thob tu lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' pha rol po chos can du bzung nas sngar ltar gtan tshigs gsum gsum 'god pa'i tshul rang gi blos dpyad de shes par bya'o// de ltar bshad pa'i gtan tshigs gsum rgol ba'i rgyun gcig la rims (289) can du bkod na/ phyi ma phyi ma'i phyogs chos sgrub byed du snga ma snga ma bkod pa yin gyis/ rgol ba de'i ngo bor sems dpa' pha rol po phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs dngos ni/ gtan tshigs gsum pa nyid yin te/ rgol ba de'i ngo bor gtan tshigs snga ma sems dpa' pha rol po phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu song na/ phyi ma gnyis grub zin sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ yang grol ba so so la ltos nas gtan tshigs snga ma de tsam sems dpa' pha rol po phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu song ba yang yod/ gnyis pa de tsam der song ba yang yod/ gsum pa de tsam der song ba yang yod pas/ de'i tshe na 'god yul gyi rgol ba de'i ngor gang rtags yang dag tu 'gro ba'i gtan tshigs gang rung cig bkod pas mchog gis/ gsum ka 'god mi dgos pa ni gnad kyi don no// des na sngar bkod pa'i gtan tshigs dang po gnyis spyir 'bras bu'i rtags yang dag dang rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag yin te/ rim bzhin rgyu sngon song sgrub dang*/ rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi rtags las 'bras bu 'byung rung du sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de ltar bkod pa'i tshe de dang de sems dpa' pha rol po gnas skabs rdzogs (290) byang las phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag yin te/

de sgrub bya'i dgag rtags yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na byang sems sbyor lam pa sogs kyi sems dpa' pha rol po phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag la/ 'bras rang ma dmigs pa'i rtags gsum du yod kyang*/ de sgrub kyi 'bras rang gi rtags yang dag med par shes par bya ste/ de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag yin na/ de sgrub kyi dgag rtags yang dag yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di 'dra'i rigs can dpal chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs na mang du bshad pas/ de bzhin 'dir yang sbyor shes na blo gros kyi mig phye bar 'gyur ro// 'dir yang nyang stod bka' chen pas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi mtshan nyid stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i yon tan gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus pa/ dbye na sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs sogs gsum du phye nas so so'i mtshan nyid kyang phal cher snga ma bzhin la rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa sogs de dang de gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog tu sgrub nus pa zhes sbyor ba mdzad do// de ni mi 'thad de/ yon tan gang la ldan pa'i (291) gang zag dang*/ ldan bya'i yon tan gnyis so sor ma phye ba'i skyon gnas pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i yon tan des rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa sogs gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus sam mi nus/ mi nus na mtshan nyid de mi 'thad par 'gyur zhing*/ sgrub nus na de lta bu'i yon tan de rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa de ltar du sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu thal/ de lta bu'i yon tan des de de ltar du sgrub nus pa gang zhig de lta bu'i yon tan de phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir/

rtags gnyis ka khas/ gong du 'dod na/ de lta bu'i yon tan chos can/ rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa de khyod yin par thal/ khyod de de ltar du sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de lta bu'i yon tan gang la ldan pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa chos can/ de lta bu'i yon tan ma yin par thal/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ des na sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi shes 'dod chos can du bshad pas/ rtags te bzung bya la yang phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ston pa'i gzhung tshig (292) so sos dngos su bstan pa'i yon tan de dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' 'am/ yon tan de dang ldan pa'i rtags su 'god dgos pa yin no// gsum pa srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba la/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ klan ka spangs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ de'i sbyor ba gang zhe na/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog spangs pa'i dag sa'i rjes thob kyi nyams len de srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba'i ngo bo yin no// zhes pa ni chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// srid dang zhi ba mi rtog par// zhes pas bstan/ 'dir kha cig gis/ yul can srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ yul 'khor 'das ngos bzung ba zhes pa'i sa bcad mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'khor 'das gnyis dang srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba de yul yul can ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid dang sbyor ba de yul yul can du 'thad pa'i phyir te/ de'i sbyor ba de'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na srid pa la dor bya dang*/ zhi ba la blang byar mi rtog pa'i sgom pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba don gcig yin zhing*/

'di ni tshogs gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs yin te/ 'di la (293) dgongs nas/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba zhes gsungs pa yin no// 'di'i sa mtshams ni/ dag pa sa gsum gyi rjes thob na yod de/ dag sa'i mnyam bzhag rnams ni chos nyid spros bral rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin pas/ 'khor 'das la blang dor tha dad du mi rtog par sgom pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor der mi 'byung zhing*/ rjes thob tu 'byung ba tha dad pa yin no// de ltar na 'khor 'das la blang dor tha dad du mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin na/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba yin pas ma khyab ste/ gnyis ka la byang sems dang po pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'khor 'das la blang dor tha dad du 'dzin pa med pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ srid zhi mnyam nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ srid zhi mnyam nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ma mtha' sa dang po nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa klan ka spangs pa ni/ las med la sogs klan ka yi// lan ni ji skad (294) bshad par zad// zhes pas bstan no// bzhi pa gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ zhing dag bla na med pa ni// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la dbye na du zhe na/ de la dbye na/ bcud kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ snod kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis su yod do// zhes pa ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'di'i mtshan nyid ni rang la snang ba'i zhing khams dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba'i ched du ma dag pa'i zhing sbyong bar byed pa'i dag sa'i rjes thob pa'i rnal 'byor de'o// 'di ni gzugs sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas/

bsod nams kyi tshogs su shes par bya'o// de ltar na gzhung rtsa bar/ sbyor ba snga ma de'i ngo bo'i sgo nas bstan/ 'di dbye ba'i sgo nas bstan zhing*/ zhing dag sbyor ba gnyis ka yang cha mthun tsam du ma dag sa bdun yod de/ ma dag pa'i sa'i gnas skabs na snod bcud kyi zhing sbyong ba'i yongs sbyongs bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar na ma dag sa'i zhing sbyong ba'i yongs sbyong de zhing sbyong ba'i sbyor ba yin la/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ma yin par shes par bya ste/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rang gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dngos su sgrub pa la nye ba'i sbyor (295) ba yin pas so// lnga pa phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/ 'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba gang zhe na// de la bcur yod de/ bdud bzhi las 'das pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ 'gog par lhung ba la mi gnas pa'i dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi bshugs las 'phangs pa'i ngang*/ theg chen lam gyi thun mong min pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dang*/ dman pa'i 'bras bu sngon du byed pa la ma chags pa'i dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi dang*/ mtshan ma med pa'i dang*/ smon pa med pa'i dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi dang*/ yul tshad med pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang bcur yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni zhes pa nas/ thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ bdud bzhi las 'das pa la sogs bcu po gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yul thabs mkhas mngon sum du bya ba la dus dang dus ma yin par shes pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor de'o// thabs mkhas dang po'i skabs su bdud bzhi bcom pa'i sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam thob nas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ sa dang po thob nas nyon mongs pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/

sa brgyad pa thob nas phung po'i bdud mngon 'gyur ba bcom/ gnas ngan len phra ba rnams (296) ni// sa bcu pa'i rgyun gyi mtha' mar btul nas/ de'i rjes thogs su sangs rgyas thob pa yin te/ bdag nyid chen po'i sdom gsum rab dbye las// sa bcu'i tha mar bdud btul nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs bzhi pa bstan zin to// ༈ //skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni/ mdor bstan du rtse mor phyin dang zhes pa las 'phros nas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i 'og tu rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems kyi tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum res 'jog gi tshul du rdzogs par bsgom pas/ sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i nyams skyes pa la rtse sbyor du 'jog pa'i phyir/ des na 'di 'chad pa la sbyor lam rtse sbyor/ mthong lam rtse sbyor/ sgom lam rtse sbyor/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor/ bsal bya log sgrub dang lngar yod pa las/ dang po sbyor lam rtse sbyor la/ rtags kyi rtse sbyor/ rnam 'phel gyi rtse sbyor/ brtan pa'i rtse sbyor/ sems kun gnas pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi skye bo snyed/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*// zhes sogs (297) tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ 'dir bstan sems kun gnas pa'i rtse sbyor ni/ sbyor lam chos mchog tu grub ste/ bsod nams mang po nyid kyi ni/ zhes pa dang*/ de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu/ bsod nams mang pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pa gnyis gnad gcig pas/ 'dir sems kun gnas pa'i rtse sbyor mthong lam myur du skye ba la mngon du gyur pa'i rtse sbyor du grub pa'i phyir/

de sbyor lam chos mchog yin par grub pa'i shugs kyis 'dir dngos bstan gyi rtse sbyor dang po gsum rim bzhin/ sbyor lam drod dang rtse mo dang bzod par grub pa yin no// des na rtse sbyor gyi rtags bcu gnyis po gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin na/ 'dir bstan rtags kyi rtse sbyor yin pas ma khyab ste/ rtags bcu gnyis po gang rung thob pa'i rtse sbyor ni/ sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan rtags kyi rtse sbyor ni sbyor lam drod kho nar nges pa'i phyir ro/ de bzhin du rtse sbyor gyi rnam 'phel bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ spyir rnam 'phel gyi rtse sbyor don gcig sa mtshams sbyor lam rtse mo nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ rtse sbyor gyi brtan pa gnyis po gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ brtan pa'i rtse sbyor don gcig sa mtshams sbyor lam bzod pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bsod nams mang po'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i rtse sbyor gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de la rjes su yi rang gang rung

(298) thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ brtan pa'i rtse sbyor don gcig sa mtshams sbyor lam bzod pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bsod nams mang po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i rtse sbyor gyi ting nge dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de la rjes su yi rang gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sems kun gnas pa'i rtse sbyor don gcig sa mtshams sbyor lam chos mchog nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do// gong gi rtags bcu gnyis ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su yang chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur lta ba dang*/ sgra brnyan dang*/ mig yor dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bur lta ba la sogs pa rmi lam gyi rtags drug dang*/ bdag byang chub tu lung bstan na grong khyer tshig par byed pa'i me 'di zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i mod la me zhi zhing nga rgyal med pa la sogs sad pa'i gnas skabs rtags drug go /rnam 'phel bcu drug ni/ rtag pa mtha' bzung gi dpes 'dzam bu gling nas stong gsum gyi bar gyi skye bo kun sangs rgyas su gyur pa la/ byang sems las dang po pa zhig gis de rnams ji srid bzhugs kyi bar du mchod cing*/ byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dge ba rnam pa du ma dper mdzad nas de bas rtse sbyor thob pa zhig gis rang nyid rtse sbyor la gnas nas/ gzhan la yum nyin gcig tsam bton pas bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba dang*/ yum (299) dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas nyin gcig la sogs pa rang gi bsgom na/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba la sogs pa'i phyi gtso bor gyur pa'i bsod nams brgyad/ nang gtso bor gyur pa'i bsod nams brgyad de bcu drug go /brtan pa gnyis ni/ shes rab chen pos dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ba gnyis so// 'dir bstan rtags kyi rtse sbyor sogs bzhi po rims bzhin/ sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi dang sbyor ba nyi snang dang 'grel pa don gsal las gsal bar gsungs shing*/

mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi snga rol du bshad pas kyang*/ sbyor lam du grub la/ 'on kyang mthong spangs bzhi'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sbyor lam ni ma yin te/ sbyor lam rjes thob tu nges pa'i phyir/ skabs bzhi par sbyor lam rjes thob bzhi bstan pa dang mi bzlos te/ skabs bzhi par sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i ldog pa nas bstan/ 'dir ni rtags dang rnam 'phel la sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spangs gzung 'dzin rnam par rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen po'i ldog pa nas bstan pa yin te/ lus rnam bzhag tu/ mthong zhes bya ba'i lam la ni// rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// (300) gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'di la spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog ngos bzung ba dang*/ gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor ngos bzung ba gnyis las/ dang po la bzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis/ dang po la 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/ ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis kyi ngo bo yul gyi sgo nas dgur dbye ba dang bcas pa mdor bsdus te 'chad pa ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i mthong spangs shes sgrib gang zhig rang yul theg chen gyi chos la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo 'dir bstan 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid dang*/ gang zhig rang yul theg dman gyi chos la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blang dor 'dir bstan ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid do// dang po la dbye na/ byang sems lam gyi ngo bo nyid la 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dang*/ sangs rgyas sar rigs nges pa la dang*/ mthong sgom gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa la dang*/ lam gyi dmigs pa phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ spang bya gnyen po 'dor len byed pa la dang*/

rang gi mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa thob pa la dang*/ nyan rang yid byed kyi bsam pa thag bsring bar byed pa la dbang*/ lam gyi byed las sems can gyi don byed pa la dang*/ bya ba'i 'bras bu myang 'das gsum la (301) 'god par byed pa la 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dang dgur yod do ces pa ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni/ zhes pa nas 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi// rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan// dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems lam gyi ngo bo phyin drug la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo lta bu dang*/ phyi ma brgyad kyi mtshan gzhi yang*/ gnas skabs sangs rgyas su rigs nges pa sogs de dang de la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo lta bu'o// bsdu na gnyis su 'dus te/ dang po lnga ni/ byang sems kyi lam la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ni/ byang sems lam gyi 'bras bu la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan 'jug pa gzung rtog yin na/ skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog yin pas khyab la/ skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi de yin na/ 'dir bstan 'jug pa'i gzung rtog yin pas ma khyab ste/ gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dgu'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzung rtog lnga pa dang drug pa ma gtogs pa'i bzung rtog gzhan bdun gyi ma nges pa'i phyir te/ ji ltar na byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi rang yul du gyur pa'i rnam byang gi phung po la (302) dmigs nas blang bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i bzung rtogs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis// de ni sor sor rnam pa dgu// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gnyen po'i rten can gyi bzung rtog dang po yin pa'i phyir te/

don gsal las/ gnyen po'i rten can phung po la bzung bar mngon par rtog pa zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi bzung rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib bzung rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ gnyen po'i rten can gyi bzung rtog lnga pa dang dgu pa gang rung min par gyur pa'i gnyen po'i rten can gyi bzung rtog gzhan bdun po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan ldog pa bzung rtog la dbye na/ srid zhi gang rung gi mthar ltung ba'i rtogs pa dman pa la dmigs pa'i ldog pa bzung rtog dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa med pa la dmigs pa'i dang*/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba la dmigs pa'i dang*/ gzhan gyi gdams ngag gi rkyen gyi dman pa'i byang chub tu 'gro ba la dmigs pa'i dang*/ ched du bya ba chen po gsum las ldog pa'i dang*/ lam gyi byed pa (303) nyi tshe ba la dmigs pa'i dang*/ rgyun zhugs sogs kyi rtogs pa sna tshogs pa la dmigs pa'i dang*/ rang don du mnyam bzhag la gnas pa dang*/ gzhan don du gdul bya'i zhing du 'gro ba la dgongs pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ dman pa myang 'das thob pa'i rjes la sangs rgyas su 'gro dgos pa la dmigs pa'i ldog pa bzung rtog dang dgur yod do zhes pa ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// zhes pa nas/ rnam rtog dgu'i bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de lta bu'i rtog pa dgu'i yul dgu po nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud la blang bar 'byung ba yin no// zhes pa ni/ nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung*// zhes pas bstan/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ rang yul du gyur pa'i rtogs pa dman pa la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo lta bu/

des phyi ma brgyad la'ang 'gre/ bsdu na gnyis su 'dus te/ dang po lnga ni/ theg dman gyi lam la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ni theg dman gyi lam gyi 'bras bu la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon pa zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan ldog pa bzung (304) rtog rnams ni skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi'i rten can gyi bzung rtog yin te/ rang yul kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos dang*/ rnam byang gi chos gang rung la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir te/ rang yul theg dman gyi rnam byang gi chos la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi'i rten can gyi bzung rtog la/ skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi ldog pa bzung rtog gis ma khyab ste/ rang yul du gyur pa'i ma rig pa la dmigs nas dor bya'i bzung bar mngon par zhen pa sogs/ bzung rtog dang po brgyad skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi ldog pa nas bzung rtog ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de brgyad rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib bzung rtog yin pa gang zhig skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi ldog pa bzung rtog yin na/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib bzung rtog yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spangs 'dzin rtog la dbye na/ gang zag la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang*/ gang zag (305) la btags yod du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang gnyis su yod cing*/ de gnyis la yang yul gyi sgo nas dgu dgur yod do zhes pa ni/ so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de dag rtog par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gal te bzung don de bzhin med ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/

mthong spangs 'dzin rtog thams cad gong gi gnyis po der ma nges te/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ rtags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis mdor bstan/ 'dir shugs la bstan par/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge yab sras kyi bzhed pa yin no// de ltar na theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtog pa gang zhig rang yul du gyur pa'i gang zag dang*/ chos kyi zlas phye ba'i de gang rung la dmigs nas/ 'dzin pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gnyis las/ dang po de dang*/ sems can rdzas dang rtags yod par// rnam rtog 'dzin pa (306) dag tu 'dod// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// zhes sogs shugs bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa rnams don gcig mtshan nyid ni/ sngar gyi de gang zhig rang yul du gyur pa'i gang zag tsam la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo de'o// dbye na/ skabs dang por bshad pa ltar/ rang dbang can gyi bdag la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu yod de/ de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi dgu mtshan dang po de skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgu la byed pa yin no// chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// zhes sogs rgyas bshad kyi dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas zhes sogs mdor bstan gyi shugs la bstan pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa rnams don gcig mtshan nyid ni/ rang yul du gyur pa'i chos tsam la dmigs nas zhes sbyar la/

gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin no// dbye ba ni rgyas bshad du 'byung ngo*// de ltar rdzas 'dzin rtog pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi spangs bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyon sgrib dang*/ phyi ma ni byang sems (307) kyi spangs bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib yin te/ skabs dang po'i thad kyi 'di nyid las/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa la gang zag la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin yin te nyan thos kyi spangs bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyon sgrib dang*/ chos la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin rtog pa gnyis ni/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin pas/ byang sems kyi spangs bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtags 'dzin rtog pa la/ gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i mthong spangs btags 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i mthong spangs btags 'dzin rtog pa dang gnyis las/ dang po de dang*/ sems can rdzas dang btags yod pa// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*// zhes sogs shugs bstan gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa rnams don gcig mtshan nyid ni/ sngar gyi de gang zhig rang yul du gyur pa'i gang zag tsam la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por rtags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo'o// dbye na skabs dang por bshad pa ltar phung po la brten nas btags par yod pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas (308) 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu yod de/ de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi dgu mtshan gnyis po de skabs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa dgu la byed pa yin no// dgu mtshan gnyis po de 'dir rgyas bshad du mi 'byung ba ni skabs dang por bstan zin pa la dgongs so// des na 'dir mdo rgyas dngos bstan mthun par mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin te/

mdor bstan du gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i 'dzin rtog gnyis dang*/ de gnyis la dbye na/ dgu dgu yod pa tsam zhig bstan nas/ dgu po gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin skabs dang por bstan zin pas rgyas bshad du mi 'byung ba'i gnad de yin la/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i 'dzin rtog gnyis rgyas bshad du dbye ba dgu dgu ngos 'dzin dang bcas te 'chad pa la dgongs nas/ mdor bstan du dngos su ma bstan pa yin no// rgyal ba byams mgon dges pa'i zhal gyi padmo bzhed par smon no// gnyis pa chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i mthong spangs btags 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ ched bzhin nges pa mi 'byung dang*/ zhes sogs rgyas bshad kyi dngos bstan gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas// zhes sogs mdor bstan gyi shugs la bstan (309) pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa rnams don gcig mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtog pa gang zhig rang yul du gyur pa'i chos tsam la dmigs nas/ 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo'o// dbye ba ni rgyas bshad du 'byung ngo*// 'dir nyang stod bka' chen pas/ skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du yang*/ mthong spangs shes sgrib gang zhig gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ gang zag la rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i mthong spangs rtog pa chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur der thal skabs lnga pa'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa 'dzin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ so so skye ba 'phags dbye bas/ zhes sogs kyi dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ sems can rdzas dang btags yod pa// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'dzin rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ shes sgrib yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyon sgrib yin pa'i phyir/
gang zag gi bdag 'dzin yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir bstan rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ni/ so skye'i kho na'i rgyud la yod pa dang*/

(310) 'dir bstan btags 'dzin rtog pa ni 'phags pa kho na'i rgyud la yod par nges te/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas// zhes pas rten gyi gang zag skye 'phags so sor nges par bstan pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'dir bstan mthong spang btags 'dzin rtog pa byang 'phags kyi rgyud la nam yang mi ldan te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam la sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi khyab pa gang zhig sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mthong spangs rtog pa bzhi slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i phyir/ 'dir dpyod ldan la dogs pa bkod pa ni/ gang zag btags pa tsam du mngon zhen pa/ sbyor lam rjes thob tsam du yod pas na// gang zag btags yod 'dzin pa rgyud ldan ni// 'phags pa kho nar bshad 'di ji ltar yin// zhes pa'o// de ltar na theg chen 'phags pa yin na mthong spangs rtog pa rgyud la mi ldan pas khyab cing*/ de spangs pas ma khyab ste/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa de/ mthong spangs spong bzhin pa'i spong ba gnyen po la gnas pas rang rgyud la mthong spangs 'gags zin kyang de spangs par mi 'jog pa'i phyir te/ de spong ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i phyir/ des spang bya kun la rigs 'gre zhing*/ spang bya de'i spong ba'i gnyen po skyes pa (311) dang spang bya 'gags pa dus mnyam pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi dpes kyang shes te/ don gsal las/ rkun po byung ba dang sgo phar bcad pa ltar dus mnyam du gnyen po dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs skye ba dang 'gag pa dgag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des mtshon nas sems can yin na/ sgrib pa ma spangs pas khyab/ ma spang na/ sgrib pa rgyud ldan yin pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems rgyun mtha' pa'i rgyud la sgrib pa med pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyud la sgrib pa yod na/ de'i rgyud la sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba yod dgos pa las/ de'i rgyud la de yang med pa'i phyir/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes de sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba spong ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/

mdor na gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ni/ gang zag rdzas yod la dmigs nas bden par mngon par zhen pa dang*/ gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i rtags 'dzin rtog pa ni/ gang zag rtags yod la dmigs nas rtags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blor shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ de dag so so'i dgu bdag nyid// ces pa la 'phros nas/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgu po gang zhe na/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa 'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgu sngar bshad ma tshar bas de 'chad pa (312) ni/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa de la dbye na dgu yod de/ blang bya dang spang bya 'dor len la dmigs nas bden par mngon par zhen pa dang*/ chos thams cad bden par yid la byed par dmigs nas dang*/ khams gsum po dag dang nye bar 'brel ba la dmigs= gzugs sogs la mtshan 'dzin gyi gnas pa la= gzugs sogs la mngon par zhen pa la= gzugs sogs chos kyi dngos po tha dad du btags pa tsam la= sbyin sogs la 'khor gsum du chags pa la= 'khor 'das la blang dor du 'dzin pa'i gnyen po la= sbyin sogs kyang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin byang chub tu 'gro ba'i nus pa nyams pa la dmigs nas bden par mngon par zhen pa dang dgur yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*// zhes pa nas/ 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan// 'di dag chos la bden 'dzin zhugs pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin te/ 'di dag gi yul 'dzin 'dor sogs dgu po de chos dang gang zag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i chos su 'jog pa'i phyir/ de skad du 'di nyid las/ rgyas bshad du chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dngos su bstan pas/ de'i yul de la 'dzin 'dor sogs chos dgur phye (313) nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa yin no// de bzhin du gnyis pa chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa yang dgur yod de/

theg chen gyi ched du bya ba bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba dang*/ dman pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba la dmigs nas rtags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa dang*/ theg chen gyi lam la lam ma yin par 'dzin pa la la dmigs nas dang*/ rgyu 'gag pa dang 'bras bu skye ba la dmigs nas dang*/ lam gyi dngos po mngon gyur du ldan pa dang mi ldan pa la dmigs nas dang*/ gzugs sogs la mi gnas pa'i tshul gyi gnas pa dmigs nas dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs 'jig par byed pa la dmigs nas dang*/ don dam par byang chub don du gnyer ba med pa la dmigs nas dang*/ don dam par byang chub kyi rgyu med pa la dmigs nas dang*/ bdud sogs kyi phyir rgol ba la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa dang dgu yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*// zhes pa nas/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ rgyas bshad kyi skabs kyi 'dzin rtog gnyis kyang skabs dang por/ rdzas dang rtags pa'i brten can gyi// 'dzin pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'dzin rtog yin te/ tshig rkang gnyis po des theg chen gyi (314) mthong spangs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa mtha' dag dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang*/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi dngos bstan gyi 'dzin rtog ma yin te/ rkang pa gnyis po de'i dngos bstan gyi 'dzin rtog yin na/ gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i 'dzin rtog yin pas khyab par sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor la mthong lam gyi rgyu/ gnyen pos spang bya spong ba'i tshul/ gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ byang chub la gzhan zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa la dbu ma'i pa'i lugs kyi spang bya spong tshul 'thad pa/ dngos smra ba'i lugs kyi spang bya spong tshul mi 'thad pa/

shes byed kyi lung dang sbyar ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dri ma zad dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'di la gsal bya zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi nang nas skad cig ma dang po sdug bsngal chos bzod kho na (315) mthong spangs rtog pa bzhi gcig char spong ba'i gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor yin no zhes pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re re ni/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal chos bzod de la mthong spangs gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi spong ba'i ldog cha nas mthong lam rtse sbyor bzhi dang*/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhir 'jog cing*/ der ma zad mthong spangs bzhi la dgu dgur phye ba'i dgu bzhi sum cu rtsa drug spong ba'i ldog pa nas/ gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor sum cu rtsa drug tu yang 'jog pa yin te/ don gsal las/ skad cig ma gcig pa sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pas bsdus pa 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas rab tu phye ba/ rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug can skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dir mthong ba'i lam yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan mthong lam sum cu rtsa drug gi nang mtshan du gyur pa'i mthong lam dang po nas sum cu rtsa drug gi bar don gcig ste/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod gcig nyid la de dag tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma phyi ma bco lnga ni nges mtshon nas bstan pas/ bcu drug rdzogs rjes su rnam thar brgyad dang snyoms 'jug dgu la lugs (316) 'byung dang lugs ldog tu snyoms par 'jug pa sa dang po'i khyad par lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin seṅge rnam sgyings 'byung ba yin no// zhes pa ni/
